pragma solidity ^0.8.23;

interface IERC1822Proxiable {
    function proxiableUUID() external view returns (bytes32);

contract ThresholdSignerAccessControlUUPS {
    struct RoleData {
        mapping(address => bool) members;
        bytes32 adminRole;
    }

    error AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(address account, bytes32 neededRole);
    error AccessControlBadConfirmation();

    error InvalidInitialization();
    error NotInitializing();

    error ERC1967InvalidImplementation(address implementation);
    error ERC1967NonPayable();
    error UUPSUnauthorizedCallContext();
    error UUPSUnsupportedProxiableUUID(bytes32 slot);

    error AddressEmptyCode(address target);
    error FailedCall();

    error ECDSAInvalidSignature();
    error ECDSAInvalidSignatureLength(uint256 length);
    error ECDSAInvalidSignatureS(bytes32 s);

    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event Upgraded(address indexed implementation);
    event Initialized(uint64 version);

    bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;
    bytes32 public constant SIGNER_ROLE = keccak256("SIGNER_ROLE");
    uint8 public constant MAX_THRESHOLD = 100;

    bytes32 private constant _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT =
        0x360894A13BA1A3210667C828492DB98DCA3E2076CC3735A920A3CA505D382BBC;

    uint8 public threshold;

    mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) private _roles;
    mapping(bytes32 => address[]) private _roleMembers;
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _roleMemberIndexPlusOne;

    bool private _initialized;
    bool private _initializing;

    address private immutable __self = address(this);

    modifier initializer() {
        if (_initialized || _initializing) revert InvalidInitialization();
        _initialized = true;
        _initializing = true;
        _;
        _initializing = false;
        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    modifier onlyInitializing() {
        if (!_initializing) revert NotInitializing();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyProxy() {
        if (address(this) == __self || _getImplementation() != __self) {
            revert UUPSUnauthorizedCallContext();
        }
        _;
    }

    modifier notDelegated() {
        if (address(this) != __self) {
            revert UUPSUnauthorizedCallContext();
        }
        _;
    }

    function initialize(
        address defaultAdmin,
        address[] calldata initialSigners,
        uint8 initialThreshold
    ) external initializer {
        __AccessControl_init();
        __UUPSUpgradeable_init();

        require(defaultAdmin != address(0), "invalid admin");
        require(initialThreshold <= MAX_THRESHOLD, "invalid threshold");

        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, defaultAdmin, msg.sender);
        threshold = initialThreshold;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < initialSigners.length; i++) {
            _grantRole(SIGNER_ROLE, initialSigners[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function __AccessControl_init() internal onlyInitializing {}
    function __UUPSUpgradeable_init() internal onlyInitializing {}

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // IERC165
            interfaceId == 0x7965db0b || // IAccessControl
            interfaceId == 0x5a05180f;   // IAccessControlEnumerable
    }

    function UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION() external pure returns (string memory) {
        return "5.0.0";
    }

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members[account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roles[role].adminRole;
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        _checkRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender);
        _grantRole(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        _checkRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender);
        _revokeRole(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        if (account != msg.sender) revert AccessControlBadConfirmation();
        _revokeRole(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return _roleMembers[role][index];
    }

    function getRoleMemberCount(bytes32 role) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _roleMembers[role].length;
    }

    function getRoleMembers(bytes32 role) external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return _roleMembers[role];
    }

    function updateSigners(address[] calldata signers, bool grant_) external {
        _checkRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        require(signers.length > 0, "empty signers");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < signers.length; i++) {
            address signer = signers[i];
            require(signer != address(0), "invalid signer");
            if (grant_) {
                _grantRole(SIGNER_ROLE, signer, msg.sender);
            } else {
                _revokeRole(SIGNER_ROLE, signer, msg.sender);
            }
        }
    }

    function updateThreshold(uint8 newThreshold) external {
        _checkRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        require(newThreshold <= MAX_THRESHOLD, "invalid threshold");
        threshold = newThreshold;
    }

    function verifySignatures(bytes32 hash, bytes calldata signatures) external view returns (bool) {
        if (signatures.length % 65 != 0) revert("Invalid signatures length");

        uint256 sigCount = signatures.length / 65;
        uint256 signerCount = getRoleMemberCount(SIGNER_ROLE);

        if (
            sigCount == 0 ||
            sigCount * uint256(MAX_THRESHOLD) < uint256(threshold) * signerCount
        ) {
            revert("Insufficient signatures");
        }

            abi.encodePacked("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32", hash)
        );

        address[] memory recovered = new address[](sigCount);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < sigCount; i++) {
            bytes32 r;
            bytes32 s;
            uint8 v;
            uint256 base = signatures.offset + i * 65;

            assembly {
                r := calldataload(base)
                s := calldataload(add(base, 0x20))
                v := byte(0, calldataload(add(base, 0x40)))
            }

            address signer = _recover(digest, v, r, s);

            if (!hasRole(SIGNER_ROLE, signer)) {
                return false;
            }

            for (uint256 j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                if (recovered[j] == signer) revert("Duplicate signature");
            }

            recovered[i] = signer;
        }

        return true;
    }

    function proxiableUUID() external view notDelegated returns (bytes32) {
        return _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
    }

    function upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes calldata data) external payable onlyProxy {
        _checkRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        require(newImplementation != address(0), "invalid implementation");
        _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(newImplementation, data);
    }

        try IERC1822Proxiable(newImplementation).proxiableUUID() returns (bytes32 slot) {
            if (slot != _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT) {

        if (d.usedHashes[signer][h]) return CheckResult.TransferAlreadyExecuted;

        uint256 approved = d.allowances[from][signer];
        if (approved < tokens) return CheckResult.InsufficientApprovedTokens;

        uint256 total;
        unchecked {
            total = tokens + fee;
            if (total < tokens) return CheckResult.OverflowError;
        }
        if (approved < total) return CheckResult.InsufficientApprovedTokensForFees;
        if (d.balances[from] < tokens) return CheckResult.InsufficientTokens;
        if (d.balances[from] < total) return CheckResult.InsufficientTokensForFees;
        if (_willOverflowAdd(d.balances[to], tokens)) return CheckResult.OverflowError;
        if (fee > 0 && _willOverflowAdd(d.balances[feeAccount], fee)) return CheckResult.OverflowError;

    function _msgForCode(uint8 code) internal pure returns (string memory) {

        if (code == 3) return "Mismatch in signing account";
        if (code == 4) return "Transfer already executed";
        if (code == 5) return "Insufficient approved tokens";
        if (code == 6) return "Insufficient approved tokens for fees";

        if (code == 8) return "Insufficient tokens for fees";

        require(d.balances[msg.sender] >= tokens, "BALANCE");

    function signedApprove(

    function signedTransferFrom(
        uint256 self,
        address signingAccount,
        address from,
        address to,
        address token,
        uint256 tokens,
        uint256 fee,
        uint256 nonce,
        bytes calldata sig,
        address feeAccount
    ) external returns (bool) {
        Data storage d = _d(self);
        CheckResult r = _checkTransferFrom(d, signingAccount, from, to, token, tokens, fee, nonce, sig, feeAccount);
        require(r == CheckResult.Success, _msgForCode(uint8(r)));

        bytes32 h = _signedTransferFromHash(signingAccount, from, to, token, tokens, fee, nonce);
        (address signer, ) = _resolveSigner(signingAccount, h, sig);
        d.usedHashes[signer][h] = true;

        }

        d.balances[to] += tokens;
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokens);

        if (fee > 0) {
            d.balances[feeAccount] += fee;
            emit Transfer(from, feeAccount, fee);
        }

    function signedApproveAndCall(

        bytes32 h = _signedApproveAndCallHash(signingAccount, spender, token, tokens, data, fee, nonce);

            unchecked {

        }

        _callReceiveApproval(spender, signer, tokens, token, data);
        return true;
    }

        return _msgForCode(code);
    }

}

contract Bridge {
    enum ProposalStatus {
        Inactive,
        Active,
        Passed,
        Executed,
        Cancelled
    }

    struct Proposal {
        ProposalStatus status;
        uint64 yesVotes;
        uint40 proposedBlock;
        bytes32 resourceID;
        bytes data;
        address[] voters;
    }

    struct RoleData {
        mapping(address => bool) members;
        mapping(address => uint256) indexPlusOne;
        address[] memberList;
        bytes32 adminRole;
    }

    bytes32 private constant _DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;
    bytes32 private constant _RELAYER_ROLE = keccak256("RELAYER_ROLE");
    bytes32 private constant _OPERATOR_ROLE = keccak256("OPERATOR_ROLE");

    mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) private _roles;

    bool private _pausedValue;
    uint8 private _chainIdValue;
    uint256 private _relayerThresholdValue;
    uint256 private _totalRelayersValue;
    uint256 private _totalOperatorsValue;
    uint256 private _totalProposalsValue;
    uint256 private _feeValue;
    uint256 private _expiryValue;
    address private _wtokenAddressValue;

    mapping(uint8 => uint64) private _depositCountValue;
    mapping(uint8 => uint256) private _specialFeeValue;
    mapping(bytes32 => address) private _resourceHandlerValue;
    mapping(bytes32 => address) private _resourceTokenValue;
    mapping(uint72 => bytes) private _depositRecordValue;
    mapping(uint72 => mapping(bytes32 => Proposal)) private _proposalValue;
    mapping(uint72 => mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool))) private _hasVotedValue;

    event Deposit(uint8 indexed destinationChainID, bytes32 indexed resourceID, uint64 indexed depositNonce);
    event ProposalVote(uint8 indexed originChainID, uint64 indexed depositNonce, uint8 status, bytes32 indexed dataHash);

    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);

    event RelayerAdded(address indexed relayer);
    event RelayerRemoved(address indexed relayer);
    event OperatorAdded(address indexed operator);
    event OperatorRemoved(address indexed operator);
    event RelayerThresholdChanged(uint256 indexed relayerThreshold);

    event Paused(address account);
    event Unpaused(address account);

    modifier onlyAdminOrRelayer() {
        require(
            hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE(), msg.sender) || hasRole(RELAYER_ROLE(), msg.sender),
            "sender is not relayer or admin"
        );
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyAdminOrOperator() {
        require(
            hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE(), msg.sender) || hasRole(OPERATOR_ROLE(), msg.sender),
            "sender is not operator or admin"
        );
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!_pausedValue, "paused");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenPaused() {
        require(_pausedValue, "not paused");
        _;
    }

    constructor(
        uint8 chainID_,
        uint256 relayerThreshold_,
        uint256 fee_,
        uint256 expiry_,
        address wtoken_
    ) {
        _chainIdValue = chainID_;
        _relayerThresholdValue = relayerThreshold_;
        _feeValue = fee_;
        _expiryValue = expiry_;
        _wtokenAddressValue = wtoken_;

        _roles[_DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE].adminRole = _DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
        _roles[_RELAYER_ROLE].adminRole = _DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
        _roles[_OPERATOR_ROLE].adminRole = _DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;

        _grantRole(_DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    function DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE() public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return _DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
    }

    function RELAYER_ROLE() public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return _RELAYER_ROLE;
    }

    function OPERATOR_ROLE() public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return _OPERATOR_ROLE;
    }

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members[account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 admin = _roles[role].adminRole;
        if (role == _DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) return _DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
        return admin == bytes32(0) ? _DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE : admin;
    }

    function getRoleMemberCount(bytes32 role) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _roles[role].memberList.length;
    }

    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        require(index < _roles[role].memberList.length, "EnumerableSet: index out of bounds");
        return _roles[role].memberList[index];
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        _checkRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender);
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        _checkRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender);
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceAdmin(address newAdmin) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE(), newAdmin);
        renounceRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE(), msg.sender);
    }

    function isRelayer(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return hasRole(RELAYER_ROLE(), account);
    }

    function isOperator(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return hasRole(OPERATOR_ROLE(), account);
    }

    function adminAddRelayer(address relayer) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        require(!hasRole(RELAYER_ROLE(), relayer), "addr already has relayer role!");
        grantRole(RELAYER_ROLE(), relayer);
        _totalRelayersValue += 1;
        emit RelayerAdded(relayer);
    }

    function adminRemoveRelayer(address relayer) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        require(hasRole(RELAYER_ROLE(), relayer), "addr doesn't have relayer role!");
        revokeRole(RELAYER_ROLE(), relayer);
        if (_totalRelayersValue > 0) _totalRelayersValue -= 1;
        emit RelayerRemoved(relayer);
    }

    function adminAddOperator(address operator) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        require(!hasRole(OPERATOR_ROLE(), operator), "addr already has operator role!");
        grantRole(OPERATOR_ROLE(), operator);
        _totalOperatorsValue += 1;
        emit OperatorAdded(operator);
    }

    function adminRemoveOperator(address operator) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        require(hasRole(OPERATOR_ROLE(), operator), "addr doesn't have operator role!");
        revokeRole(OPERATOR_ROLE(), operator);
        if (_totalOperatorsValue > 0) _totalOperatorsValue -= 1;
        emit OperatorRemoved(operator);
    }

    function adminPauseTransfers() external onlyAdminOrOperator whenNotPaused {
        _pausedValue = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function adminUnpauseTransfers() external onlyAdminOrOperator whenPaused {
        _pausedValue = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _pausedValue;
    }

    function _chainID() external view returns (uint8) {
        return _chainIdValue;
    }

    function _fee() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _feeValue;
    }

    function _expiry() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _expiryValue;
    }

    function _relayerThreshold() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _relayerThresholdValue;
    }

    function _totalRelayers() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalRelayersValue;
    }

    function _totalOperators() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalOperatorsValue;
    }

    function _totalProposals() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalProposalsValue;
    }

    function _wtokenAddress() external view returns (address) {
        return _wtokenAddressValue;
    }

    function _specialFee(uint8 domainID) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _specialFeeValue[domainID];
    }

    function getFee(uint8 domainID) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 sf = _specialFeeValue[domainID];
        return sf == 0 ? _feeValue : sf;
    }

    function adminChangeRelayerThreshold(uint256 newThreshold) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        _relayerThresholdValue = newThreshold;
        emit RelayerThresholdChanged(newThreshold);
    }

    function adminChangeFee(uint256 newFee) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        require(newFee != _feeValue, "Current fee is equal to new fee");
        _feeValue = newFee;
    }

    function adminChangeSpecialFee(uint256 newFee, uint8 domainID) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        require(_specialFeeValue[domainID] != newFee, "Current special fee equals to the new fee");
        _specialFeeValue[domainID] = newFee;
    }

    function _resourceIDToHandlerAddress(bytes32 resourceID) external view returns (address) {
        return _resourceHandlerValue[resourceID];
    }

    function adminSetResource(address handlerAddress, bytes32 resourceID, address tokenAddress) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        _resourceHandlerValue[resourceID] = handlerAddress;
        _resourceTokenValue[resourceID] = tokenAddress;
        IBridgeHandler(handlerAddress).setResource(resourceID, tokenAddress);
    }

    function adminSetGenericResource(
        address handlerAddress,
        bytes32 resourceID,
        address targetContractAddress,
        bytes4 depositFunctionSig,
        uint256 depositFunctionDepositerOffset,
        bytes4 executeFunctionSig
    ) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        _resourceHandlerValue[resourceID] = handlerAddress;
        _resourceTokenValue[resourceID] = targetContractAddress;
        IBridgeHandler(handlerAddress).setResource(
            resourceID,
            targetContractAddress,
            depositFunctionSig,
            depositFunctionDepositerOffset,
            executeFunctionSig
        );
    }

    function adminSetBurnable(address handlerAddress, address tokenAddress) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        IBridgeHandler(handlerAddress).setBurnable(tokenAddress);
    }

    function adminUpdateBridgeAddress(address handlerAddress, address bridgeAddress) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        IBridgeHandler(handlerAddress).updateBridgeAddress(bridgeAddress);
    }

    function adminWithdraw(address handlerAddress, address tokenAddress, address recipient, uint256 amount) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        IBridgeHandler(handlerAddress).withdraw(tokenAddress, recipient, amount);
    }

    function transferFunds(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyAdminOrOperator {
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            (bool ok, ) = payable(recipients[i]).call{value: amounts[i]}("");
            require(ok, "native transfer failed");
        }
    }

    function _depositCounts(uint8 destinationChainID) external view returns (uint64) {
        return _depositCountValue[destinationChainID];
    }

    function _depositRecords(uint64 depositNonce, uint8 chainID) external view returns (bytes memory) {
        return _depositRecordValue[_nonceAndID(chainID, depositNonce)];
    }

    function _hasVotedOnProposal(uint72 nonceAndID, bytes32 dataHash, address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _hasVotedValue[nonceAndID][dataHash][account];
    }

    function _proposals(uint72 nonceAndID, bytes32 dataHash)
        external
        view
        returns (uint8 status, uint64 yesVotes, uint40 proposedBlock, uint256 voters, uint256 dataLength)
    {
        Proposal storage p = _proposalValue[nonceAndID][dataHash];
        return (uint8(p.status), p.yesVotes, p.proposedBlock, p.voters.length, p.data.length);
    }

    function getProposal(uint8 originChainID, uint64 depositNonce, bytes32 dataHash)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint8 status,
            uint64 yesVotes,
            uint40 proposedBlock,
            bytes32 resourceID,
            bytes memory data,
            address[] memory voters
        )
    {
        Proposal storage p = _proposalValue[_nonceAndID(originChainID, depositNonce)][dataHash];
        return (uint8(p.status), p.yesVotes, p.proposedBlock, p.resourceID, p.data, p.voters);
    }

    function deposit(uint8 destinationChainID, bytes32 resourceID, bytes calldata data) external payable whenNotPaused {
        require(msg.value == getFee(destinationChainID), "Incorrect fee supplied");
        _depositInternal(destinationChainID, resourceID, data, msg.sender);
    }

    function depositETH(uint8 destinationChainID, bytes32 resourceID, bytes calldata data) external payable whenNotPaused {
        uint256 requiredFee = getFee(destinationChainID);
        require(msg.value >= requiredFee, "Insufficient fee supplied");

        uint256 amount = msg.value - requiredFee;
        require(data.length >= 32, "msg.value and data mismatched");
        uint256 dataAmount = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
        require(dataAmount == amount, "msg.value and data mismatched");

        address handler = _resourceHandlerValue[resourceID];
        require(handler != address(0), "resourceID not mapped to handler");

        address wtoken = _wtokenAddressValue;
        if (wtoken == address(0)) {
            try IBridgeHandler(handler)._wtokenAddress() returns (address wt) {
                wtoken = wt;
            } catch {}
        }
        require(wtoken != address(0), "wToken is not allowed in ERC20 mode");

        IWETH(wtoken).deposit{value: amount}();
        require(IERC20(wtoken).transfer(handler, amount), "wrapped transfer failed");

        _depositInternal(destinationChainID, resourceID, data, msg.sender);
    }

    function voteProposal(uint8 originChainID, uint64 depositNonce, bytes32 resourceID, bytes32 dataHash)
        external
        onlyAdminOrRelayer
        whenNotPaused
    {
        require(_resourceHandlerValue[resourceID] != address(0), "no handler for resourceID");

        uint72 id = _nonceAndID(originChainID, depositNonce);
        Proposal storage p = _proposalValue[id][dataHash];

        if (p.status == ProposalStatus.Inactive) {
            p.status = ProposalStatus.Active;
            p.proposedBlock = uint40(block.number);
            p.resourceID = resourceID;
            _totalProposalsValue += 1;
        } else {
            require(
                p.status != ProposalStatus.Cancelled && p.status != ProposalStatus.Executed,
                "proposal already passed/executed"
            );
            require(block.number <= uint256(p.proposedBlock) + _expiryValue, "proposal not at expiry threshold");
        }

        require(!_hasVotedValue[id][dataHash][msg.sender], "already voted");
        _hasVotedValue[id][dataHash][msg.sender] = true;

        p.yesVotes += 1;
        p.voters.push(msg.sender);

        emit ProposalVote(originChainID, depositNonce, uint8(p.status), dataHash);

        if (p.status == ProposalStatus.Active && p.yesVotes >= _relayerThresholdValue) {
            p.status = ProposalStatus.Passed;
        }
    }

    function cancelProposal(uint8 originChainID, uint64 depositNonce, bytes32 dataHash) external onlyAdminOrRelayer {
        uint72 id = _nonceAndID(originChainID, depositNonce);
        Proposal storage p = _proposalValue[id][dataHash];

        require(p.status == ProposalStatus.Active, "proposal is not active");
        require(block.number > uint256(p.proposedBlock) + _expiryValue, "Proposal not at expiry threshold");

        p.status = ProposalStatus.Cancelled;
    }

    function executeProposal(uint8 originChainID, uint64 depositNonce, bytes calldata data, bytes32 resourceID)
        external
        onlyAdminOrRelayer
        whenNotPaused
    {
        address handler = _resourceHandlerValue[resourceID];
        require(handler != address(0), "no handler for resourceID");

        uint72 id = _nonceAndID(originChainID, depositNonce);
        bytes32 dataHash = keccak256(data);
        Proposal storage p = _proposalValue[id][dataHash];

        if (p.status == ProposalStatus.Active && p.yesVotes >= _relayerThresholdValue) {
            p.status = ProposalStatus.Passed;
        }

        require(
            p.resourceID == bytes32(0) || p.resourceID == resourceID,
            "data doesn't match datahash"
        );
        require(p.status == ProposalStatus.Passed, "proposal already passed/executed");

        p.status = ProposalStatus.Executed;
        p.resourceID = resourceID;
        p.data = data;

        IBridgeHandler(handler).executeProposal(resourceID, data);
    }

    function _depositInternal(
        uint8 destinationChainID,
        bytes32 resourceID,
        bytes memory data,
        address depositer
    ) internal {
        address handler = _resourceHandlerValue[resourceID];
        require(handler != address(0), "resourceID not mapped to handler");

        uint64 nonce = _depositCountValue[destinationChainID] + 1;
        _depositCountValue[destinationChainID] = nonce;

        uint72 id = _nonceAndID(destinationChainID, nonce);
        _depositRecordValue[id] = data;

        IBridgeHandler(handler).deposit(resourceID, destinationChainID, nonce, depositer, data);
        emit Deposit(destinationChainID, resourceID, nonce);
    }

    function _nonceAndID(uint8 chainID, uint64 nonce) internal pure returns (uint72) {
        return (uint72(nonce) << 8) | uint72(chainID);
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view {
        require(hasRole(role, account), "AccessControl: sender must be an admin");
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        RoleData storage r = _roles[role];
        if (!r.members[account]) {
            r.members[account] = true;
            r.memberList.push(account);
            r.indexPlusOne[account] = r.memberList.length;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        RoleData storage r = _roles[role];
        if (r.members[account]) {
            r.members[account] = false;

            uint256 idx = r.indexPlusOne[account];
            if (idx > 0) {
                uint256 i = idx - 1;
                uint256 last = r.memberList.length - 1;
                if (i != last) {
                    address moved = r.memberList[last];
                    r.memberList[i] = moved;
                    r.indexPlusOne[moved] = idx;
                }
                r.memberList.pop();
                delete r.indexPlusOne[account];
            }

            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract RPSGame {
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Paused(address account);

    event RPS_GameCreated(uint256 indexed gameId, address indexed creator, uint256 bet);
    event RPS_GameJoined(uint256 indexed gameId, address indexed creator, address indexed opponent, address referral);
    event RPS_GameUpdated(uint256 indexed gameId, address indexed player);
    event RPS_GameMovePlayed(uint256 indexed gameId, address indexed player);
    event RPS_GameOpponentMoved(uint256 indexed gameId, address indexed player);
    event RPS_GamePaused(uint256 indexed gameId);
    event RPS_GameUnpaused(uint256 indexed gameId, address indexed by);
    event RPS_GameFinished(uint256 indexed gameId);

    event RPS_RafflePlayed(address indexed winner, uint256 prize);
    event RPS_RafflePrizeWithdrawn(address indexed player, uint256 amount);
    event RPS_GamePrizesWithdrawn(address indexed player);
    event RPS_GameReferralWithdrawn(address indexed player);
    event RPS_PartnerFeeTransferred(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount);

    struct Game {
        uint256 id;
        address creator;
        address opponent;
        address winner;
        address referrer;
        address nextMover;
        uint256 bet;
        uint256 pot;
        uint256 createdAt;
        uint256 lastMoveAt;
        uint8 creatorMove;
        uint8 opponentMove;
        uint8 state; // 0 none, 1 open, 2 active, 4 finished, 5 cancelled
        bool onPause;
        bytes32 creatorMoveHash;
        bytes32 opponentMoveHash;
    }

    struct RaffleResult {
        address winner;
        uint256 prize;
        uint256 atTimestamp;
    }

    address private _owner;
    address private _partner;
    bool private _pausedGlobal;

    uint256 private _minBet = 0.001 ether;
    uint256 private _partnerFeeTransferThreshold = 0.1 ether;
    uint256 private _gameMoveDuration = 1 days;
    uint16 private _raffleActivationParticipantsAmount = 10;

    uint256 private _gamesCreatedAmount;
    uint256 private _gamesCompletedAmount;
    uint256 private _totalUsedInGame;
    uint256 private _totalUsedReferralFees;
    uint256 private _partnerFeePending;
    uint256 private _partnerFeeTotalUsed;
    uint256 private _devFeePending;
    uint256 private _ongoinRafflePrize;
    uint256 private _rafflePrizesWonTotal;

    mapping(uint256 => Game) private _gamesById;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _prizeForGameById;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _pendingGamePrizeForPlayer;
    mapping(uint256 => bytes32[]) private _creatorMoveHashesForGameById;

    mapping(address => uint256[]) private _playedGameIdxsForPlayerMap;
    mapping(address => uint256[]) private _gamesWithPendingPrizeWithdrawalForAddressMap;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap;

    mapping(address => uint256) private _addressPrizeTotalMap;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _addressBetTotalMap;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _referralFeesPendingMap;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _referralFeesWithdrawnMap;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _rafflePrizePendingForAddressMap;

    address[] private _raffleParticipantsList;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isRaffleParticipant;
    RaffleResult[] private _raffleResultsList;

    uint256[] private _topGamesList;
    mapping(uint256 => bool) private _isTopGameMap;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!_pausedGlobal, "paused");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        _partner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert();
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert();
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address payable to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount == 0) return;
        (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "transfer failed");
    }

    function _recordRaffleParticipant(address player) internal {
        if (!_isRaffleParticipant[player]) {
            _isRaffleParticipant[player] = true;
            _raffleParticipantsList.push(player);
        }
    }

    function _collectFees(uint256 amount, address referrer) internal returns (uint256 net) {
        uint256 partnerFee = amount / 100;
        uint256 devFee = amount / 100;
        uint256 raffleFee = amount / 100;
        uint256 referralFee = (referrer != address(0) && referrer != msg.sender) ? amount / 200 : 0;

        uint256 totalFee = partnerFee + devFee + raffleFee + referralFee;
        if (totalFee > amount) totalFee = amount;
        net = amount - totalFee;

        _partnerFeePending += partnerFee;
        _devFeePending += devFee;
        _ongoinRafflePrize += raffleFee;

        if (referralFee > 0) {
            _referralFeesPendingMap[referrer] += referralFee;
            _totalUsedReferralFees += referralFee;
        }

        _flushPartnerFeeIfNeeded();
    }

    function _flushPartnerFeeIfNeeded() internal {
        if (_partner == address(0)) return;
        if (_partnerFeeTransferThreshold == 0) return;
        if (_partnerFeePending < _partnerFeeTransferThreshold) return;

        uint256 amount = _partnerFeePending;
        _partnerFeePending = 0;
        _partnerFeeTotalUsed += amount;
        _safeTransfer(payable(_partner), amount);
        emit RPS_PartnerFeeTransferred(msg.sender, _partner, amount);
    }

    function _isGamePlayer(Game storage g, address p) internal view returns (bool) {
        return p == g.creator || p == g.opponent;
    }

    function _requireMove(uint8 move) internal pure {
        require(move >= 1 && move <= 3, "bad move");
    }

    function _setPendingPrize(uint256 gameId, address player, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (player == address(0) || amount == 0) return;
        if (_pendingGamePrizeForPlayer[gameId][player] == 0) {
            _gamesWithPendingPrizeWithdrawalForAddressMap[player].push(gameId);
        }
        _pendingGamePrizeForPlayer[gameId][player] += amount;
    }

    function _resolveGame(uint256 gameId) internal {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        if (g.state >= 4) return;
        if (g.creatorMove == 0 || g.opponentMove == 0) return;

        address winner_;
        uint256 pot = g.pot;

        if (g.creatorMove == g.opponentMove) {
            uint256 half = pot / 2;
            _setPendingPrize(gameId, g.creator, half);
            _setPendingPrize(gameId, g.opponent, pot - half);
        } else {
            bool creatorWins = (g.creatorMove == 1 && g.opponentMove == 3) ||
                (g.creatorMove == 2 && g.opponentMove == 1) ||
                (g.creatorMove == 3 && g.opponentMove == 2);
            winner_ = creatorWins ? g.creator : g.opponent;
            _setPendingPrize(gameId, winner_, pot);
        }

        g.winner = winner_;
        g.state = 4;
        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;
        _gamesCompletedAmount += 1;

        _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap[g.creator] = 0;
        if (g.opponent != address(0)) _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap[g.opponent] = 0;

        _playedGameIdxsForPlayerMap[g.creator].push(gameId);
        if (g.opponent != address(0)) _playedGameIdxsForPlayerMap[g.opponent].push(gameId);

        emit RPS_GameFinished(gameId);
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function partner() external view returns (address) {
        return _partner;
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _pausedGlobal;
    }

    function pause() external onlyOwner {
        _pausedGlobal = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "zero");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function kill() external onlyOwner {
        selfdestruct(payable(msg.sender));
    }

    function updatePartner(address newPartner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newPartner != address(0), "zero");
        _partner = newPartner;
    }

    function updatePartnerTransferThreshold(uint256 threshold) external onlyOwner {
        require(threshold > 0, "bad threshold");
        _partnerFeeTransferThreshold = threshold;
    }

    function updateMinBet(uint256 newMinBet) external onlyOwner {
        require(newMinBet > 0, "bad min");
        _minBet = newMinBet;
    }

    function updateGameMoveDuration(uint16 d) external onlyOwner {
        require(d > 0, "bad duration");
        _gameMoveDuration = uint256(d);
    }

    function updateRaffleActivationParticipantsCount(uint256 c) external onlyOwner {
        require(c > 0 && c <= type(uint16).max, "bad count");
        _raffleActivationParticipantsAmount = uint16(c);
    }

    function minBet() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _minBet;
    }

    function partnerFeeTransferThreshold() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _partnerFeeTransferThreshold;
    }

    function gameMoveDuration() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _gameMoveDuration;
    }

    function raffleActivationParticipantsAmount() external view returns (uint16) {
        return _raffleActivationParticipantsAmount;
    }

    function gamesCreatedAmount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _gamesCreatedAmount;
    }

    function gamesCompletedAmount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _gamesCompletedAmount;
    }

    function totalUsedInGame() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalUsedInGame;
    }

    function totalUsedReferralFees() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalUsedReferralFees;
    }

    function partnerFeePending() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _partnerFeePending;
    }

    function partnerFeeTotalUsed() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _partnerFeeTotalUsed;
    }

    function devFeePending() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _devFeePending;
    }

    function ongoinRafflePrize() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _ongoinRafflePrize;
    }

    function rafflePrizesWonTotal() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _rafflePrizesWonTotal;
    }

    function referralFeesPending(address a) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _referralFeesPendingMap[a];
    }

    function referralFeesWithdrawn(address a) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _referralFeesWithdrawnMap[a];
    }

    function rafflePrizePendingForAddress(address a) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _rafflePrizePendingForAddressMap[a];
    }

    function addressPrizeTotal(address a) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _addressPrizeTotalMap[a];
    }

    function addressBetTotal(address a) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _addressBetTotalMap[a];
    }

    function ongoingGameIdxForPlayer(address a) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap[a];
    }

    function prizeForGame(uint256 gameId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _prizeForGameById[gameId];
    }

    function gameOnPause(uint256 gameId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _gamesById[gameId].onPause;
    }

    function games(uint256 gameId) external view returns (Game memory) {
        return _gamesById[gameId];
    }

    function gameWithdrawalInfo(uint256 gameId) external view returns (bool creatorCanWithdraw, bool opponentCanWithdraw, bool finished) {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        creatorCanWithdraw = _pendingGamePrizeForPlayer[gameId][g.creator] > 0;
        opponentCanWithdraw = _pendingGamePrizeForPlayer[gameId][g.opponent] > 0;
        finished = g.state >= 4;
    }

    function gameMoveExpired(uint256 gameId) public view returns (bool) {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        if (g.onPause) return false;
        if (g.state == 0 || g.state >= 4) return false;
        if (g.lastMoveAt == 0) return false;
        return block.timestamp > g.lastMoveAt + _gameMoveDuration;
    }

    function getCreatorMoveHashesForGame(uint256 gameId) external view returns (bytes32[] memory) {
        return _creatorMoveHashesForGameById[gameId];
    }

    function createGame(address referrer, bytes32 creatorMoveHash) external payable whenNotPaused returns (uint256 gameId) {
        require(msg.value >= _minBet, "fee");
        _gamesCreatedAmount += 1;
        gameId = _gamesCreatedAmount;

        uint256 net = _collectFees(msg.value, referrer);

        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        g.id = gameId;
        g.creator = msg.sender;
        g.referrer = referrer;
        g.bet = msg.value;
        g.pot = net;
        g.createdAt = block.timestamp;
        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;
        g.state = 1;
        g.creatorMoveHash = creatorMoveHash;
        g.nextMover = msg.sender;

        _prizeForGameById[gameId] = g.pot;
        _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap[msg.sender] = gameId;
        _addressBetTotalMap[msg.sender] += msg.value;
        _totalUsedInGame += msg.value;
        _creatorMoveHashesForGameById[gameId].push(creatorMoveHash);

        _recordRaffleParticipant(msg.sender);

        emit RPS_GameCreated(gameId, msg.sender, msg.value);
    }

    function joinGame(uint256 gameId, address referrer, uint8 move) external payable whenNotPaused {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        require(g.state == 1, "state");
        require(g.creator != address(0), "missing");
        require(g.opponent == address(0), "joined");
        require(msg.value == g.bet, "fee");

        _requireMove(move);

        uint256 net = _collectFees(msg.value, referrer);

        g.opponent = msg.sender;
        g.opponentMove = move;
        g.referrer = g.referrer == address(0) ? referrer : g.referrer;
        g.pot += net;
        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;
        g.state = 2;
        g.nextMover = g.creator;

        _prizeForGameById[gameId] = g.pot;
        _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap[msg.sender] = gameId;
        _addressBetTotalMap[msg.sender] += msg.value;
        _totalUsedInGame += msg.value;

        _recordRaffleParticipant(msg.sender);
        _recordRaffleParticipant(g.creator);

        emit RPS_GameJoined(gameId, g.creator, msg.sender, g.referrer);
        emit RPS_GameOpponentMoved(gameId, msg.sender);
    }

    function playMove(uint256 gameId, uint8 move, bytes32 salt, bytes32 expectedHash) external whenNotPaused {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        require(g.state == 2 || g.state == 1, "state");
        require(_isGamePlayer(g, msg.sender), "player");
        _requireMove(move);

        if (msg.sender == g.creator) {
            if (g.creatorMoveHash != bytes32(0)) {
                if (expectedHash != bytes32(0)) require(expectedHash == g.creatorMoveHash, "hash");
                require(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(move, salt)) == g.creatorMoveHash, "reveal");
            }
            g.creatorMove = move;
            g.nextMover = g.opponent;
        } else {
            g.opponentMove = move;
            g.nextMover = g.creator;
        }

        if (expectedHash != bytes32(0)) {
            _creatorMoveHashesForGameById[gameId].push(expectedHash);
        }

        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;
        if (g.state == 1 && g.opponent != address(0)) g.state = 2;

        emit RPS_GameMovePlayed(gameId, msg.sender);
        _resolveGame(gameId);
    }

    function opponentNextMove(uint256 gameId, uint8 move) external whenNotPaused {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        require(g.state == 2, "state");
        require(msg.sender == g.opponent, "opp");
        _requireMove(move);

        g.opponentMove = move;
        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;
        g.nextMover = g.creator;

        emit RPS_GameOpponentMoved(gameId, msg.sender);
        _resolveGame(gameId);
    }

    function increaseBetForGameBy(uint256 gameId) external payable whenNotPaused {
        require(msg.value > 0, "value");
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        require(_isGamePlayer(g, msg.sender), "player");
        require(g.state > 0 && g.state < 4, "state");

        uint256 net = _collectFees(msg.value, g.referrer);

        g.pot += net;
        g.bet += msg.value;
        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;

        _prizeForGameById[gameId] = g.pot;
        _addressBetTotalMap[msg.sender] += msg.value;
        _totalUsedInGame += msg.value;

        emit RPS_GameUpdated(gameId, msg.sender);
    }

    function finishExpiredGame(uint256 gameId) external {
        require(gameMoveExpired(gameId), "not expired");
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        require(g.state > 0 && g.state < 4, "state");

        address winner_ = g.creator;
        if (g.creatorMove == 0 && g.opponentMove != 0) winner_ = g.opponent;
        if (g.creatorMove != 0 && g.opponentMove == 0) winner_ = g.creator;

        _setPendingPrize(gameId, winner_, g.pot);
        g.winner = winner_;
        g.state = 4;
        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;
        _gamesCompletedAmount += 1;

        _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap[g.creator] = 0;
        if (g.opponent != address(0)) _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap[g.opponent] = 0;

        _playedGameIdxsForPlayerMap[g.creator].push(gameId);
        if (g.opponent != address(0)) _playedGameIdxsForPlayerMap[g.opponent].push(gameId);

        emit RPS_GameFinished(gameId);
    }

    function quitGame(uint256 gameId) external {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        require(msg.sender == g.creator, "creator");
        require(g.state == 1, "state");
        require(g.opponent == address(0), "joined");

        uint256 refund = g.pot;
        g.pot = 0;
        g.state = 5;
        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;
        _ongoingGameIdxForPlayerMap[g.creator] = 0;

        emit RPS_GameFinished(gameId);
        _safeTransfer(payable(msg.sender), refund);
    }

    function pauseGame(uint256 gameId) external {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        require(_isGamePlayer(g, msg.sender), "player");
        require(g.state > 0 && g.state < 4, "state");
        g.onPause = true;
        emit RPS_GamePaused(gameId);
    }

    function unpauseGame(uint256 gameId) external payable {
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        require(_isGamePlayer(g, msg.sender), "player");
        g.onPause = false;
        g.lastMoveAt = block.timestamp;

        if (msg.value > 0) {
            uint256 net = _collectFees(msg.value, g.referrer);
            g.pot += net;
            g.bet += msg.value;
            _prizeForGameById[gameId] = g.pot;
            _addressBetTotalMap[msg.sender] += msg.value;
            _totalUsedInGame += msg.value;
        }

        emit RPS_GameUnpaused(gameId, msg.sender);
    }

    function withdrawGamePrizes(uint256 gameId) external {
        uint256 amount = _pendingGamePrizeForPlayer[gameId][msg.sender];
        require(amount > 0, "none");
        _pendingGamePrizeForPlayer[gameId][msg.sender] = 0;

        _addressPrizeTotalMap[msg.sender] += amount;
        _safeTransfer(payable(msg.sender), amount);
        emit RPS_GamePrizesWithdrawn(msg.sender);
    }

    function withdrawReferralFees() external {
        uint256 amount = _referralFeesPendingMap[msg.sender];
        require(amount > 0, "none");
        _referralFeesPendingMap[msg.sender] = 0;
        _referralFeesWithdrawnMap[msg.sender] += amount;
        _safeTransfer(payable(msg.sender), amount);
        emit RPS_GameReferralWithdrawn(msg.sender);
    }

    function withdrawRafflePrizes() external {
        uint256 amount = _rafflePrizePendingForAddressMap[msg.sender];
        require(amount > 0, "none");
        _rafflePrizePendingForAddressMap[msg.sender] = 0;
        _rafflePrizesWonTotal += amount;
        _addressPrizeTotalMap[msg.sender] += amount;
        _safeTransfer(payable(msg.sender), amount);
        emit RPS_RafflePrizeWithdrawn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function withdrawDevFee() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 amount = _devFeePending;
        require(amount > 0, "none");
        _devFeePending = 0;
        _safeTransfer(payable(msg.sender), amount);
    }

    function raffleActivated() public view returns (bool) {
        return _raffleParticipantsList.length > 0 &&
            _raffleParticipantsList.length >= _raffleActivationParticipantsAmount &&
            _ongoinRafflePrize > 0;
    }

    function rand() public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_raffleParticipantsList.length == 0) return 0;
        return uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.prevrandao, _raffleParticipantsList.length, _gamesCreatedAmount)));
    }

    function runRaffle() external {
        require(raffleActivated(), "not active");
        uint256 idx = rand() % _raffleParticipantsList.length;
        address winner_ = _raffleParticipantsList[idx];
        uint256 prize = _ongoinRafflePrize;

        _ongoinRafflePrize = 0;
        _rafflePrizePendingForAddressMap[winner_] += prize;
        _raffleResultsList.push(RaffleResult({winner: winner_, prize: prize, atTimestamp: block.timestamp}));

        emit RPS_RafflePlayed(winner_, prize);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _raffleParticipantsList.length; i++) {
            _isRaffleParticipant[_raffleParticipantsList[i]] = false;
        }
        delete _raffleParticipantsList;
    }

    function raffleParticipants(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        require(index < _raffleParticipantsList.length, "oob");
        return _raffleParticipantsList[index];
    }

    function getRaffleParticipants() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return _raffleParticipantsList;
    }

    function raffleResults(uint256 index) external view returns (address winner, uint256 prize, uint256 atTimestamp) {
        require(index < _raffleResultsList.length, "oob");
        RaffleResult storage r = _raffleResultsList[index];
        return (r.winner, r.prize, r.atTimestamp);
    }

    function getRaffleResultCount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _raffleResultsList.length;
    }

    function addTopGame(uint256 gameId) external payable onlyOwner {
        if (_isTopGameMap[gameId]) return;

        if (_topGamesList.length < 5) {
            _topGamesList.push(gameId);
            _isTopGameMap[gameId] = true;
            return;
        }

        uint256 minIdx = 0;
        uint256 minPrize = _prizeForGameById[_topGamesList[0]];
        for (uint256 i = 1; i < _topGamesList.length; i++) {
            uint256 p = _prizeForGameById[_topGamesList[i]];

                minPrize = p;
                minIdx = i;
            }
        }

            _isTopGameMap[_topGamesList[minIdx]] = false;
            _topGamesList[minIdx] = gameId;
            _isTopGameMap[gameId] = true;
        }
    }

        uint256 n = _topGamesList.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (_topGamesList[i] == gameId) {
                _topGamesList[i] = _topGamesList[n - 1];
                _topGamesList.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
        _isTopGameMap[gameId] = false;
    }

    function isTopGame(uint256 gameId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isTopGameMap[gameId];
    }

    function topGames(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _topGamesList.length, "oob");
        return _topGamesList[index];
    }

    function getTopGames() external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _topGamesList;
    }

    function gamesWithPendingPrizeWithdrawalForAddress(address player, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _gamesWithPendingPrizeWithdrawalForAddressMap[player].length, "oob");
        return _gamesWithPendingPrizeWithdrawalForAddressMap[player][index];
    }

    function getGamesWithPendingPrizeWithdrawalForAddress(address player) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _gamesWithPendingPrizeWithdrawalForAddressMap[player];
    }

    function getPlayedGameIdxsForPlayer(address player) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _playedGameIdxsForPlayerMap[player];
    }

    function showRowMoves(uint256 gameId, uint8 row) external view returns (bool) {
        if (row < 1 || row > 3) return false;
        Game storage g = _gamesById[gameId];
        return g.creatorMove == row || g.opponentMove == row;
    }

pragma experimental ABIEncoderV2;

struct ChainBatchHeader {
    uint256 batchIndex;
    bytes32 batchRoot;
    uint256 batchSize;
    uint256 prevTotalElements;
    bytes extraData;
}

struct ChainInclusionProof {
    uint256 index;
    bytes32[] siblings;
}

struct RelayMessageProof {
    bytes32 stateRoot;
    ChainBatchHeader stateRootBatchHeader;
    ChainInclusionProof stateRootProof;
    bytes transaction;
    bytes witness;
}

interface IAddressManager {
    function getAddress(string calldata _name) external view returns (address);
}

interface ICanonicalTransactionChain {
    function getQueueLength() external view returns (uint40);
    function getQueueElement(uint256 _index) external view returns (uint40, uint40, bytes32);
    function enqueue(address _target, uint256 _gasLimit, bytes calldata _data) external;
}

interface IStateCommitmentChain {
    function insideFraudProofWindow(ChainBatchHeader calldata _batchHeader) external view returns (bool);
    function verifyStateCommitment(
        bytes32 _stateRoot,
        ChainBatchHeader calldata _batchHeader,
        ChainInclusionProof calldata _proof
    ) external view returns (bool);
}

contract L1CrossDomainMessenger {
    address public libAddressManager;
    address public owner;
    bool public paused;

    mapping(bytes32 => bool) public blockedMessages;
    mapping(bytes32 => bool) public relayedMessages;
    mapping(bytes32 => bool) public successfulMessages;

    address private _xDomainMessageSender;
    bool private _initialized;
    uint256 private _status;

    uint256 private constant _NOT_ENTERED = 1;
    uint256 private constant _ENTERED = 2;
    address private constant DEAD_ADDRESS = address(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD);
    bytes4 private constant RELAY_MESSAGE_SELECTOR = 0xcbd4ece9;

    event SentMessage(bytes message);
    event RelayedMessage(bytes32 msgHash);
    event FailedRelayedMessage(bytes32 msgHash);
    event MessageBlocked(bytes32 indexed msgHash);
    event MessageAllowed(bytes32 indexed msgHash);
    event Paused(address account);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_status != _ENTERED, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _status = _ENTERED;
        _;
        _status = _NOT_ENTERED;
    }

    function initialize(address _libAddressManager) external {
        require(!_initialized, "Initializable: contract is already initialized.");
        require(owner == address(0), "L1CrossDomainMessenger already initialized.");
        _initialized = true;

        libAddressManager = _libAddressManager;
        _xDomainMessageSender = DEAD_ADDRESS;
        _status = _NOT_ENTERED;
        paused = false;

        owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    function resolve(string memory _name) public view returns (address) {
        return IAddressManager(libAddressManager).getAddress(_name);
    }

    function xDomainMessageSender() external view returns (address) {
        require(_xDomainMessageSender != DEAD_ADDRESS, "xDomainMessageSender is not set");
        return _xDomainMessageSender;
    }

    function sendMessage(
        address _target,
        bytes memory _message,
        uint32 _gasLimit
    ) external {
        address ctcAddress = resolve("OVM_CanonicalTransactionChain");
        address l2Messenger = resolve("OVM_L2CrossDomainMessenger");
        ICanonicalTransactionChain ctc = ICanonicalTransactionChain(ctcAddress);

        uint256 nonce = uint256(ctc.getQueueLength());
        bytes memory xDomainCalldata = _encodeXDomainCalldata(_target, msg.sender, _message, nonce);

        ctc.enqueue(l2Messenger, uint256(_gasLimit), xDomainCalldata);
        emit SentMessage(xDomainCalldata);
    }

    function replayMessage(
        address _target,
        address _sender,
        bytes memory _message,
        uint256 _messageNonce,
        uint32 _gasLimit

            _walletActivated[wallet] = true;
            _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] += 1;
            emit WalletActivated(wallet, operator_);
        }
    }

    function _deactivateWalletInternal(address wallet, address operator_) internal {
        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        if (wallet == address(0) || userId == 0) return;

        if (_walletActivated[wallet]) {
            _walletActivated[wallet] = false;
            if (_activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] > 0) {
                _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] -= 1;
            }
            emit WalletDeactivated(wallet, operator_);
        }

        if (_activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] == 0 && _investorEnlisted[wallet]) {
            _delistInvestorInternal(wallet);
        }
    }

    function _enlistInvestorInternal(address wallet) internal {
        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        if (userId == 0) revert InvalidWallet();
        if (_investorEnlisted[wallet]) return;

        uint256 jurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[userId];

        if (_maxInvestors != 0) {
            require(_currentInvestors + 1 <= _maxInvestors, "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS");
        }

        uint256 maxByJ = _maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction];
        if (maxByJ != 0) {
            require(
                _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] + 1 <= maxByJ,
                "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS_BY_JURISDICTION"
            );
        }

        _investorEnlisted[wallet] = true;
        _currentInvestors += 1;
        _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] += 1;

        emit InvestorEnlisted(wallet, userId);
    }

    function _delistInvestorInternal(address wallet) internal {
        if (!_investorEnlisted[wallet]) return;

        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        uint256 jurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[userId];

        _investorEnlisted[wallet] = false;
        if (_currentInvestors > 0) _currentInvestors -= 1;
        if (_currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] > 0) {
            _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] -= 1;
        }

        emit InvestorDelisted(wallet, userId);
    }

    function _balanceOf(address account) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_callingContract == address(0)) return type(uint256).max;
        try IERC20Like(_callingContract).balanceOf(account) returns (uint256 bal) {
            return bal;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert();
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert();
    }
}
