pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IAddressResolver {
    function getAddress(bytes32 name) external view returns (address);
    function requireAndGetAddress(bytes32 name, string calldata reason) external view returns (address);
}

interface IFlexibleStorage {
    function getUIntValue(bytes32 contractName, bytes32 record) external view returns (uint256);
    function getAddressValue(bytes32 contractName, bytes32 record) external view returns (address);
}

interface IAggregatorV2V3 {
    function latestRound() external view returns (uint256);
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
    function latestRoundData() external view returns (uint80, int256, uint256, uint256, uint80);
    function getRoundData(uint80 roundId) external view returns (uint80, int256, uint256, uint256, uint80);
}

interface IAggregatorWarningFlags {
    function getFlag(address aggregator) external view returns (bool);
    function getFlags(address[] calldata aggregators) external view returns (bool[] memory);
}

interface IExchanger {
    function setLastExchangeRateForSynth(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rate) external;
}

contract ExchangeRates {
    uint256 private constant UNIT = 1e18;
    uint256 private constant ORACLE_FUTURE_LIMIT = 600;
    uint256 private constant DEFAULT_RATE_STALE_PERIOD = 3 hours;

    bytes32 private constant SUSD = "sUSD";
    bytes32 private constant CONTRACT_FLEXIBLE_STORAGE = "FlexibleStorage";
    bytes32 private constant CONTRACT_EXCHANGER = "Exchanger";
    bytes32 private constant CONTRACT_SYSTEM_SETTINGS = "SystemSettings";
    bytes32 private constant SETTING_RATE_STALE_PERIOD = "rateStalePeriod";
    bytes32 private constant SETTING_AGGREGATOR_WARNING_FLAGS = "aggregatorWarningFlags";

    event OwnerNominated(address newOwner);
    event OwnerChanged(address oldOwner, address newOwner);
    event OracleUpdated(address oracle);
    event AggregatorAdded(bytes32 currencyKey, address aggregator);
    event AggregatorRemoved(bytes32 currencyKey, address aggregator);
    event RateDeleted(bytes32 currencyKey);
    event InversePriceConfigured(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 entryPoint, uint256 upperLimit, uint256 lowerLimit);
    event InversePriceFrozen(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rate, uint256 frozenRate, address caller);
    event RatesUpdated(bytes32[] currencyKeys, uint256[] newRates);
    event CacheUpdated(bytes32 name, address destination);

    struct RoundData {
        uint256 rate;
        uint256 time;
    }

    struct InversePricingData {
        uint256 entryPoint;
        uint256 upperLimit;
        uint256 lowerLimit;
        bool frozen;
        bool frozenAtUpperLimit;
    }

    address public owner;
    address public nominatedOwner;

    address private _oracle;
    IAddressResolver private _resolver;

    mapping(bytes32 => address) public addressCache;

    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private _rates;
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private _lastRateUpdateTimes;
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private _currentRoundForRate;
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(uint256 => RoundData)) private _roundData;

    mapping(bytes32 => address) private _aggregators;
    mapping(address => bytes32[]) private _currenciesUsingAggregator;
    bytes32[] private _aggregatorKeys;
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private _aggregatorKeyIndexPlusOne;
    mapping(bytes32 => uint8) private _currencyKeyDecimals;

    mapping(bytes32 => InversePricingData) private _inversePricing;
    bytes32[] private _invertedKeys;
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private _invertedKeyIndexPlusOne;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only the contract owner may perform this action");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOracle() {
        require(msg.sender == _oracle, "Only the oracle can perform this action");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address resolver_, address oracle_) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        _oracle = oracle_ == address(0) ? msg.sender : oracle_;
        _resolver = IAddressResolver(resolver_);

        _setRate(SUSD, UNIT, block.timestamp);
        _rebuildCacheInternal();
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        require(msg.value == 0, "No ETH");
        bytes4 sig;
        assembly {
            sig := shr(224, calldataload(0))
        }

        if (sig == 0x009919c0) {
            require(msg.data.length >= 36, "Bad calldata");
            bytes32 key;
            assembly {
                key := calldataload(4)
            }
            bool stale = rateIsStale(key);
            assembly {
                mstore(0x00, stale)
                return(0x00, 0x20)
            }
        }

        revert("Invalid selector");
    }

    function resolver() external view returns (address) {
        return address(_resolver);
    }

    function oracle() external view returns (address) {
        return _oracle;
    }

    function setOracle(address newOracle) external onlyOwner {
        _oracle = newOracle;
        emit OracleUpdated(newOracle);
    }

    function nominateNewOwner(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        nominatedOwner = newOwner;
        emit OwnerNominated(newOwner);
    }

    function acceptOwnership() external {
        require(msg.sender == nominatedOwner, "You must be nominated before you can accept ownership");
        emit OwnerChanged(owner, nominatedOwner);
        owner = nominatedOwner;
        nominatedOwner = address(0);
    }

    function resolverAddressesRequired() public pure returns (bytes32[] memory required) {
        required = new bytes32[](2);
        required[0] = CONTRACT_FLEXIBLE_STORAGE;
        required[1] = CONTRACT_EXCHANGER;
    }

    function isResolverCached() public view returns (bool) {
        if (address(_resolver) == address(0)) return false;
        bytes32[] memory required = resolverAddressesRequired();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
            address destination;
            try _resolver.getAddress(required[i]) returns (address found) {
                destination = found;
            } catch {
                return false;
            }
            if (destination == address(0) || addressCache[required[i]] != destination) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    function rebuildCache() external {
        _rebuildCacheInternal();
    }

    function _rebuildCacheInternal() internal {
        if (address(_resolver) == address(0)) return;
        bytes32[] memory required = resolverAddressesRequired();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
            try _resolver.requireAndGetAddress(required[i], "Resolver missing target") returns (address found) {
                addressCache[required[i]] = found;
                emit CacheUpdated(required[i], found);
            } catch {}
        }
    }

    function rateStalePeriod() public view returns (uint256) {
        IFlexibleStorage fs = _flexibleStorage();
        if (address(fs) == address(0)) return DEFAULT_RATE_STALE_PERIOD;
        try fs.getUIntValue(CONTRACT_SYSTEM_SETTINGS, SETTING_RATE_STALE_PERIOD) returns (uint256 period) {
            return period == 0 ? DEFAULT_RATE_STALE_PERIOD : period;
        } catch {
            return DEFAULT_RATE_STALE_PERIOD;
        }
    }

    function aggregatorWarningFlags() public view returns (address) {
        IFlexibleStorage fs = _flexibleStorage();
        if (address(fs) == address(0)) return address(0);
        try fs.getAddressValue(CONTRACT_SYSTEM_SETTINGS, SETTING_AGGREGATOR_WARNING_FLAGS) returns (address flags) {
            return flags;
        } catch {
            return address(0);
        }
    }

    function addAggregator(bytes32 currencyKey, address aggregator) external onlyOwner {
        require(aggregator != address(0), "Given Aggregator is invalid");

        uint256 lr;
        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).latestRound() returns (uint256 r) {
            lr = r;
        } catch {
            revert("Given Aggregator is invalid");
        }
        require(lr > 0, "Given Aggregator is invalid");

        uint8 dec;
        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).decimals() returns (uint8 d) {
            dec = d;
        } catch {
            revert("Given Aggregator is invalid");
        }
        require(dec <= 18, "Aggregator decimals should be lower or equal to 18");

        address old = _aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (old != address(0)) {
            _removeCurrencyFromAggregator(old, currencyKey);
        }

        _aggregators[currencyKey] = aggregator;
        _currencyKeyDecimals[currencyKey] = dec;

        if (_aggregatorKeyIndexPlusOne[currencyKey] == 0) {
            _aggregatorKeys.push(currencyKey);
            _aggregatorKeyIndexPlusOne[currencyKey] = _aggregatorKeys.length;
        }

        _addCurrencyToAggregator(aggregator, currencyKey);
        emit AggregatorAdded(currencyKey, aggregator);
    }

    function removeAggregator(bytes32 currencyKey) external onlyOwner {
        address existing = _aggregators[currencyKey];
        require(existing != address(0), "No aggregator exists for key");

        delete _aggregators[currencyKey];
        delete _currencyKeyDecimals[currencyKey];

        _removeCurrencyFromAggregator(existing, currencyKey);
        _removeFromIndexedArray(_aggregatorKeys, _aggregatorKeyIndexPlusOne, currencyKey);

        emit AggregatorRemoved(currencyKey, existing);
    }

    function aggregators(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (address) {
        return _aggregators[currencyKey];
    }

    function aggregatorKeys(uint256 index) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _aggregatorKeys[index];
    }

    function currenciesUsingAggregator(address aggregator) external view returns (bytes32[] memory) {
        return _currenciesUsingAggregator[aggregator];
    }

    function setInversePricing(
        bytes32 currencyKey,
        uint256 entryPoint,
        uint256 upperLimit,
        uint256 lowerLimit,
        bool freezeAtUpperLimit,
        bool freezeAtLowerLimit
    ) external onlyOwner {
        require(lowerLimit > 0, "lowerLimit must be above 0");
        require(upperLimit > lowerLimit, "upperLimit must be above lowerLimit");
        require(lowerLimit < entryPoint, "lowerLimit must be below entryPoint");
        require(upperLimit < entryPoint * 2, "upperLimit must be less than double entryPoint");
        require(!(freezeAtUpperLimit && freezeAtLowerLimit), "Cannot freeze at both limits");

        if (_invertedKeyIndexPlusOne[currencyKey] == 0) {
            _invertedKeys.push(currencyKey);
            _invertedKeyIndexPlusOne[currencyKey] = _invertedKeys.length;
        }

        InversePricingData storage inv = _inversePricing[currencyKey];
        inv.entryPoint = entryPoint;
        inv.upperLimit = upperLimit;
        inv.lowerLimit = lowerLimit;
        inv.frozen = false;
        inv.frozenAtUpperLimit = false;

        if (freezeAtUpperLimit || freezeAtLowerLimit) {
            inv.frozen = true;
            inv.frozenAtUpperLimit = freezeAtUpperLimit;
            uint256 frozenRate = freezeAtUpperLimit ? upperLimit : lowerLimit;
            _setRate(currencyKey, frozenRate, block.timestamp);
            _notifyExchanger(currencyKey, frozenRate);
            emit InversePriceFrozen(currencyKey, frozenRate, frozenRate, msg.sender);
        }

        emit InversePriceConfigured(currencyKey, entryPoint, upperLimit, lowerLimit);
    }

    function removeInversePricing(bytes32 currencyKey) external onlyOwner {
        require(_inversePricing[currencyKey].entryPoint != 0, "No inverted price exists");
        delete _inversePricing[currencyKey];
        _removeFromIndexedArray(_invertedKeys, _invertedKeyIndexPlusOne, currencyKey);
        emit InversePriceConfigured(currencyKey, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    function inversePricing(bytes32 currencyKey)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 entryPoint,
            uint256 upperLimit,
            uint256 lowerLimit,
            bool frozen,
            bool frozenAtUpperLimit
        )
    {
        InversePricingData storage inv = _inversePricing[currencyKey];
        return (inv.entryPoint, inv.upperLimit, inv.lowerLimit, inv.frozen, inv.frozenAtUpperLimit);
    }

    function invertedKeys(uint256 index) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _invertedKeys[index];
    }

    function updateRates(
        bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys,
        uint256[] calldata newRates,
        uint256 timeSent
    ) external onlyOracle {
        require(currencyKeys.length == newRates.length, "Currency key array length must match rates array length");
        require(timeSent <= block.timestamp + ORACLE_FUTURE_LIMIT, "Time is too far into the future");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            bytes32 key = currencyKeys[i];
            uint256 rate = newRates[i];
            require(rate != 0, "Rate is zero");
            require(key != SUSD, "sUSD cannot be manually updated");

            uint256 finalRate = _applyInversePricingAndUpdateState(key, rate);
            _setRate(key, finalRate, timeSent);
        }

        emit RatesUpdated(currencyKeys, newRates);
    }

    function deleteRate(bytes32 currencyKey) external onlyOracle {
        require(rateForCurrency(currencyKey) > 0, "Rate is zero");
        _setRate(currencyKey, 0, block.timestamp);
        emit RateDeleted(currencyKey);
    }

    function freezeRate(bytes32 currencyKey) external {
        require(canFreezeRate(currencyKey), "Rate within bounds");
        InversePricingData storage inv = _inversePricing[currencyKey];
        uint256 currentRate = rateForCurrency(currencyKey);
        uint256 frozenRate;

        if (currentRate >= inv.upperLimit) {
            inv.frozenAtUpperLimit = true;
            frozenRate = inv.upperLimit;
        } else {
            inv.frozenAtUpperLimit = false;
            frozenRate = inv.lowerLimit;
        }

        inv.frozen = true;
        _setRate(currencyKey, frozenRate, block.timestamp);
        _notifyExchanger(currencyKey, frozenRate);
        emit InversePriceFrozen(currencyKey, currentRate, frozenRate, msg.sender);
    }

    function canFreezeRate(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (bool) {
        InversePricingData storage inv = _inversePricing[currencyKey];
        if (inv.entryPoint == 0 || inv.frozen) return false;
        uint256 current = rateForCurrency(currencyKey);
        return current >= inv.upperLimit || current <= inv.lowerLimit;
    }

    function roundFrozen(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (bool) {
        return _inversePricing[currencyKey].frozen;
    }

    function rateIsFrozen(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (bool) {
        return _inversePricing[currencyKey].frozen;
    }

    function currencyKeyDecimals(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint8) {
        return _getCurrencyDecimals(currencyKey, _aggregators[currencyKey]);
    }

    function currentRoundForRate(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _currentRoundForRate[currencyKey];
    }

    function getCurrentRoundId(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint256) {
        address agg = _aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (agg == address(0)) return _currentRoundForRate[currencyKey];

        try IAggregatorV2V3(agg).latestRound() returns (uint256 rid) {
            return rid;
        } catch {
            (, , uint256 rid2) = _latestAggregatorData(currencyKey, agg);
            return rid2;
        }
    }

    function rateForCurrency(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (currencyKey == SUSD) return UNIT;

        address agg = _aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (agg != address(0)) {
            (uint256 rate,,) = _latestAggregatorData(currencyKey, agg);
            return _applyInversePricingView(currencyKey, rate);
        }

        return _rates[currencyKey];
    }

    function ratesForCurrencies(bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys) external view returns (uint256[] memory rates) {
        rates = new uint256[](currencyKeys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            rates[i] = rateForCurrency(currencyKeys[i]);
        }
    }

    function lastRateUpdateTimes(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (uint256) {
        address agg = _aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (agg == address(0)) return _lastRateUpdateTimes[currencyKey];
        (, uint256 updatedAt,) = _latestAggregatorData(currencyKey, agg);
        return updatedAt;
    }

    function lastRateUpdateTimesForCurrencies(bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256[] memory times)
    {
        times = new uint256[](currencyKeys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            times[i] = lastRateUpdateTimes(currencyKeys[i]);
        }
    }

    function rateAndUpdatedTime(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (uint256 rate, uint256 time) {
        return _rateAndUpdatedTime(currencyKey);
    }

    function rateAndTimestampAtRound(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 roundId)
        public
        view
        returns (uint256 rate, uint256 time)
    {
        if (currencyKey == SUSD) {
            return (UNIT, _lastRateUpdateTimes[SUSD]);
        }

        address agg = _aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (agg != address(0)) {
            return _roundDataFromAggregator(currencyKey, agg, roundId);
        }

        RoundData storage r = _roundData[currencyKey][roundId];
        return (r.rate, r.time);
    }

    function ratesAndUpdatedTimeForCurrencyLastNRounds(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 numRounds)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256[] memory rates, uint256[] memory times)
    {
        rates = new uint256[](numRounds);
        times = new uint256[](numRounds);

        uint256 current = getCurrentRoundId(currencyKey);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < numRounds; i++) {
            if (current <= i) break;
            uint256 roundId = current - i;
            (rates[i], times[i]) = rateAndTimestampAtRound(currencyKey, roundId);
        }
    }

    function getLastRoundIdBeforeElapsedSecs(
        bytes32 currencyKey,
        uint256 startingRoundId,
        uint256 startingTimestamp,
        uint256 timediff
    ) external view returns (uint256) {
        if (startingRoundId == 0) {
            startingRoundId = getCurrentRoundId(currencyKey);
        }

        uint256 target = startingTimestamp > timediff ? startingTimestamp - timediff : 0;
        uint256 roundId = startingRoundId;

        while (roundId > 0) {
            (, uint256 ts) = rateAndTimestampAtRound(currencyKey, roundId);
            if (ts == 0 || ts <= target) return roundId;
            unchecked {
                roundId--;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    function rateIsStale(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (bool) {
        if (currencyKey == SUSD) return false;
        uint256 updateTime = lastRateUpdateTimes(currencyKey);
        if (updateTime == 0) return true;
        return block.timestamp > updateTime + rateStalePeriod();
    }

    function rateIsFlagged(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (bool) {
        address flags = aggregatorWarningFlags();
        if (flags == address(0)) return false;

        address agg = _aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (agg == address(0)) return false;

        try IAggregatorWarningFlags(flags).getFlag(agg) returns (bool flagged) {
            return flagged;
        } catch {
            return false;
        }
    }

    function rateIsInvalid(bytes32 currencyKey) public view returns (bool) {
        if (currencyKey == SUSD) return false;
        uint256 rate = rateForCurrency(currencyKey);
        return rate == 0 || rateIsStale(currencyKey) || rateIsFlagged(currencyKey);
    }

    function anyRateIsInvalid(bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys) external view returns (bool) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            if (rateIsInvalid(currencyKeys[i])) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function rateAndInvalid(bytes32 currencyKey) external view returns (uint256 rate, bool invalid) {
        rate = rateForCurrency(currencyKey);
        invalid = rateIsInvalid(currencyKey);
    }

    function ratesAndInvalidForCurrencies(bytes32[] calldata currencyKeys)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256[] memory rates, bool anyInvalid)
    {
        rates = new uint256[](currencyKeys.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < currencyKeys.length; i++) {
            rates[i] = rateForCurrency(currencyKeys[i]);
            if (rateIsInvalid(currencyKeys[i])) anyInvalid = true;
        }
    }

    function effectiveValue(bytes32 sourceCurrencyKey, uint256 sourceAmount, bytes32 destinationCurrencyKey)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256)
    {
        return _effectiveValue(sourceCurrencyKey, sourceAmount, destinationCurrencyKey);
    }

    function effectiveValueAndRates(bytes32 sourceCurrencyKey, uint256 sourceAmount, bytes32 destinationCurrencyKey)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256 value, uint256 sourceRate, uint256 destinationRate)
    {
        sourceRate = rateForCurrency(sourceCurrencyKey);
        destinationRate = rateForCurrency(destinationCurrencyKey);
        value = destinationRate == 0 ? 0 : (sourceAmount * sourceRate) / destinationRate;
    }

    function effectiveValueAtRound(
        bytes32 sourceCurrencyKey,
        uint256 sourceAmount,
        bytes32 destinationCurrencyKey,
        uint256 sourceRoundId,
        uint256 destinationRoundId
    ) external view returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 sourceRate,) = rateAndTimestampAtRound(sourceCurrencyKey, sourceRoundId);
        (uint256 destinationRate,) = rateAndTimestampAtRound(destinationCurrencyKey, destinationRoundId);
        if (destinationRate == 0) return 0;
        return (sourceAmount * sourceRate) / destinationRate;
    }

    function _effectiveValue(bytes32 sourceCurrencyKey, uint256 sourceAmount, bytes32 destinationCurrencyKey)
        internal
        view
        returns (uint256)
    {
        if (sourceCurrencyKey == destinationCurrencyKey) return sourceAmount;
        uint256 sourceRate = rateForCurrency(sourceCurrencyKey);
        uint256 destinationRate = rateForCurrency(destinationCurrencyKey);
        if (destinationRate == 0) return 0;
        return (sourceAmount * sourceRate) / destinationRate;
    }

    function _rateAndUpdatedTime(bytes32 currencyKey) internal view returns (uint256 rate, uint256 time) {
        if (currencyKey == SUSD) return (UNIT, _lastRateUpdateTimes[SUSD]);

        address agg = _aggregators[currencyKey];
        if (agg != address(0)) {
            (rate, time,) = _latestAggregatorData(currencyKey, agg);
            rate = _applyInversePricingView(currencyKey, rate);
            return (rate, time);
        }

        return (_rates[currencyKey], _lastRateUpdateTimes[currencyKey]);
    }

    function _latestAggregatorData(bytes32 currencyKey, address aggregator)
        internal
        view
        returns (uint256 rate, uint256 updatedAt, uint256 roundId)
    {
        uint8 dec = _getCurrencyDecimals(currencyKey, aggregator);

        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).latestRoundData() returns (
            uint80 r,
            int256 answer,
            uint256,
            uint256 ts,
            uint80
        ) {
            roundId = uint256(r);
            updatedAt = ts;
            if (answer > 0) rate = _scaleTo18(uint256(answer), dec);
            return (rate, updatedAt, roundId);
        } catch {}

        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).latestRound() returns (uint256 r2) {
            roundId = r2;
            (rate, updatedAt) = _roundDataFromAggregator(currencyKey, aggregator, r2);
        } catch {}
    }

    function _roundDataFromAggregator(bytes32 currencyKey, address aggregator, uint256 roundId)
        internal
        view
        returns (uint256 rate, uint256 updatedAt)
    {
        uint8 dec = _getCurrencyDecimals(currencyKey, aggregator);
        try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).getRoundData(uint80(roundId)) returns (
            uint80,
            int256 answer,
            uint256,
            uint256 ts,
            uint80
        ) {
            updatedAt = ts;
            if (answer > 0) rate = _scaleTo18(uint256(answer), dec);
            rate = _applyInversePricingView(currencyKey, rate);
            return (rate, updatedAt);
        } catch {
            return (0, 0);
        }
    }

    function _setRate(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rate, uint256 timeSent) internal {
        _rates[currencyKey] = rate;
        _lastRateUpdateTimes[currencyKey] = timeSent;
        _currentRoundForRate[currencyKey] += 1;
        uint256 rid = _currentRoundForRate[currencyKey];
        _roundData[currencyKey][rid] = RoundData(rate, timeSent);
    }

    function _applyInversePricingAndUpdateState(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rate) internal returns (uint256) {
        InversePricingData storage inv = _inversePricing[currencyKey];
        if (inv.entryPoint == 0) return rate;
        if (inv.frozen) return inv.frozenAtUpperLimit ? inv.upperLimit : inv.lowerLimit;

        uint256 doubled = inv.entryPoint * 2;
        uint256 newRate = doubled <= rate ? 0 : doubled - rate;

        if (newRate >= inv.upperLimit) {
            newRate = inv.upperLimit;
            inv.frozen = true;
            inv.frozenAtUpperLimit = true;
            _notifyExchanger(currencyKey, newRate);
            emit InversePriceFrozen(currencyKey, rate, newRate, msg.sender);
        } else if (newRate <= inv.lowerLimit) {
            newRate = inv.lowerLimit;
            inv.frozen = true;
            inv.frozenAtUpperLimit = false;
            _notifyExchanger(currencyKey, newRate);
            emit InversePriceFrozen(currencyKey, rate, newRate, msg.sender);
        }

        return newRate;
    }

    function _applyInversePricingView(bytes32 currencyKey, uint256 rate) internal view returns (uint256) {
        InversePricingData storage inv = _inversePricing[currencyKey];
        if (inv.entryPoint == 0) return rate;
        if (inv.frozen) return inv.frozenAtUpperLimit ? inv.upperLimit : inv.lowerLimit;

        uint256 doubled = inv.entryPoint * 2;
        uint256 inverted = doubled <= rate ? 0 : doubled - rate;

        if (inverted >= inv.upperLimit) return inv.upperLimit;
        if (inverted <= inv.lowerLimit) return inv.lowerLimit;
        return inverted;
    }

    function _getCurrencyDecimals(bytes32 currencyKey, address aggregator) internal view returns (uint8) {
        if (currencyKey == SUSD) return 18;

        uint8 dec = _currencyKeyDecimals[currencyKey];
        if (dec != 0) return dec;

        if (aggregator != address(0)) {
            try IAggregatorV2V3(aggregator).decimals() returns (uint8 d) {
                if (d <= 18) return d;
            } catch {}
        }

        return 18;
    }

    function _scaleTo18(uint256 value, uint8 decimals_) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (decimals_ == 18) return value;
        if (decimals_ < 18) return value * (10 ** (18 - decimals_));
        return value / (10 ** (decimals_ - 18));
    }

    function _flexibleStorage() internal view returns (IFlexibleStorage) {
        address fs = addressCache[CONTRACT_FLEXIBLE_STORAGE];
        if (fs == address(0) && address(_resolver) != address(0)) {
            try _resolver.getAddress(CONTRACT_FLEXIBLE_STORAGE) returns (address found) {
                fs = found;
            } catch {}
        }
        return IFlexibleStorage(fs);
    }

    function _exchanger() internal view returns (address ex) {
        ex = addressCache[CONTRACT_EXCHANGER];
        if (ex == address(0) && address(_resolver) != address(0)) {
            try _resolver.getAddress(CONTRACT_EXCHANGER) returns (address found) {
                ex = found;
            } catch {}
        }
    }

    }

        );
        if (!ok) revert OdysseyMarket_BuyError();
    }

    function _listingKey(address seller, address collection, uint256 tokenId) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(seller, collection, tokenId));
    }

    function _collectionOwner(address collection) internal view returns (address owner_) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = collection.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x8da5cb5b)));
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) owner_ = abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _ownerOf721(address collection, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (address owner_, bool ok) {
        (ok, bytes memory data) = collection.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC721Like.ownerOf.selector, tokenId));
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) {
            owner_ = abi.decode(data, (address));
        } else {
            owner_ = address(0);
            ok = false;
        }
    }

    function _isApproved721(address collection, address tokenOwner, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        (bool okA, bytes memory dataA) =
            collection.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC721Like.getApproved.selector, tokenId));
        if (okA && dataA.length >= 32 && abi.decode(dataA, (address)) == address(this)) return true;

        (bool okB, bytes memory dataB) =
            collection.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC721Like.isApprovedForAll.selector, tokenOwner, address(this)));
        return okB && dataB.length >= 32 && abi.decode(dataB, (bool));
    }

    function _balanceOf1155(address collection, address owner_, uint256 id) internal view returns (uint256 bal) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
            collection.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC1155Like.balanceOf.selector, owner_, id));
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) bal = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _isApprovedForAll1155(address collection, address owner_, address operator) internal view returns (bool approved) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
            collection.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC1155Like.isApprovedForAll.selector, owner_, operator));
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) approved = abi.decode(data, (bool));
    }

    function _balanceOf(address token, address account) internal view returns (uint256 bal) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.balanceOf.selector, account));
        if (ok && data.length >= 32) bal = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;

            assembly {

        }

        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {

            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));

        uint256 validatorCount;
        uint256 rewardDebt;      // scaled by 1e6

    }

        uint32 joinedAt;

    uint256 private _lifetimePaidUserRewards;

    uint256 private _accRewardPerValidator;      // scaled by 1e6
    uint256 private _lastRewardUpdateBlock;
    uint256 private _lifetimeRewardCheckpoint;

    bool private _initialized;

    mapping(address => UserState) private _users;
    mapping(bytes32 => ValidatorInfo) private _validators; // keccak256(pubkey) => info

    constructor() {
        __self = address(this);
        _status = NOT_ENTERED;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == _admin, "Only stakefish admin allowed");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOperator() {
        require(msg.sender == _operator, "Only stakefish operator allowed");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_status != ENTERED, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _status = ENTERED;
        _;
        _status = NOT_ENTERED;
    }

    modifier onlyProxy() {
        require(address(this) != __self, "Function must be called through delegatecall");
        require(_getImplementation() == __self, "Function must be called through active proxy");
        _;
    }

    modifier notDelegated() {
        require(address(this) == __self, "UUPSUpgradeable: must not be called through delegatecall");
        _;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
    fallback() external payable {}

    function initialize(address admin_, address operator_) external {
        require(!_initialized, "Initializable: contract is already initialized");
        require(admin_ != address(0), "admin must be set");
        require(operator_ != address(0), "operator must be set");

        _initialized = true;
        if (_status == 0) _status = NOT_ENTERED;

        _admin = admin_;
        _operator = operator_;
        _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints = 2000;
        _openForWithdrawal = true;

        _lastRewardUpdateBlock = block.number;
        _lifetimeRewardCheckpoint = _lifetimeReward();

        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    function initialize_version3() external {
        if (!_initialized) {
            _initialized = true;
            if (_status == 0) _status = NOT_ENTERED;
            emit Initialized(1);
        }
        _amountTransferredToColdWallet = 0;
    }

    function changeOperator(address newOperator) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(newOperator != address(0), "operator must be set");
        _operator = newOperator;
        emit OperatorChanged(newOperator);
    }

    function setCommissionRate(uint256 newRateBasisPoints) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints = newRateBasisPoints;
        emit CommissionRateChanged(newRateBasisPoints);
    }

    function openPoolForWithdrawal() external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(!_openForWithdrawal, "Pool is already open for withdrawal");
        _openForWithdrawal = true;
    }

    function closePoolForWithdrawal() external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(_openForWithdrawal, "Pool is already closed for withdrawal");
        _openForWithdrawal = false;
    }

    function saveToColdWallet(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Not enough balance");
        _amountTransferredToColdWallet += amount;
        _sendValue(to, amount);
    }

    function loadFromColdWallet() external payable onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(msg.value <= _amountTransferredToColdWallet, "Too much transferred from cold wallet");
        _amountTransferredToColdWallet -= msg.value;
    }

    function collectPoolCommission(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(to != address(0), "to address must be set to nonzero");
        _updateGlobal();

        uint256 pending = _pendingCommission();
        if (amount == 0) amount = pending;
        require(amount <= pending, "Not enough pending commission");

        _lifetimeCollectedCommission += amount;
        emit CommissionCollected(to, amount);
        _sendValue(to, amount);
    }

    function collectReward(address to, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(_openForWithdrawal, "Pool is not open for withdrawal right now");
        _updateGlobal();
        _collectRewardFor(msg.sender, to, amount);
    }

        address[] calldata beneficiaries,
        address[] calldata tos,
        uint256 amountPerBeneficiary
    ) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(
            tos.length == 1 || tos.length == beneficiaries.length,
            "beneficiaries length incorrect"
        );
        _updateGlobal();

        if (tos.length == 1) {
            address to = tos[0];
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < beneficiaries.length; i++) {
                _collectRewardFor(beneficiaries[i], to, amountPerBeneficiary);
            }
        } else {
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < beneficiaries.length; i++) {
                _collectRewardFor(beneficiaries[i], tos[i], amountPerBeneficiary);
            }
        }
    }

        require(!_openForWithdrawal, "Pool must be closed for withdrawal");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositors.length; i++) {
            address d = depositors[i];
            if (d == address(0)) continue;

            _settle(d);
            _users[d].validatorCount += 1;
            _users[d].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;
            _totalValidators += 1;
        }

        require(depositors.length == amounts.length, "length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositors.length; i++) {
            _users[depositors[i]].claimedHistory += amounts[i];
            _lifetimePaidUserRewards += amounts[i];
        }
    }

        bytes memory pk = validatorPubKey;

    function joinPool(

        address depositor,
        uint256 joinedAtHint
    ) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        bytes memory pk = validatorPubKey;
        _join(pk, depositor, joinedAtHint == 0 ? block.timestamp : joinedAtHint);
    }

    function bulkJoinPool(
        bytes calldata validatorPubKeys,
        address[] calldata depositors,
        uint256 mode
    ) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        uint256 n = _validatorCountFromBytes(validatorPubKeys, "pubKeyArray length not multiple of 48");
        if (mode == 1) {
            require(depositors.length == 1, "Invalid depositorAddresses length");
        } else {
            require(depositors.length == n, "Invalid depositorAddresses length");
        }

        _updateGlobal();

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            address d = mode == 1 ? depositors[0] : depositors[i];
            bytes memory pk = _slice48(validatorPubKeys, i);
            _join(pk, d, block.timestamp);
        }
    }

    function partPool(bytes calldata validatorPubKey) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        bytes memory pk = validatorPubKey;
        _part(pk, block.timestamp);
    }

    function partPool(bytes calldata validatorPubKey, uint256 timestampHint) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        bytes memory pk = validatorPubKey;
        _part(pk, timestampHint == 0 ? block.timestamp : timestampHint);
    }

    function bulkPartPool(bytes calldata validatorPubKeys, uint256 timestampHint) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        uint256 n = _validatorCountFromBytes(validatorPubKeys, "pubKeyArray length not multiple of 48");
        _updateGlobal();

        uint256 ts = timestampHint == 0 ? block.timestamp : timestampHint;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            bytes memory pk = _slice48(validatorPubKeys, i);
            _part(pk, ts);
        }
    }

    function transferValidatorByAdmin(bytes calldata validatorPubKeys, address[] calldata newDepositors)
        external
        onlyAdmin
        nonReentrant
    {
        uint256 n = _validatorCountFromBytes(validatorPubKeys, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");
        require(n == newDepositors.length, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");

        _updateGlobal();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            bytes memory pk = _slice48(validatorPubKeys, i);
            _transferValidator(pk, newDepositors[i]);
        }
    }

    function totalValidators() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalValidators;
    }

    function stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints;
    }

    function lifetimeCollectedCommission() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
    }

    function lifetimePaidUserRewards() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lifetimePaidUserRewards;
    }

    function amountTransferredToColdWallet() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _amountTransferredToColdWallet;
    }

    function isOpenForWithdrawal() external view returns (bool) {
        return _openForWithdrawal;
    }

    function getLifetimeReward() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _lifetimeReward();
    }

        return _currentAccRewardPerValidator();
    }

            uint256 totalValidators_,
            uint256 commissionRateBps_,
            uint256 pendingPoolCommission_,
            uint256 lifetimeCommission_,
            uint256 lifetimePaidRewards_,
            bool openForWithdrawal_
        )
    {
        accRewardPerValidator_ = _currentAccRewardPerValidator();
        totalValidators_ = _totalValidators;
        commissionRateBps_ = _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints;
        pendingPoolCommission_ = _pendingCommissionView();
        lifetimeCommission_ = _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
        lifetimePaidRewards_ = _lifetimePaidUserRewards;
        openForWithdrawal_ = _openForWithdrawal;
    }

        external

        )
    {
        UserState storage u = _users[depositor];
        validatorCount_ = u.validatorCount;
        pendingReward_ = _pendingRewardOf(depositor);
        claimedHistory_ = u.claimedHistory;
        rewardDebt_ = u.rewardDebt;
    }

        require(validatorPubKey.length == 48, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");
        bytes32 key = keccak256(validatorPubKey);

        ValidatorInfo storage v = _validators[key];
        address depositor = v.depositor;
        require(depositor != address(0), "validator not in pool");

        _settle(depositor);

        if (_users[depositor].validatorCount > 0) {
            _users[depositor].validatorCount -= 1;
        }
        _users[depositor].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;

        if (_totalValidators > 0) _totalValidators -= 1;
        delete _validators[key];

        emit ValidatorParted(validatorPubKey, depositor, timestamp_);
    }

    function _transferValidator(bytes memory validatorPubKey, address to) internal {
        require(validatorPubKey.length == 48, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");
        require(to != address(0), "to address must be set to nonzero");

        bytes32 key = keccak256(validatorPubKey);
        ValidatorInfo storage v = _validators[key];
        address from = v.depositor;
        require(from != address(0), "validator not in pool");
        require(from != to, "cannot transfer validator owner to same");

        _settle(from);
        if (_users[from].validatorCount > 0) {
            _users[from].validatorCount -= 1;
        }
        _users[from].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;

        _settle(to);
        _users[to].validatorCount += 1;
        _users[to].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;

        v.depositor = to;
        emit ValidatorTransferred(validatorPubKey, from, to, block.timestamp);
    }

    function _collectRewardFor(address depositor, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "to address must be set to nonzero");

        _settle(depositor);

        uint256 available = _users[depositor].pendingReward;
        if (amount == 0) amount = available;
        require(amount <= available, "Not enough pending rewards");

        _users[depositor].pendingReward = available - amount;
        _users[depositor].claimedHistory += amount;
        _lifetimePaidUserRewards += amount;

        emit ValidatorRewardCollected(depositor, to, amount, msg.sender);
        _sendValue(to, amount);
    }

    function _lifetimeReward() internal view returns (uint256) {
        return address(this).balance + _amountTransferredToColdWallet + _lifetimePaidUserRewards + _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
    }

    function _currentAccRewardPerValidator() internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_totalValidators == 0) return _accRewardPerValidator;
        return (_lifetimeReward() * SCALE) / _totalValidators;
    }

    function _updateGlobal() internal {
        if (block.number > _lastRewardUpdateBlock && _totalValidators != 0) {
            _accRewardPerValidator = _currentAccRewardPerValidator();
            _lifetimeRewardCheckpoint = _lifetimeReward();
        }
        _lastRewardUpdateBlock = block.number;
    }

    function _settle(address depositor) internal {
        UserState storage u = _users[depositor];
        if (u.validatorCount != 0 && _accRewardPerValidator > u.rewardDebt) {
            uint256 delta = _accRewardPerValidator - u.rewardDebt;
            u.pendingReward += (u.validatorCount * delta) / SCALE;
        }
        u.rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;
    }

    function _pendingRewardOf(address depositor) internal view returns (uint256) {
        UserState storage u = _users[depositor];
        uint256 pending = u.pendingReward;
        uint256 accNow = _currentAccRewardPerValidator();
        if (u.validatorCount != 0 && accNow > u.rewardDebt) {
            pending += (u.validatorCount * (accNow - u.rewardDebt)) / SCALE;
        }
        return pending;
    }

    function _pendingCommissionView() internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 entitled = (_lifetimeReward() * _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints) / 10_000;
        if (entitled <= _lifetimeCollectedCommission) return 0;
        return entitled - _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
    }

    function _pendingCommission() internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _pendingCommissionView();
    }

    function _validatorCountFromBytes(bytes calldata blob, string memory err) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(blob.length % 48 == 0, err);
        return blob.length / 48;
    }

    function _slice48(bytes calldata blob, uint256 idx) internal pure returns (bytes memory out) {
        uint256 start = idx * 48;
        out = new bytes(48);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
            out[i] = blob[start + i];
        }
    }

    function _sendValue(address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(address(this).balance >= value, "Address: insufficient balance");
        (bool success, ) = payable(to).call{value: value}("");
        require(success, "Address: unable to send value, recipient may have reverted");
    }

    function _getImplementation() internal view returns (address impl) {
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {
            impl := sload(slot)
        }
    }

    function _setImplementation(address newImplementation) private {
        require(_isContract(newImplementation), "ERC1967: new implementation is not a contract");
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {
            sstore(slot, newImplementation)
        }
    }

    function _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(address newImplementation, bytes memory data, bool forceCall) internal {
        try IERC1822Proxiable(newImplementation).proxiableUUID() returns (bytes32 slot) {
            require(slot == _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, "ERC1967Upgrade: unsupported proxiableUUID");
        } catch {
            revert("ERC1967Upgrade: new implementation is not UUPS");
        }

        _setImplementation(newImplementation);
        emit Upgraded(newImplementation);

        if (data.length > 0 || forceCall) {
            _functionDelegateCall(newImplementation, data);
        }
    }

    function _functionDelegateCall(address target, bytes memory data) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        require(_isContract(target), "Address: delegate call to non-contract");
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.delegatecall(data);
        if (success) return returndata;

        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            assembly {
                revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
            }
        }
        revert("Address: low-level delegate call failed");
    }

    function _isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        return account.code.length > 0;
    }
}

    }

        emit Transfer(from, to, value);

                uint256 rootKLast = _sqrt(_kLast);
                if (rootK > rootKLast) {
                    uint256 numerator = totalSupply * (rootK - rootKLast);
                    uint256 denominator = rootK * 5 + rootKLast;
                    uint256 liquidity = numerator / denominator;
                    if (liquidity > 0) _mint(feeTo, liquidity);
                }
            }
        } else if (_kLast != 0) {
            kLast = 0;
        }
    }

    function _update(uint256 balance0_, uint256 balance1_, uint112 _r0, uint112 _r1) private {
        require(balance0_ <= type(uint112).max && balance1_ <= type(uint112).max, "KingSwap: OVERFLOW");

        uint32 blockTimestamp = uint32(block.timestamp % 2 ** 32);
        uint32 timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast;

        if (timeElapsed > 0 && _r0 != 0 && _r1 != 0) {
            price0CumulativeLast += ((uint256(_r1) * UQ112) / _r0) * timeElapsed;
            price1CumulativeLast += ((uint256(_r0) * UQ112) / _r1) * timeElapsed;
        }

        reserve0 = uint112(balance0_);
        reserve1 = uint112(balance1_);
        blockTimestampLast = blockTimestamp;

        if (balance0_ > 0 && balance1_ > 0) {
            uint256 vp = (balance1_ * UQ112) / balance0_;
            if (vp > type(uint224).max) vp = type(uint224).max;
            virtualPriceX112 = uint224(vp);
            virtualPriceTimestamp = blockTimestamp;
        }

        emit Sync(reserve0, reserve1);
    }

    function _marketPrice(address token) private view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 v;
        if (token == token0) {
            v = virtualPriceX112;
        } else if (token == token1) {
            if (virtualPriceX112 == 0) return 0;
            v = (UQ112 * UQ112) / uint256(virtualPriceX112);
        } else {
            revert("KingSwap: INVALID_TOKEN");
        }

        uint256 pool = _poolPrice(token);
        if (virtualPriceTimestamp == 0) return pool;

        uint256 age = block.timestamp - uint256(virtualPriceTimestamp);
        if (age >= DECAY_PERIOD) return pool;

        return (v * (DECAY_PERIOD - age) + pool * age) / DECAY_PERIOD;
    }

    function _poolPrice(address token) private view returns (uint256) {
        if (token == token0) {
            if (reserve0 == 0) return 0;
            return (uint256(reserve1) * UQ112) / uint256(reserve0);
        } else if (token == token1) {
            if (reserve1 == 0) return 0;
            return (uint256(reserve0) * UQ112) / uint256(reserve1);
        } else {
            revert("KingSwap: INVALID_TOKEN");
        }
    }

    function _reservesForIn(address tokenIn) private view returns (uint256 rIn, uint256 rOut) {
        if (tokenIn == token0) return (reserve0, reserve1);
        if (tokenIn == token1) return (reserve1, reserve0);
        revert("KingSwap: INVALID_TOKEN");
    }

    function _reservesForOut(address tokenOut) private view returns (uint256 rIn, uint256 rOut) {
        if (tokenOut == token1) return (reserve0, reserve1);
        if (tokenOut == token0) return (reserve1, reserve0);
        revert("KingSwap: INVALID_TOKEN");
    }

    function _isLockedFor(address token) private view returns (bool) {
        if (token == token0) return lockedIn0;
        if (token == token1) return lockedIn1;
        revert("KingSwap: INVALID_TOKEN");
    }

    function _isPairPath(address a, address b) private view returns (bool) {
        return (a == token0 && b == token1) || (a == token1 && b == token0);
    }

    function _min(uint256 x, uint256 y) private pure returns (uint256) {
        return x < y ? x : y;
    }

    function _ceilDiv(uint256 x, uint256 y) private pure returns (uint256) {
        return x == 0 ? 0 : ((x - 1) / y) + 1;
    }

    function _sqrt(uint256 y) private pure returns (uint256 z) {
        if (y > 3) {
            z = y;
            uint256 x = (y / 2) + 1;
            while (x < z) {
                z = x;
                x = (y / x + x) / 2;
            }
        } else if (y != 0) {
            z = 1;
        }
    }
}

            interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // ERC721
            interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f || // ERC721Metadata
            interfaceId == 0x780e9d63;   // ERC721Enumerable

    }

    }

    }

    function boxMouldCount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _boxMouldCount;
    }

    function authorisedCaller(address who) external view returns (bool) {
        return _authorisedCallers[who];
    }

    function teamShare(address member) external view returns (uint256) {

    function team(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");

        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {

        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function updateURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external onlyOwner {

    }

    function updateTeamAddress(address newTeamAddress) external onlyOwner {
        require(newTeamAddress != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _teamAddress = newTeamAddress;
    }

    function updateSecondaryFee(uint256 bps) external onlyOwner {
        require(bps <= TOTAL_SHARES, "NFTBoxes: share must be below 1000");
        _secondaryFeeBps = bps;
    }

    function setVendingMachine(address machine) external onlyOwner {
        _vendingMachine = machine;
    }

    function setCaller(address caller_, bool allowed) external onlyOwner {
        _authorisedCallers[caller_] = allowed;
    }

    function addTeamMember(address member) external onlyOwner {
        require(member != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_teamMemberExists[member], "NFTBoxes: members exists already");
        _teamMemberExists[member] = true;
        _teamMembers.push(member);
    }

    function removeTeamMember(address member) external onlyOwner {
        require(_teamMemberExists[member], "NFTBoxes: Not authorised to exec");
        uint256 len = _teamMembers.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (_teamMembers[i] == member) {
                _teamMembers[i] = _teamMembers[len - 1];
                _teamMembers.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
        _teamMemberExists[member] = false;
        delete _teamShare[member];
    }

    function setTeamShare(address member, uint256 share) external onlyOwner {
        require(share <= TOTAL_SHARES, "NFTBoxes: share must be below 1000");
        if (!_teamMemberExists[member] && member != address(0)) {
            _teamMemberExists[member] = true;
            _teamMembers.push(member);
        }
        _teamShare[member] = share;
    }

    function createBoxMould(
        uint128 price,
        uint128 maxPerBuy,
        uint256 maxSupply,
        address[] calldata artists,
        uint256[] calldata artistShares,
        string calldata data0,
        string calldata data1,
        string calldata data2,
        string calldata data3,
        string calldata data4
    ) external onlyOwner {
        require(artists.length == artistShares.length, "NFTBoxes: arrays are not of same");
        uint256 sum;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < artistShares.length; i++) {
            sum += artistShares[i];
        }
        require(sum + _secondaryFeeBps <= TOTAL_SHARES, "NFTBoxes: shares do not add up to 1000");

        uint256 mouldId = ++_boxMouldCount;
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        m.exists = true;
        m.price = price;
        m.maxPerBuy = maxPerBuy;
        m.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        m.data0 = data0;
        m.data1 = data1;
        m.data2 = data2;
        m.data3 = data3;
        m.data4 = data4;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < artists.length; i++) {
            m.artists.push(artists[i]);
            m.artistShares.push(artistShares[i]);
        }

        emit BoxMouldCreated(mouldId);
    }

    function addArtists(uint256 mouldId, address artist, uint256 share) external onlyOwner {
        require(artist != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

        m.artists.push(artist);
        m.artistShares.push(share);

        uint256 sum;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < m.artistShares.length; i++) {
            sum += m.artistShares[i];
        }
        require(sum + _secondaryFeeBps <= TOTAL_SHARES, "NFTBoxes: shares do not add up to 1000");
    }

    function removeArtist(uint256 mouldId, address artist) external onlyOwner {
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");
        uint256 len = m.artists.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (m.artists[i] == artist) {
                m.artists[i] = m.artists[len - 1];
                m.artistShares[i] = m.artistShares[len - 1];
                m.artists.pop();
                m.artistShares.pop();
                return;
            }
        }
        revert("NFTBoxes: Not authorised to exec");
    }

    function boxMoulds(uint256 mouldId) external view returns (BoxMould memory) {
        return _readMould(mouldId);
    }

        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");
        return _copyAddresses(m.artists);
    }

    function getArtistShares(uint256 mouldId) public view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");
        return _copyUints(m.artistShares);
    }

        (recipients, ) = _royaltiesForMould(mouldId);
    }

    function getFeeBps(uint256 mouldId) external view returns (uint256[] memory bps) {
        (, bps) = _royaltiesForMould(mouldId);
    }

    function getArtistRoyalties(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address[] memory recipients, uint256[] memory bps) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        (recipients, bps) = _royaltiesForMould(_boxesData[tokenId].mouldId);
    }

    function buyManyBoxes(uint256 mouldId, uint128 amount) external payable {
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");
        require(amount > 0, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");
        require(uint256(amount) <= 1000, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");
        if (m.maxPerBuy != 0) {
            require(amount <= m.maxPerBuy, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");
        }
        require(m.sold + uint256(amount) <= m.maxSupply, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");

        uint256 totalPrice = uint256(m.price) * uint256(amount);
        require(msg.value == totalPrice, "NFTBoxes: Wrong total price.");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < uint256(amount); i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = ++_nextTokenId;
            _mint(msg.sender, tokenId);
            _boxesData[tokenId] = BoxData({
                mouldId: mouldId,
                paidPrice: uint256(m.price),
                locked: false,
                distributed: false
            });
            if (bytes(m.data0).length != 0) {
                _tokenURIs[tokenId] = m.data0;
            }
            m.sold += 1;
        }

        emit BoxBought(mouldId, uint256(amount), totalPrice);
    }

    function setLockOnBox(uint256 tokenId, bool locked_) external onlyOwner {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        _boxesData[tokenId].locked = locked_;
    }

    function closeBox(uint256 tokenId) external {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        bool allowed = _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId) || _authorisedCallers[msg.sender] || msg.sender == _owner;
        require(allowed, "NFTBoxes: Not authorised to exec");
        _boxesData[tokenId].locked = true;
    }

    function distributeShares(uint256 tokenId) external {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        bool allowed = _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId) || _authorisedCallers[msg.sender] || msg.sender == _owner;
        require(allowed, "NFTBoxes: Not authorised to exec");

        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];
        require(b.locked, "NTFBoxes: Box is still live, cannot distribute shares");
        require(!b.distributed, "NFTBoxes: cannot distribute shares");

        b.distributed = true;
        _payoutForToken(tokenId);
    }

    function distributeOffchain(
        uint256 mouldId,
        address[][] calldata recipients,
        uint256[] calldata tokenIds
    ) external onlyOwnerOrAuthorised {
        require(recipients.length == tokenIds.length, "NFTBoxes: Wrong array size.");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            _requireMinted(tokenIds[i]);
            require(_boxesData[tokenIds[i]].mouldId == mouldId, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

            if (_vendingMachine.code.length > 0) {
                for (uint256 j = 0; j < recipients[i].length; j++) {
                    INFTMachine(_vendingMachine).NFTMachineFor(tokenIds[i], recipients[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        emit BatchDeployed(mouldId, tokenIds.length);
    }

    function boxes(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256 mouldId, uint256 paidPrice) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];
        return (b.mouldId, b.paidPrice);
    }

    function lockedBoxes(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _boxesData[tokenId].locked;
    }

    function getBoxMetaData(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (BoxMetaData memory meta) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];

        meta.tokenId = tokenId;
        meta.mouldId = b.mouldId;
        meta.paidPrice = b.paidPrice;
        meta.locked = b.locked;
        meta.distributed = b.distributed;
        meta.mould = _readMould(b.mouldId);
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for the zero address");
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {

        require(o != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");

        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");

        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");

        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _payoutForToken(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];
        uint256 gross = b.paidPrice;
        if (gross == 0) {
            gross = uint256(_moulds[b.mouldId].price);
        }

        require(address(this).balance >= gross, "NFTBoxes: Wrong total price.");

        (address[] memory recipients, uint256[] memory bps) = _royaltiesForMould(b.mouldId);

        uint256 sent;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            if (recipients[i] == address(0) || bps[i] == 0) continue;
            uint256 amount = (gross * bps[i]) / TOTAL_SHARES;
            if (amount == 0) continue;
            sent += amount;
            _sendValue(payable(recipients[i]), amount);
        }

        if (gross > sent && _teamAddress != address(0)) {
            _sendValue(payable(_teamAddress), gross - sent);
        }
    }

    function _sendValue(address payable to, uint256 value) internal {

        require(ok, "Address: call to non-contract");
    }

        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

        recipients = new address[](m.artists.length + 1);
        bps = new uint256[](m.artistShares.length + 1);

        recipients[0] = _teamAddress;
        bps[0] = _secondaryFeeBps;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < m.artists.length; i++) {
            recipients[i + 1] = m.artists[i];
            bps[i + 1] = m.artistShares[i];
        }
    }

        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

        out.exists = m.exists;
        out.feeA = m.feeA;
        out.feeB = m.feeB;
        out.price = m.price;
        out.maxPerBuy = m.maxPerBuy;
        out.maxSupply = m.maxSupply;
        out.sold = m.sold;
        out.artists = _copyAddresses(m.artists);
        out.artistShares = _copyUints(m.artistShares);
        out.data0 = m.data0;
        out.data1 = m.data1;
        out.data2 = m.data2;
        out.data3 = m.data3;
        out.data4 = m.data4;
    }

    function _copyAddresses(address[] storage src) internal view returns (address[] memory dst) {
        dst = new address[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            dst[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _copyUints(uint256[] storage src) internal view returns (uint256[] memory dst) {
        dst = new uint256[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            dst[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _requireMinted(uint256 tokenId) internal view {

    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, spender) || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender);
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
        _ownedTokens[to].push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        _ownedTokens[from].pop();
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;

        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) {
                revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            }
            assembly {
                revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
            }
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory str) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        uint256 i = digits;
        temp = value;
        while (temp != 0) {
            i--;
            buffer[i] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (temp % 10)));
            temp /= 10;
        }
        str = string(buffer);
    }
}

        require(msg.sender == _beneficiaryAddr, "BENEFICIARY_ONLY");
        _;

        require(msg.sender == _controlAddr, "CONTROL_ONLY");
        _;

        _versionString = "1";
        _decimalsToken = 18;
        _setDomainSeparator();

        require(!_initializedMeta, "ALREADY_INITIALIZED");
        _initializedMeta = true;

        _nameToken = n;
        _symbolToken = s;
        _decimalsToken = d;

        if (_beneficiaryAddr == address(0)) _beneficiaryAddr = msg.sender;
        if (_controlAddr == address(0)) _controlAddr = msg.sender;
        if (_stateValue == 0) _stateValue = 1;

        _setDomainSeparator();
    }

        uint256 initialSupply,
        address currency_,
        uint256 minInvestment_,
        uint256 fundraisingGoal_,
        uint256 maxGoal_,
        uint256 setupFee_,
        address setupFeeRecipient_,
        string calldata n,
        string calldata s,
        uint256 buySlopeNum_,
        uint256 buySlopeDen_,
        uint256 equityCommitment_,
        uint256 minDuration_
    ) external {

        if (!_initializedMeta) {

        _fundraisingGoalValue = fundraisingGoal_;
        _initGoalValue = fundraisingGoal_;

        _setupFeeValue = setupFee_;
        _setupFeeRecipientAddr = setupFeeRecipient_;

        _buySlopeNumValue = buySlopeNum_;
        _buySlopeDenValue = buySlopeDen_;
        _equityCommitmentValue = equityCommitment_;
        _minDurationValue = minDuration_;

        _stateValue = 1;
        _setDomainSeparator();

        if (initialSupply > 0) {
            _mint(msg.sender, initialSupply);
        }

        emit UpdateConfig(
            _whitelistAddr,
            _controlAddr,
            _setupFeeRecipientAddr,
            _feeCollectorAddr,
            _feeBasisPointsValue,
            _gasFeeValue,
            _minDurationValue,
            _buySlopeNumValue,
            _buySlopeDenValue
        );
    }

    function name() external view returns (string memory) { return _nameToken; }
    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) { return _symbolToken; }
    function version() external view returns (string memory) { return _versionString; }
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8) { return _decimalsToken; }
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) { return _totalSupplyToken; }
    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256) { return _balances[who]; }
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256) { return _allowances[owner][spender]; }
    function nonces(address owner) external view returns (uint256) { return _nonces[owner]; }

    function beneficiary() external view returns (address) { return _beneficiaryAddr; }
    function whitelist() external view returns (address) { return _whitelistAddr; }
    function control() external view returns (address) { return _controlAddr; }
    function currency() external view returns (address) { return _currencyAddr; }
    function setupFeeRecipient() external view returns (address) { return _setupFeeRecipientAddr; }
    function feeCollector() external view returns (address) { return _feeCollectorAddr; }

    function state() external view returns (uint256) { return _stateValue; }
    function minInvestment() external view returns (uint256) { return _minInvestmentValue; }
    function fundraisingGoal() external view returns (uint256) { return _fundraisingGoalValue; }
    function maxGoal() external view returns (uint256) { return _maxGoalValue; }
    function setupFee() external view returns (uint256) { return _setupFeeValue; }
    function feeBasisPoints() external view returns (uint256) { return _feeBasisPointsValue; }
    function gasFee() external view returns (uint256) { return _gasFeeValue; }
    function minDuration() external view returns (uint256) { return _minDurationValue; }
    function buySlopeNum() external view returns (uint256) { return _buySlopeNumValue; }
    function buySlopeDen() external view returns (uint256) { return _buySlopeDenValue; }
    function equityCommitment() external view returns (uint256) { return _equityCommitmentValue; }
    function burnedSupply() external view returns (uint256) { return _burnedSupplyValue; }
    function stakeholdersPoolAuthorized() external view returns (uint256) { return _stakeholdersPoolAuthorizedValue; }
    function stakeholdersPoolIssued() external view returns (uint256) { return _stakeholdersPoolIssuedValue; }
    function trialEndedOn() external view returns (uint256) { return _trialEndedOnValue; }
    function shareholdersPool() external view returns (uint256) { return _shareholdersPoolValue; }
    function initGoal() external view returns (uint256) { return _initGoalValue; }
    function initReserve() external view returns (uint256) { return _initReserveValue; }
    function initTrial() external view returns (uint256) { return _initTrialValue; }
    function manualBuybackReserve() external view returns (uint256) { return _manualBuybackReserveValue; }
    function initInvestors(address user) external view returns (uint256) { return _initInvestorsMap[user]; }

    function stakeholdersPool() external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        return (_shareholdersPoolValue, _stakeholdersPoolAuthorizedValue);
    }

    function buybackReserve() external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 base = _manualBuybackReserveValue;
        if (_currencyAddr == address(0)) return base + address(this).balance;
        return base + IERC20Like(_currencyAddr).balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view returns (bytes32) {
        if (block.chainid == _initialChainId) return _domainSeparator;
        return _buildDomainSeparator();
    }

    function initializeDomainSeparator() external {
        _setDomainSeparator();
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

        _approve(msg.sender, spender, _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + added);
        return true;
    }

        uint256 current = _allowances[msg.sender][spender];
        require(current >= subtracted, "DECREASED_BELOW_ZERO");
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, current - subtracted);
        return true;
    }

        _transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

        uint256 current = _allowances[from][msg.sender];
        if (current != type(uint256).max) {

            _approve(from, msg.sender, current - amount);

        _transfer(from, to, amount);
        return true;

    }

            abi.encode(

                keccak256(bytes(_nameToken)),
                keccak256(bytes(_versionString)),

        require(from != address(0) && to != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE");
        _balances[from] = bal - amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        _totalSupplyToken += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE");
        _balances[from] = bal - amount;
        _totalSupplyToken -= amount;
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
    }

    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(owner != address(0) && spender != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transfer.selector, to, value));
        require(ok, "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FAILED");
        if (ret.length > 0) require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FAILED");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value)
        );
        require(ok, "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FROM_FAILED");
        if (ret.length > 0) require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FROM_FAILED");
    }

    string private _nameValue;
    string private _symbolValue;

    uint256 private _rTotalAmount;

    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _rOwned;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _tOwned;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;

    address private _owner;
    address private _marketingWalletAddress;
    address private _burnWalletAddress;

    bool private _canTradeValue;
    bool private _swapAndLiquifyEnabledValue;

    uint256 private _launchTimestamp;
