    uint256 private _maxTxValue;
    uint256 private _minLpTokensValue;
    uint256 private _feeDenominatorValue;

    uint256 private _taxFeeBuyValue;
    uint256 private _liquidityFeeBuyValue;
    uint256 private _marketingFeeBuyValue;
    uint256 private _burnFeeBuyValue;

    uint256 private _taxFeeSellValue;
    uint256 private _liquidityFeeSellValue;
    uint256 private _marketingFeeSellValue;
    uint256 private _burnFeeSellValue;

    uint256 private _taxFeeTransferValue;
    uint256 private _liquidityFeeTransferValue;
    uint256 private _marketingFeeTransferValue;
    uint256 private _burnFeeTransferValue;

    uint256 private _previousMarketingFeeValue;

    mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromFee;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromReward;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromMaxWallet;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromMaxTx;
    mapping(address => bool) private _automatedMarketMakerPairs;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _holderLastTransferTimestamp;

    address[] private _excludedAccounts;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier lockTheSwap() {
        _inSwapAndLiquify = true;
        _;
        _inSwapAndLiquify = false;
    }

    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), _owner);

        _nameValue = "Decompiled Token";
        _symbolValue = "DCT";
        _decimalsValue = 18;

        _tTotalAmount = 1_000_000_000 * 10 ** _decimalsValue;
        _rTotalAmount = type(uint256).max - (type(uint256).max % _tTotalAmount);

        _marketingWalletAddress = _owner;
        _burnWalletAddress = 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD;

        _feeDenominatorValue = 10000;
        _maxTxValue = _tTotalAmount / 100;
        _maxWalletSizeValue = _tTotalAmount / 50;
        _minLpTokensValue = 1;

        _taxFeeBuyValue = 200;
        _liquidityFeeBuyValue = 200;
        _marketingFeeBuyValue = 200;
        _burnFeeBuyValue = 0;

        _taxFeeSellValue = 200;
        _liquidityFeeSellValue = 200;
        _marketingFeeSellValue = 200;
        _burnFeeSellValue = 0;

        _taxFeeTransferValue = 0;
        _liquidityFeeTransferValue = 0;
        _marketingFeeTransferValue = 0;
        _burnFeeTransferValue = 0;

        _balances[_owner] = _tTotalAmount;
        _rOwned[_owner] = _rTotalAmount;

        _isExcludedFromFee[_owner] = true;
        _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[_owner] = true;
        _isExcludedFromMaxTx[_owner] = true;
        _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[address(this)] = true;
        _isExcludedFromMaxTx[address(this)] = true;

        emit Transfer(address(0), _owner, _tTotalAmount);
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    function name() external view returns (string memory) { return _nameValue; }
    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) { return _symbolValue; }
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8) { return _decimalsValue; }

    function owner() public view returns (address) { return _owner; }
    function burnWallet() external view returns (address) { return _burnWalletAddress; }
    function uniswapV2Router() external view returns (address) { return address(_router); }
    function uniswapPair() external view returns (address) { return _uniswapPairAddress; }

    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) { return _tTotalAmount; }
    function _tTotal() external view returns (uint256) { return _tTotalAmount; }
    function _rTotal() external view returns (uint256) { return _rTotalAmount; }
    function totalFees() external view returns (uint256) { return _totalFeesCollected; }

    function _feeDenominator() external view returns (uint256) { return _feeDenominatorValue; }

    function _taxFeeBuy() external view returns (uint256) { return _taxFeeBuyValue; }
    function _liquidityFeeBuy() external view returns (uint256) { return _liquidityFeeBuyValue; }
    function _marketingFeeBuy() external view returns (uint256) { return _marketingFeeBuyValue; }
    function _burnFeeBuy() external view returns (uint256) { return _burnFeeBuyValue; }

    function _taxFeeSell() external view returns (uint256) { return _taxFeeSellValue; }
    function _liquidityFeeSell() external view returns (uint256) { return _liquidityFeeSellValue; }
    function _marketingFeeSell() external view returns (uint256) { return _marketingFeeSellValue; }
    function _burnFeeSell() external view returns (uint256) { return _burnFeeSellValue; }

    function _taxFeeTransfer() external view returns (uint256) { return _taxFeeTransferValue; }
    function _liquidityFeeTransfer() external view returns (uint256) { return _liquidityFeeTransferValue; }
    function _marketingFeeTransfer() external view returns (uint256) { return _marketingFeeTransferValue; }
    function _burnFeeTransfer() external view returns (uint256) { return _burnFeeTransferValue; }
    function _previousMarketingFee() external view returns (uint256) { return _previousMarketingFeeValue; }

    function maxWalletSize() external view returns (uint256) { return _maxWalletSizeValue; }
    function maxTx() external view returns (uint256) { return _maxTxValue; }
    function marketingWallet() external view returns (address) { return _marketingWalletAddress; }

    function canTrade() external view returns (bool) { return _canTradeValue; }
    function swapAndLiquifyEnabled() external view returns (bool) { return _swapAndLiquifyEnabledValue; }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_isExcludedFromReward[account]) return _tOwned[account];
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function allowance(address holder, address spender) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[holder][spender];
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) external returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + addedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) external returns (bool) {
        uint256 current = _allowances[msg.sender][spender];
        require(current >= subtractedValue, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero");
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, current - subtractedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[sender][msg.sender];
        require(currentAllowance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance");
        _approve(sender, msg.sender, currentAllowance - amount);
        _transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function tokenFromReflection(uint256 rAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(rAmount <= _rTotalAmount, "Amount must be less than total reflections");
        return rAmount / _getRate();
    }

    function reflectionFromToken(uint256 tAmount, bool deductTransferFee) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(tAmount <= _tTotalAmount, "Amount must be less than supply");
        uint256 rate = _getRate();
        if (!deductTransferFee) {
            return tAmount * rate;
        }
        uint256 fee = tAmount * (_taxFeeTransferValue + _liquidityFeeTransferValue + _marketingFeeTransferValue + _burnFeeTransferValue) / _feeDenominatorValue;
        return (tAmount - fee) * rate;
    }

    function isExcludedFromFee(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isExcludedFromFee[account];
    }

    function excludeFromFee(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromFee[account] = true;
    }

    function includeInFee(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromFee[account] = false;
    }

    function isExcludedFromReward(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isExcludedFromReward[account];
    }

    function _excluded(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        require(index < _excludedAccounts.length, "index out of bounds");
        return _excludedAccounts[index];
    }

    function excludeFromReward(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(!_isExcludedFromReward[account], "Account is already excluded");
        if (_balances[account] > 0) _tOwned[account] = _balances[account];
        _isExcludedFromReward[account] = true;
        _excludedAccounts.push(account);
    }

    function includeInReward(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(account != _burnWalletAddress, "Don't include it, it's not a good idea");
        require(_isExcludedFromReward[account], "Account is not excluded");

        uint256 len = _excludedAccounts.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (_excludedAccounts[i] == account) {
                _excludedAccounts[i] = _excludedAccounts[len - 1];
                _excludedAccounts.pop();
                break;
            }
        }

        _tOwned[account] = 0;
        _isExcludedFromReward[account] = false;
    }

    function includeInMaxWallet(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[account] = false;
    }

    function excludeFromMaxWallet(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[account] = true;
    }

    function isExcludedFromMaxWallet(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[account];
    }

    function includeInMaxTx(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromMaxTx[account] = false;
    }

    function excludeFromMaxTx(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromMaxTx[account] = true;
    }

    function setMaxTx(uint256 newMaxTx) external onlyOwner {
        _maxTxValue = newMaxTx;
    }

    function setMaxWalletSize(uint256 newMaxWallet) external onlyOwner {
        _maxWalletSizeValue = newMaxWallet;
    }

    function setMinLpTokens(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount >= 1 && amount <= 50, "minLpTokens must be between 1 and 50");
        _minLpTokensValue = amount;
    }

    function setMarketingWallet(address wallet) external onlyOwner {
        require(wallet != address(0), "walletAddress can't be 0 address");
        _marketingWalletAddress = wallet;
    }

    function pauseTrading() external onlyOwner {
        _canTradeValue = false;
    }

    function allowTrading() external onlyOwner {
        _canTradeValue = true;
        if (_launchTimestamp == 0) _launchTimestamp = block.timestamp;
    }

    function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(bool enabled) external onlyOwner {
        _swapAndLiquifyEnabledValue = enabled;
        emit SwapAndLiquifyEnabledUpdated(enabled);
    }

    function setBuyFees(uint256 tax, uint256 liquidity, uint256 marketing, uint256 burn) external onlyOwner {
        _checkFeeCap(tax, liquidity, marketing, burn);
        _taxFeeBuyValue = tax;
        _liquidityFeeBuyValue = liquidity;
        _marketingFeeBuyValue = marketing;
        _burnFeeBuyValue = burn;
    }

    function setSellFees(uint256 tax, uint256 liquidity, uint256 marketing, uint256 burn) external onlyOwner {
        _checkFeeCap(tax, liquidity, marketing, burn);
        _previousMarketingFeeValue = _marketingFeeSellValue;
        _taxFeeSellValue = tax;
        _liquidityFeeSellValue = liquidity;
        _marketingFeeSellValue = marketing;
        _burnFeeSellValue = burn;
    }

    function setTransferFees(uint256 tax, uint256 liquidity, uint256 marketing, uint256 burn) external onlyOwner {
        _checkFeeCap(tax, liquidity, marketing, burn);
        _taxFeeTransferValue = tax;
        _liquidityFeeTransferValue = liquidity;
        _marketingFeeTransferValue = marketing;
        _burnFeeTransferValue = burn;
    }

    function setAMM(address pair, bool value) external onlyOwner {
        require(pair != address(0), "walletAddress can't be 0 address");
        _automatedMarketMakerPairs[pair] = value;
        if (value) _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[pair] = true;
        if (value && _uniswapPairAddress == address(0)) _uniswapPairAddress = pair;
    }

    function automatedMarketMakerPairs(address pair) external view returns (bool) {
        return _automatedMarketMakerPairs[pair];
    }

    function removeB(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _holderLastTransferTimestamp[account] = 0;
    }

    function claimTokens() external onlyOwner {
        _sendETH(_marketingWalletAddress, address(this).balance);
    }

    function clearStuckBalance(address walletAddress) external onlyOwner {
        require(walletAddress != address(0), "walletAddress can't be 0 address");
        _sendETH(walletAddress, address(this).balance);
    }

    function claimOtherTokens(address token, address walletAddress) external onlyOwner {
        require(walletAddress != address(0), "walletAddress can't be 0 address");
        if (token == address(0)) {
            _sendETH(walletAddress, address(this).balance);
            return;
        }

        if (token == address(this)) {
            uint256 ownBal = _balances[address(this)];
            _basicTransfer(address(this), walletAddress, ownBal);
            return;
        }

        uint256 bal = IERC20Minimal(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        require(IERC20Minimal(token).transfer(walletAddress, bal), "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0) && to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from/to zero address");
        if (amount == 0) {
            emit Transfer(from, to, 0);
            return;
        }

        if (_inSwapAndLiquify) {
            _basicTransfer(from, to, amount);
            return;
        }

        if (!_canTradeValue) {
            require(
                _isExcludedFromFee[from] || _isExcludedFromFee[to] || from == _owner || to == _owner,
                "Trading not enabled"
            );
        }

        if (!_isExcludedFromMaxTx[from] && !_isExcludedFromMaxTx[to]) {
            require(amount <= _maxTxValue, "maxTx exceeded");
        }

        if (!_isExcludedFromMaxWallet[to] && !_automatedMarketMakerPairs[to] && to != address(this)) {
            require(_balances[to] + amount <= _maxWalletSizeValue, "Max wallet size exceeded");
        }

        if (_holderLastTransferTimestamp[from] != 0) {
            require(block.timestamp > _holderLastTransferTimestamp[from], "Cooldown active");
        }

        if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[from] && !_isExcludedFromFee[to]) {
            _holderLastTransferTimestamp[to] = block.timestamp + 1;
        }

        uint256 contractTokenBalance = _balances[address(this)];
        if (
            _swapAndLiquifyEnabledValue &&
            _automatedMarketMakerPairs[to] &&
            !_inSwapAndLiquify &&
            contractTokenBalance >= _minLpTokensValue
        ) {
            if (contractTokenBalance > _maxTxValue) {
                contractTokenBalance = _maxTxValue;
            }
            _swapAndLiquify(contractTokenBalance);
        }

        (uint256 taxFee, uint256 liquidityFee, uint256 marketingFee, uint256 burnFee) = _currentFees(from, to);
        uint256 totalFee = taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee + burnFee;

        if (totalFee == 0) {
            _basicTransfer(from, to, amount);
            return;
        }

        uint256 feeAmount = amount * totalFee / _feeDenominatorValue;
        uint256 transferAmount = amount - feeAmount;

        _balances[from] -= amount;
        _balances[to] += transferAmount;

        emit Transfer(from, to, transferAmount);

        uint256 contractPart = amount * (taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee) / _feeDenominatorValue;
        if (contractPart > 0) {
            _balances[address(this)] += contractPart;
            emit Transfer(from, address(this), contractPart);
        }

        uint256 burnPart = amount * burnFee / _feeDenominatorValue;
        if (burnPart > 0) {
            _balances[_burnWalletAddress] += burnPart;
            emit Transfer(from, _burnWalletAddress, burnPart);
        }

        _totalFeesCollected += amount * taxFee / _feeDenominatorValue;

        uint256 rate = _getRate();
        _rOwned[from] -= amount * rate;
        _rOwned[to] += transferAmount * rate;
        if (contractPart > 0) _rOwned[address(this)] += contractPart * rate;
        if (burnPart > 0) _rOwned[_burnWalletAddress] += burnPart * rate;

        _syncExcluded(from);
        _syncExcluded(to);
        _syncExcluded(address(this));
        _syncExcluded(_burnWalletAddress);
    }

    function _basicTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _balances[from] -= amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;

        uint256 rate = _getRate();
        _rOwned[from] -= amount * rate;
        _rOwned[to] += amount * rate;

        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);

        _syncExcluded(from);
        _syncExcluded(to);
    }

    function _syncExcluded(address account) internal {
        if (_isExcludedFromReward[account]) {
            _tOwned[account] = _balances[account];
        }
    }

    function _currentFees(address from, address to) internal view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        if (_isExcludedFromFee[from] || _isExcludedFromFee[to]) {
            return (0, 0, 0, 0);
        }

        if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[from]) {
            return (_taxFeeBuyValue, _liquidityFeeBuyValue, _marketingFeeBuyValue, _burnFeeBuyValue);
        }

        if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[to]) {
            return (_taxFeeSellValue, _liquidityFeeSellValue, _marketingFeeSellValue, _burnFeeSellValue);
        }

        return (_taxFeeTransferValue, _liquidityFeeTransferValue, _marketingFeeTransferValue, _burnFeeTransferValue);
    }

    function _swapAndLiquify(uint256 tokenAmount) internal lockTheSwap {
        if (address(_router) == address(0) || tokenAmount == 0) return;

        uint256 half = tokenAmount / 2;
        uint256 otherHalf = tokenAmount - half;
        uint256 initialBalance = address(this).balance;

        _approve(address(this), address(_router), tokenAmount);
        _swapTokensForEth(half);

        uint256 postSwapBalance = address(this).balance;
        uint256 ethReceived = postSwapBalance > initialBalance ? postSwapBalance - initialBalance : 0;

        if (otherHalf > 0 && ethReceived > 0) {
            _addLiquidity(otherHalf, ethReceived);
        }

        emit SwapAndLiquify(half, ethReceived, otherHalf);
    }

    function _swapTokensForEth(uint256 tokenAmount) internal {
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = _router.WETH();

        try _router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(
            tokenAmount,
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp
        ) {} catch {}
    }

    function _addLiquidity(uint256 tokenAmount, uint256 ethAmount) internal {
        try _router.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount}(
            address(this),
            tokenAmount,
            0,
            0,
            _owner,
            block.timestamp
        ) returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {} catch {}
    }

    function _approve(address holder, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(holder != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowances[holder][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(holder, spender, amount);
    }

    function _getRate() internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_tTotalAmount == 0) return 1;
        return _rTotalAmount / _tTotalAmount;
    }

    function _sendETH(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount == 0) return;
        (bool ok, ) = payable(to).call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "ETH transfer failed");
    }

    function _checkFeeCap(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 c, uint256 d) internal pure {
        require(a + b + c + d <= 3000, "Fee above 30% not allowed");
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }
}

        uint256 againstVotes;
        bool canceled;
        bool executed;
        bool abrogated;
        uint256 pWarmUpDuration;
        uint256 pActiveDuration;
        uint256 pQueueDuration;
        uint256 pGracePeriodDuration;
        uint256 pAcceptanceThreshold;
        uint256 pMinQuorum;
        mapping(address => Receipt) receipts;
    }

    struct AbrogationProposal {
        uint256 id;
        address proposer;
        string description;
        uint256 startTime;
        uint256 endTime;
        uint256 forVotes;
        uint256 againstVotes;
        bool canceled;
        bool executed;
        mapping(address => Receipt) receipts;
    }

    event Vote(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed voter, bool support, uint256 votes);
    event VoteCanceled(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed voter);
    event ProposalCreated(uint256 indexed proposalId);
    event ProposalQueued(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed proposer, uint256 eta);
    event ProposalCanceled(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed caller);
    event ProposalExecuted(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed caller);

    event AbrogationProposalStarted(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed proposer);
    event AbrogationProposalVote(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed voter, bool support, uint256 votes);
    event AbrogationProposalVoteCancelled(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed voter);
    event AbrogationProposalExecuted(uint256 indexed proposalId, address indexed caller);

    uint256 public warmUpDuration;          // slot 0
    uint256 public activeDuration;          // slot 1
    uint256 public queueDuration;           // slot 2
    uint256 public gracePeriodDuration;     // slot 3
    uint256 public gradualWeightUpdate;     // slot 4
    uint256 public acceptanceThreshold;     // slot 5
    uint256 public minQuorum;               // slot 6

    address public smartPool;               // slot 7
    mapping(bytes32 => bool) public queuedTransactions; // slot 8
    uint256 public lastProposalId;          // slot 9

    mapping(uint256 => Proposal) internal _proposals;                // slot 10
    mapping(uint256 => AbrogationProposal) internal _abrogationProposals; // slot 11
    mapping(address => uint256) public latestProposalIds;            // slot 12

    address public reign;                   // slot 13
    address public controller;              // packed slot in original bytecode

    bool private _initialized;
    bool private _active;

    uint256 public constant MAX_ACTIONS = 10;

    modifier onlySelf() {
        require(msg.sender == address(this), "only governance");
        _;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
    fallback() external payable { revert("invalid call"); }

    function initialize(address _reign, address _controller, address _smartPool) external {
        require(!_initialized, "Contract already initialized.");
        require(_reign != address(0), "reign must not be 0x0");

        reign = _reign;
        controller = _controller;

        if (smartPool == address(0) && _smartPool != address(0)) {
            smartPool = _smartPool;
        }

        _initialized = true;
    }

    function activate() external {
        require(!_active, "DAO already active");
        require(_reignStaked() > 0, "activation threshold not met");
        _active = true;
    }

    function isActive() external view returns (bool) {
        return _active;
    }

    function setWarmUpDuration(uint256 value) external onlySelf {
        warmUpDuration = value;
    }

    function setActiveDuration(uint256 value) external onlySelf {
        require(value >= 1 days, "period must be >= 1 day");
        activeDuration = value;
    }

    function setQueueDuration(uint256 value) external onlySelf {
        queueDuration = value;
    }

    function setGracePeriodDuration(uint256 value) external onlySelf {
        require(value >= 1 days, "period must be >= 1 day");
        gracePeriodDuration = value;
    }

    function setGradualWeightUpdate(uint256 value) external onlySelf {
        gradualWeightUpdate = value;
    }

    function setAcceptanceThreshold(uint256 value) external onlySelf {
        require(value <= 100, "must be <= 100");
        require(value > 50, "must be > 50");
        acceptanceThreshold = value;
    }

    function setMinQuorum(uint256 value) external onlySelf {
        require(value > 5, "quorum must be > 5");
        require(value <= 100, "must be <= 100");
        minQuorum = value;
    }

    function setSmartPoolAddress(address pool) external onlySelf {
        smartPool = pool;
    }

    function setSmartPoolInitial(address pool) external {
        require(smartPool == address(0), "Can only initialize smartPool address once");
        smartPool = pool;
    }

    function triggerApplyAddToken() external {
        if (smartPool == address(0)) return;
        try ISmartPoolLike(smartPool).applyAddToken() {} catch {}
    }

    function triggerWeightUpdate() external {
        if (controller == address(0) || smartPool == address(0)) return;

        try IWeightControllerLike(controller).updateBasketBalance() {} catch {}

        address[] memory tokens;
        try IWeightControllerLike(controller).getTokens() returns (address[] memory t) {
            tokens = t;
        } catch {
            return;
        }

        uint256[] memory targetWeights = new uint256[](tokens.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            try IWeightControllerLike(controller).getTargetAllocation(tokens[i]) returns (uint256 w) {
                targetWeights[i] = w;
            } catch {
                targetWeights[i] = 0;
            }
        }

        uint256 endTs = block.timestamp.add(gradualWeightUpdate);
        try ISmartPoolLike(smartPool).updateWeightsGradually(targetWeights, block.timestamp, endTs) {} catch {}
    }

    function propose(
        address[] calldata targets,
        uint256[] calldata values,
        string[] calldata signatures,
        bytes[] calldata calldatas,
        string calldata title,
        string calldata description
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(targets.length == values.length, "proposal function information mismatch");
        require(targets.length == signatures.length, "proposal function information mismatch");
        require(targets.length == calldatas.length, "proposal function information mismatch");
        require(targets.length > 0, "Must provide actions");
        require(targets.length <= MAX_ACTIONS, "Too many actions on a vote");
        require(bytes(title).length > 0, "title can't be empty");
        require(bytes(description).length > 0, "description can't be empty");

        if (!_active) {
            require(_reignStaked() > 0, "DAO not yet active");
            _active = true;
        }

        uint256 latestId = latestProposalIds[msg.sender];
        if (latestId != 0) {
            uint256 st = _state(latestId);
            require(_isFinalState(st), "One live proposal per proposer");
        }

        uint256 proposalId = lastProposalId.add(1);
        lastProposalId = proposalId;

        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        p.id = proposalId;
        p.proposer = msg.sender;
        p.title = title;
        p.description = description;
        p.creationTime = block.timestamp > 0 ? block.timestamp.sub(1) : 0;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
            p.targets.push(targets[i]);
            p.values.push(values[i]);
            p.signatures.push(signatures[i]);
            p.calldatas.push(calldatas[i]);
        }

        p.pWarmUpDuration = warmUpDuration;
        p.pActiveDuration = activeDuration;
        p.pQueueDuration = queueDuration;
        p.pGracePeriodDuration = gracePeriodDuration;
        p.pAcceptanceThreshold = acceptanceThreshold;
        p.pMinQuorum = minQuorum;

        latestProposalIds[msg.sender] = proposalId;
        emit ProposalCreated(proposalId);

        return proposalId;
    }

    function proposals(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 id,
            address proposer,
            string memory title,
            string memory description,
            uint256 creationTime,
            uint256 eta,
            uint256 forVotes,
            uint256 againstVotes,
            bool canceled,
            bool executed,
            uint256 proposalAcceptanceThreshold,
            uint256 proposalMinQuorum
        )
    {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        return (
            p.id,
            p.proposer,
            p.title,
            p.description,
            p.creationTime,
            p.eta,
            p.forVotes,
            p.againstVotes,
            p.canceled,
            p.executed,
            p.pAcceptanceThreshold,
            p.pMinQuorum
        );
    }

    function getActions(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            address[] memory targets,
            uint256[] memory values,
            string[] memory signatures,
            bytes[] memory calldatas
        )
    {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];

        targets = new address[](p.targets.length);
        values = new uint256[](p.values.length);
        signatures = new string[](p.signatures.length);
        calldatas = new bytes[](p.calldatas.length);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.targets.length; i++) targets[i] = p.targets[i];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.values.length; i++) values[i] = p.values[i];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.signatures.length; i++) signatures[i] = p.signatures[i];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.calldatas.length; i++) calldatas[i] = p.calldatas[i];
    }

    function getProposalParameters(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 proposalWarmUpDuration,
            uint256 proposalActiveDuration,
            uint256 proposalQueueDuration,
            uint256 proposalGracePeriodDuration,
            uint256 proposalAcceptanceThreshold,
            uint256 proposalMinQuorum
        )
    {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        return (
            p.pWarmUpDuration,
            p.pActiveDuration,
            p.pQueueDuration,
            p.pGracePeriodDuration,
            p.pAcceptanceThreshold,
            p.pMinQuorum
        );
    }

    function state(uint256 proposalId) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _state(proposalId);
    }

    function getProposalQuorum(uint256 proposalId) public view returns (uint256) {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        require(p.id != 0, "proposal not found");
        uint256 staked = _reignStakedAtTs(p.creationTime);
        if (staked == 0) return p.pMinQuorum;
        return staked.mul(p.pMinQuorum).div(100);
    }

    function queue(uint256 proposalId) external {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 4, "Proposal can only be queued if succeeded");
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];

        uint256 eta = block.timestamp.add(p.pQueueDuration);
        p.eta = eta;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.targets.length; i++) {
            bytes32 txHash = keccak256(abi.encode(
                p.targets[i],
                p.values[i],
                p.signatures[i],
                p.calldatas[i],
                eta
            ));
            require(!queuedTransactions[txHash], "proposal action already queued at eta");
            queuedTransactions[txHash] = true;
        }

        emit ProposalQueued(proposalId, msg.sender, eta);
    }

    function execute(uint256 proposalId) external payable {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 6, "proposal not executable");
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        p.executed = true;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.targets.length; i++) {
            bytes32 txHash = keccak256(abi.encode(
                p.targets[i],
                p.values[i],
                p.signatures[i],
                p.calldatas[i],
                p.eta
            ));
            require(queuedTransactions[txHash], "transaction not queued");
            queuedTransactions[txHash] = false;

            bytes memory callData;
            if (bytes(p.signatures[i]).length == 0) {
                callData = p.calldatas[i];
            } else {
                callData = abi.encodePacked(bytes4(keccak256(bytes(p.signatures[i]))), p.calldatas[i]);
            }

            (bool ok, ) = p.targets[i].call{value: p.values[i]}(callData);
            require(ok, "proposal action failed");
        }

        emit ProposalExecuted(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function cancelProposal(uint256 proposalId) external {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        require(p.id != 0, "proposal not found");
        require(!p.executed, "already executed");
        require(msg.sender == p.proposer || msg.sender == address(this), "cannot cancel");

        p.canceled = true;
        if (p.eta != 0) {
            _clearQueuedTransactions(p);
        }

        emit ProposalCanceled(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function castVote(uint256 proposalId, bool support) external {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 1, "Proposal not active");
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        Receipt storage r = p.receipts[msg.sender];
        require(!r.hasVoted, "Already voted this option");

        uint256 votes = _votingPowerAtTs(msg.sender, p.creationTime);
        if (support) p.forVotes = p.forVotes.add(votes);
        else p.againstVotes = p.againstVotes.add(votes);

        r.hasVoted = true;
        r.support = support;
        r.votes = votes;

        emit Vote(proposalId, msg.sender, support, votes);
    }

    function cancelVote(uint256 proposalId) external {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 1, "Proposal not active");
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        Receipt storage r = p.receipts[msg.sender];
        require(r.hasVoted, "Cannot cancel if not voted yet");

        if (r.support) p.forVotes = p.forVotes.sub(r.votes);
        else p.againstVotes = p.againstVotes.sub(r.votes);

        r.hasVoted = false;
        r.support = false;
        r.votes = 0;

        emit VoteCanceled(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function getReceipt(uint256 proposalId, address voter)
        external
        view
        returns (bool hasVoted, bool support, uint256 votes)
    {
        Receipt storage r = _proposals[proposalId].receipts[voter];
        return (r.hasVoted, r.support, r.votes);
    }

    function startAbrogationProposal(uint256 proposalId, string calldata description) external {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 5, "Proposal must be in queue");
        require(bytes(description).length > 0, "description can't be empty");

        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        require(ap.id == 0, "Abrogation proposal already exists");

        ap.id = proposalId;
        ap.proposer = msg.sender;
        ap.description = description;
        ap.startTime = block.timestamp;
        ap.endTime = block.timestamp.add(activeDuration);

        emit AbrogationProposalStarted(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function abrogationProposals(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 id,
            address proposer,
            string memory description,
            uint256 startTime,
            uint256 endTime,
            uint256 forVotes,
            uint256 againstVotes,
            bool canceled,
            bool executed
        )
    {
        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        return (
            ap.id,
            ap.proposer,
            ap.description,
            ap.startTime,
            ap.endTime,
            ap.forVotes,
            ap.againstVotes,
            ap.canceled,
            ap.executed
        );
    }

    function abrogationProposal_castVote(uint256 proposalId, bool support) external {
        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        require(ap.id != 0, "abrogation proposal not found");
        require(!ap.executed && !ap.canceled, "not active");
        require(block.timestamp <= ap.endTime, "abrogation proposal ended");

        Receipt storage r = ap.receipts[msg.sender];
        require(!r.hasVoted, "Already voted this option");

        uint256 votes = _votingPowerAtTs(msg.sender, ap.startTime);
        if (support) ap.forVotes = ap.forVotes.add(votes);
        else ap.againstVotes = ap.againstVotes.add(votes);

        r.hasVoted = true;
        r.support = support;
        r.votes = votes;

        emit AbrogationProposalVote(proposalId, msg.sender, support, votes);
    }

    function abrogationProposal_cancelVote(uint256 proposalId) external {
        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        require(ap.id != 0, "abrogation proposal not found");
        require(!ap.executed && !ap.canceled, "not active");

        Receipt storage r = ap.receipts[msg.sender];
        require(r.hasVoted, "Cannot cancel if not voted yet");

        if (r.support) ap.forVotes = ap.forVotes.sub(r.votes);
        else ap.againstVotes = ap.againstVotes.sub(r.votes);

        r.hasVoted = false;
        r.support = false;
        r.votes = 0;

        emit AbrogationProposalVoteCancelled(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function getAbrogationProposalReceipt(uint256 proposalId, address voter)
        external
        view
        returns (bool hasVoted, bool support, uint256 votes)
    {
        Receipt storage r = _abrogationProposals[proposalId].receipts[voter];
        return (r.hasVoted, r.support, r.votes);
    }

    function abrogateProposal(uint256 proposalId) external {
        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        require(ap.id != 0, "abrogation proposal not found");
        require(!ap.executed && !ap.canceled, "already finalized");
        require(block.timestamp > ap.endTime, "abrogation proposal still active");
        require(ap.forVotes > ap.againstVotes, "abrogation not approved");

        ap.executed = true;

        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        p.canceled = true;
        p.abrogated = true;
        if (p.eta != 0) {
            _clearQueuedTransactions(p);
        }

        emit AbrogationProposalExecuted(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function _state(uint256 proposalId) internal view returns (uint256) {
        require(proposalId > 0 && proposalId <= lastProposalId, "invalid proposal id");

        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        if (p.id == 0) return 0;
        if (p.abrogated) return 9;
        if (p.canceled) return 2;
        if (p.executed) return 8;

        uint256 votingStart = p.creationTime.add(p.pWarmUpDuration);
        if (block.timestamp <= votingStart) return 0;

        uint256 votingEnd = votingStart.add(p.pActiveDuration);
        if (block.timestamp <= votingEnd) return 1;

        uint256 totalVotes = p.forVotes.add(p.againstVotes);
        uint256 quorumVotes = getProposalQuorum(proposalId);
        if (totalVotes < quorumVotes || totalVotes == 0) return 3;
        if (p.forVotes.mul(100) < totalVotes.mul(p.pAcceptanceThreshold)) return 3;

        if (p.eta == 0) return 4;
        if (block.timestamp < p.eta) return 5;
        if (block.timestamp <= p.eta.add(p.pGracePeriodDuration)) return 6;
        return 7;
    }

    function _isFinalState(uint256 st) internal pure returns (bool) {
        return (st == 2 || st == 3 || st == 7 || st == 8 || st == 9);
    }

    function _clearQueuedTransactions(Proposal storage p) internal {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.targets.length; i++) {
            bytes32 txHash = keccak256(abi.encode(
                p.targets[i],
                p.values[i],
                p.signatures[i],
                p.calldatas[i],
                p.eta
            ));
            queuedTransactions[txHash] = false;
        }
    }

    function _reignStaked() internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (reign == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reign.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IReignLike.reignStaked.selector)
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _reignStakedAtTs(uint256 ts) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (reign == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reign.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IReignLike.reignStakedAtTs.selector, ts)
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _votingPowerAtTs(address who, uint256 ts) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (reign == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reign.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IReignLike.votingPowerAtTs.selector, who, ts)
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }
}

        StakeInfo storage lp = _userMoveEthLP[user];

        require(m.amount >= amountMove, "withdraw: insufficient move");
        require(lp.amount >= amountMoveEthLP, "withdraw: insufficient lp");

        if (amountMove > 0) {
            m.amount -= amountMove;
            totalStakedMove -= amountMove;
            _transferOrSafeTransfer(tokenMoveAddress, address(this), user, amountMove);
        }

        if (amountMoveEthLP > 0) {
            lp.amount -= amountMoveEthLP;
            totalStakedMoveEthLP -= amountMoveEthLP;
            _safeTransfer(tokenMoveEthLPAddress, user, amountMoveEthLP);
        }

    }

                _safeTransfer(token, to, amount);
            } else {
                _safeTransferFrom(token, from, to, amount);
            }
        }
    }

    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(owner != address(0) && spender != address(0), "zero address");
        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

    function _spendAllowance(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 current = _allowances[owner][spender];
        if (current != type(uint256).max) {
            require(current >= amount, "insufficient allowance");
            _allowances[owner][spender] = current - amount;
            emit Approval(owner, spender, _allowances[owner][spender]);
        }
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0) && to != address(0), "zero address");
        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "insufficient balance");
        _balances[from] = bal - amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "mint to zero");
        _totalSupplyToken += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "burn from zero");
        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "burn exceeds balance");
        _balances[from] = bal - amount;
        _totalSupplyToken -= amount;
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
    }

    function _buildDomainSeparator() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 nameHash = _hashedName;
        if (nameHash == bytes32(0)) {
            nameHash = keccak256(bytes(_nameToken));
        }
        return keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                _EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,
                nameHash,
                _HASHED_VERSION,
                block.chainid,
                address(this)
            )
        );
    }

    function _updateDomainSeparator() internal {
        _hashedName = keccak256(bytes(_nameToken));
        _cachedChainId = block.chainid;
        _cachedDomainSeparator = _buildDomainSeparator();
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account, address sender) internal {
        RoleData storage rd = _roles[role];
        if (!rd.members[account]) {
            rd.members[account] = true;
            rd.memberList.push(account);
            rd.memberIndexPlus1[account] = rd.memberList.length;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account, address sender) internal {
        RoleData storage rd = _roles[role];
        if (rd.members[account]) {
            rd.members[account] = false;

            uint256 idxPlus = rd.memberIndexPlus1[account];
            if (idxPlus != 0) {
                uint256 idx = idxPlus - 1;
                uint256 lastIdx = rd.memberList.length - 1;
                if (idx != lastIdx) {
                    address last = rd.memberList[lastIdx];
                    rd.memberList[idx] = last;
                    rd.memberIndexPlus1[last] = idx + 1;
                }
                rd.memberList.pop();
                rd.memberIndexPlus1[account] = 0;
            }

            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, sender);
        }
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(token != address(0), "token zero");
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(token != address(0), "token zero");
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "transferFrom failed");
    }
}

    struct UserInfo {

    uint256 private constant ACC_REWARD_PRECISION = 1e12;

    uint8 private _initialized;

    uint8 public eligibilityMode; // 0..2

    uint256 public lastAllPoolUpdate;

    uint256 public endingTimeUpdateCadence;

    EmissionPoint[] public emissionSchedule;

    mapping(address => PoolInfo) public poolInfo;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => UserInfo)) public userInfo;

    mapping(address => bool) public eligibilityExempt;
    mapping(address => bool) public whitelist;
    mapping(address => bool) public authorizedContracts;

    error NotOwner();

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Initialized(uint8 version);

    event Unpaused(address account);

    event RewardsPerSecondUpdated(uint256 rewardsPerSecond, bool persist);
    event RewardDeposit(uint256 amount);
    event EmissionScheduleAppended(uint256[] timePoints, uint256[] rewardsPerSecondValues);
    event BalanceUpdated(address indexed user, address indexed token, uint256 userBalance, uint256 totalSupply);
    event Recovered(address indexed token, uint256 amount);
    event Disqualified(address indexed user);

    event OnwardIncentivesUpdated(address indexed token, address indexed onwardIncentives);
    event BountyManagerUpdated(address indexed manager);
    event AuthorizedContractUpdated(address indexed account, bool allowed);
    event WhitelistUpdated(address indexed account, bool allowed);
    event EligibilityModeUpdated(uint8 mode);
    event EndingTimeUpdateCadenceUpdated(uint256 cadence);

    modifier initializer() {
        if (_initialized != 0 || _initializing) revert AlreadyInitialized();
        _initialized = 1;
        _initializing = true;
        _;
        _initializing = false;
        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        if (msg.sender != _owner) revert NotOwner();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyPoolConfigurator() {
        if (msg.sender != poolConfigurator) revert NotPoolConfigurator();
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        if (_paused) revert ContractPaused();
        _;
    }

    modifier whenPaused() {
        if (!_paused) revert ContractNotPaused();
        _;
    }

    function initialize(
        address rdntToken_,
        address mfd_,
        address eligibleDataProvider_,
        uint256 rewardsPerSecond_,
        address poolConfigurator_,
        uint256 endingTimeUpdateCadence_
    ) external initializer {
        if (
            rdntToken_ == address(0) ||
            mfd_ == address(0) ||
            eligibleDataProvider_ == address(0) ||
            poolConfigurator_ == address(0)
        ) revert ZeroAddress();

        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);

        rdntToken = rdntToken_;
        mfd = mfd_;
        eligibleDataProvider = eligibleDataProvider_;
        poolConfigurator = poolConfigurator_;
        rewardsPerSecond = rewardsPerSecond_;
        lastRPS = rewardsPerSecond_;
        endingTimeUpdateCadence = endingTimeUpdateCadence_;
        persistRewardsPerSecond = true;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function poolLength() external view returns (uint256) {
        return registeredTokens.length;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        if (newOwner == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function pause() external onlyOwner whenNotPaused {
        _paused = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner whenPaused {
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function start() external onlyOwner {
        if (startTime != 0) revert AlreadyStarted();
        startTime = block.timestamp;
    }

    function toggleWhitelist() external onlyOwner {
        whitelistActive = !whitelistActive;
    }

    function setWhitelist(address account, bool allowed) external onlyOwner {
        whitelist[account] = allowed;
        emit WhitelistUpdated(account, allowed);
    }

    function setAuthorizedContract(address account, bool allowed) external onlyOwner {
        if (authorizedContracts[account] == allowed) revert StatusUnchanged();
        authorizedContracts[account] = allowed;
        emit AuthorizedContractUpdated(account, allowed);
    }

    function setEligibilityMode(uint8 mode) external onlyOwner {
        if (mode > 2) revert InvalidMode();
        eligibilityMode = mode;
        emit EligibilityModeUpdated(mode);
    }

    function setEligibilityExempt(address user, bool exempt) external {
        if (eligibilityMode != 0) return;
        if (msg.sender != _owner && !authorizedContracts[msg.sender]) revert NotAuthorized();
        eligibilityExempt[user] = exempt;
    }

    function setBountyManager(address manager) external onlyOwner {
        bountyManager = manager;
        emit BountyManagerUpdated(manager);
    }

    function setEndingTimeUpdateCadence(uint256 cadence) external onlyOwner {
        if (cadence > MAX_ENDING_TIME_CADENCE) revert InvalidCadence();
        endingTimeUpdateCadence = cadence;
        emit EndingTimeUpdateCadenceUpdated(cadence);
    }

    function addPool(address token, uint256 allocPoint) external onlyPoolConfigurator {
        if (token == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
        if (_poolExists[token]) revert PoolAlreadyExists();

        _poolExists[token] = true;
        registeredTokens.push(token);

        PoolInfo storage p = poolInfo[token];
        p.allocPoint = allocPoint;
        p.lastRewardTime = _currentRewardTime();

        totalAllocPoint += allocPoint;
    }

    function batchUpdateAllocPoint(address[] calldata tokens, uint256[] calldata allocPoints) external onlyOwner {
        if (tokens.length != allocPoints.length) revert InvalidLength();
        _updateAllPools();

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; ) {
            _requirePool(tokens[i]);
            PoolInfo storage p = poolInfo[tokens[i]];
            totalAllocPoint = totalAllocPoint - p.allocPoint + allocPoints[i];
            p.allocPoint = allocPoints[i];
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function setOnwardIncentives(address token, address onwardIncentives) external onlyOwner {
        _requirePool(token);
        poolInfo[token].onwardIncentives = onwardIncentives;
        emit OnwardIncentivesUpdated(token, onwardIncentives);
    }

    function setRewardsPerSecond(uint256 newRewardsPerSecond, bool persist) external onlyOwner {
        _updateAllPools();
        rewardsPerSecond = newRewardsPerSecond;
        persistRewardsPerSecond = persist;
        if (newRewardsPerSecond > lastRPS) lastRPS = newRewardsPerSecond;
        _recomputeEndingTime();
        emit RewardsPerSecondUpdated(newRewardsPerSecond, persist);
    }

    function setEmissionSchedule(uint256[] calldata timePoints, uint256[] calldata rates) external onlyOwner {
        if (timePoints.length != rates.length) revert InvalidLength();
        if (timePoints.length == 0) return;

        uint256 prev = emissionSchedule.length == 0 ? 0 : uint256(emissionSchedule[emissionSchedule.length - 1].timePoint);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < timePoints.length; ) {
            if (timePoints[i] < prev) revert InvalidLength();
            emissionSchedule.push(EmissionPoint(uint128(timePoints[i]), uint128(rates[i])));
            prev = timePoints[i];
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }

        emit EmissionScheduleAppended(timePoints, rates);
    }

    function registerRewardDeposit(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        depositedRewards += amount;
        _updateAllPools();
        _recomputeEndingTime();
        if (rewardsPerSecond > lastRPS) lastRPS = rewardsPerSecond;
        emit RewardDeposit(amount);
    }

    function claim(address user, address[] calldata tokens) external whenNotPaused {
        address[] memory memTokens = tokens;
        _claim(user, memTokens, false);
    }

    function claim(address user) external whenNotPaused {
        _enforceWhitelistCaller();
        _claim(user, _allPools(), true);
    }

    function claimAll(address user) external whenNotPaused {
        _claim(user, _allPools(), false);
    }

    function claimWithWhitelist(address user, address[] calldata tokens) external whenNotPaused {
        _enforceWhitelistCaller();
        address[] memory memTokens = tokens;
        _claim(user, memTokens, true);
    }

    function handleActionBefore(address) external {}

    function beforeLockUpdate(address) external {}

    function afterLockUpdate(address user) external {
        if (eligibilityMode != 2) return;
        if (msg.sender != mfd) revert NotAuthorized();
        _refreshEligibility(user);
    }

    function handleActionAfter(address user, uint256 userBalance, uint256 totalSupply_) external whenNotPaused {
        if (!_poolExists[msg.sender] && msg.sender != mfd) revert NotAuthorized();

        if (_poolExists[msg.sender]) {
            _syncEmission();
            _updatePool(msg.sender);

            PoolInfo storage p = poolInfo[msg.sender];
            UserInfo storage u = userInfo[msg.sender][user];

            uint256 accumulated = (u.amount * p.accRewardPerShare) / ACC_REWARD_PRECISION;
            if (accumulated > u.rewardDebt) {
                userBaseClaimable[user] += (accumulated - u.rewardDebt);
            }

            u.amount = userBalance;
            u.rewardDebt = (u.amount * p.accRewardPerShare) / ACC_REWARD_PRECISION;
            p.totalSupply = totalSupply_;

            emit BalanceUpdated(user, msg.sender, userBalance, totalSupply_);

            if (p.onwardIncentives != address(0)) {
                try IOnwardIncentives(p.onwardIncentives).handleAction(user, msg.sender, userBalance, totalSupply_) {} catch {}
            }
        }

        _refreshEligibility(user);
    }

    function claimBounty(address user, bool execute) external whenNotPaused {
        if (msg.sender != bountyManager) revert NotBountyManager();
        if (execute) _refreshEligibility(user);
    }

    function pendingRewards(address user, address[] calldata tokens) external view returns (uint256[] memory out) {
        out = new uint256[](tokens.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; ) {
            _requirePool(tokens[i]);
            out[i] = _pendingFor(user, tokens[i]);
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function allPendingRewards(address user) external view returns (uint256[] memory out) {
        out = new uint256[](registeredTokens.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokens.length; ) {
            out[i] = _pendingFor(user, registeredTokens[i]);
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function hasEligibleDeposits(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokens.length; ) {
            if (userInfo[registeredTokens[i]][user].amount != 0) return true;
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    function endRewardTime() public view returns (uint256) {
        if (endingTime > block.timestamp) return endingTime;
        if (rewardsPerSecond == 0) return type(uint256).max;
        if (depositedRewards <= accountedRewards) return block.timestamp;
        return block.timestamp + (depositedRewards - accountedRewards) / rewardsPerSecond;
    }

    function recoverERC20(address token, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _safeTransfer(token, _owner, amount);
        emit Recovered(token, amount);
    }

    function _claim(address user, address[] memory tokens, bool refresh) internal {
        _syncEmission();

        uint256 total = userBaseClaimable[user];
        userBaseClaimable[user] = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; ) {
            _requirePool(tokens[i]);
            _updatePool(tokens[i]);

            PoolInfo storage p = poolInfo[tokens[i]];
            UserInfo storage u = userInfo[tokens[i]][user];

            uint256 accumulated = (u.amount * p.accRewardPerShare) / ACC_REWARD_PRECISION;
            uint256 pending = u.pending;
            if (accumulated > u.rewardDebt) {
                pending += (accumulated - u.rewardDebt);
            }

            if (pending != 0) {
                total += pending;
                u.pending = 0;
            }

            u.rewardDebt = (u.amount * p.accRewardPerShare) / ACC_REWARD_PRECISION;

            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }

        if (refresh) {
            _refreshEligibility(user);
        }

        if (total != 0) {
            _safeTransfer(rdntToken, user, total);
        }
    }

    function _pendingFor(address user, address token) internal view returns (uint256) {
        PoolInfo storage p = poolInfo[token];
        UserInfo storage u = userInfo[token][user];

        uint256 acc = p.accRewardPerShare;
        uint256 current = block.timestamp;

        if (endingTime != 0 && current > endingTime) current = endingTime;
        if (startTime != 0 && current > startTime) {
            uint256 from = p.lastRewardTime;
            if (from < startTime) from = startTime;

            if (current > from && p.totalSupply != 0 && totalAllocPoint != 0 && rewardsPerSecond != 0) {
                uint256 reward = ((current - from) * rewardsPerSecond * p.allocPoint) / totalAllocPoint;
                acc += (reward * ACC_REWARD_PRECISION) / p.totalSupply;
            }
        }

        uint256 accumulated = (u.amount * acc) / ACC_REWARD_PRECISION;
        if (accumulated >= u.rewardDebt) {
            return u.pending + (accumulated - u.rewardDebt);
        }
        return u.pending;
    }

    function _updateAllPools() internal {
        _syncEmission();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokens.length; ) {
            _updatePool(registeredTokens[i]);
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
        lastAllPoolUpdate = block.timestamp;
    }

    function _updatePool(address token) internal {
        PoolInfo storage p = poolInfo[token];

        uint256 current = block.timestamp;
        if (endingTime != 0 && current > endingTime) current = endingTime;
        if (startTime == 0 || current <= startTime) return;

        uint256 from = p.lastRewardTime;
        if (from < startTime) from = startTime;
        if (current <= from) return;

        if (p.totalSupply == 0 || totalAllocPoint == 0 || rewardsPerSecond == 0) {
            p.lastRewardTime = current;
            return;
        }

        uint256 reward = ((current - from) * rewardsPerSecond * p.allocPoint) / totalAllocPoint;
        accountedRewards += reward;
        p.accRewardPerShare += (reward * ACC_REWARD_PRECISION) / p.totalSupply;
        p.lastRewardTime = current;
    }

    function _syncEmission() internal {
        while (emissionScheduleIndex < emissionSchedule.length) {
            EmissionPoint memory ep = emissionSchedule[emissionScheduleIndex];
            if (block.timestamp < uint256(ep.timePoint)) break;
            rewardsPerSecond = uint256(ep.rate);
            emissionScheduleIndex++;
        }
    }

    function _refreshEligibility(address user) internal {
        if (eligibleDataProvider == address(0) || eligibilityExempt[user]) return;

        bool eligible = true;
        try IEligibilityDataProvider(eligibleDataProvider).refresh(user) returns (bool ok) {
            eligible = ok;
        } catch {
            return;
        }

        if (!eligible) {
            emit Disqualified(user);
            try IEligibilityDataProvider(eligibleDataProvider).setDqTime(user, block.timestamp) {} catch {}
        }
    }

    function _currentRewardTime() internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (startTime == 0) return block.timestamp;
        return block.timestamp < startTime ? startTime : block.timestamp;
    }

    function _recomputeEndingTime() internal {
        if (rewardsPerSecond == 0 || depositedRewards <= accountedRewards) {
            endingTime = block.timestamp;
            return;
        }
        endingTime = block.timestamp + (depositedRewards - accountedRewards) / rewardsPerSecond;
    }

    function _allPools() internal view returns (address[] memory pools) {
        pools = new address[](registeredTokens.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokens.length; ) {
            pools[i] = registeredTokens[i];
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function _enforceWhitelistCaller() internal view {
        if (whitelistActive && !whitelist[msg.sender] && msg.sender != address(this)) {
            revert NotAuthorized();
        }
    }

    function _requirePool(address token) internal view {
        if (!_poolExists[token]) revert PoolDoesNotExist();
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, amount));
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "SAFE_TRANSFER_FAILED");
    }
}
