    event PaymentReceived(address from, uint256 amount);
    event PayeeAdded(address account, uint256 shares);
    event RoyaltiesSet(address receiver, uint256 feeNumerator);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Initialized(uint8 version);

    string private _nameToken;
    string private _symbolToken;
    string private _prefix_;
    string private _suffix_;

    address private _owner;
    mapping(address => bool) private _admins;
    bool private _initialized;

    uint256 private _maxSupply_;
    uint256 private _totalMinted_;

    mapping(uint256 => TokenOwnership) private _ownerships;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;

    address private _royaltyReceiver;
    uint96 private _royaltyFeeBps;

    mapping(uint8 => StageWhitelist) private _stageWL;
    mapping(uint8 => StageBalance) private _stageBal;
    mapping(uint8 => uint256) private _priceByStage;
    uint8 private _stage_;

    uint256 private _totalShares_;
    uint256 private _totalReleasedEth_;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _sharesByPayee;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _releasedEthByPayee;
    address[] private _payees;

    mapping(address => uint256) private _erc20TotalReleased;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _erc20ReleasedByTokenAndPayee;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(_admins[msg.sender] || msg.sender == _owner, "Not admin");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        _admins[msg.sender] = true;
        _nameToken = "Collection";
        _symbolToken = "COLL";
        _suffix_ = ".json";
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    receive() external payable {
        emit PaymentReceived(msg.sender, msg.value);
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert();
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // IERC165
            interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // IERC721
            interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f || // IERC721Metadata
            interfaceId == 0x2a55205a || // IERC2981
            interfaceId == 0x152a902d;   // custom/queryable id seen in runtime
    }

    function initialize(
        bytes32 rootA,
        bytes32 rootB,
        bytes32 rootC,
        address royaltyReceiver_,
        uint256 royaltyBps_,
        address[] calldata payees_,
        uint256[] calldata shares_
    ) external {
        require(!_initialized, "Already initialized");
        if (_owner != address(0)) {
            require(msg.sender == _owner || _admins[msg.sender], "Unauthorized");
        } else {
            _owner = msg.sender;
            emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
        }

        _initialized = true;
        _admins[msg.sender] = true;

        if (bytes(_nameToken).length == 0) _nameToken = "Collection";
        if (bytes(_symbolToken).length == 0) _symbolToken = "COLL";
        if (bytes(_suffix_).length == 0) _suffix_ = ".json";

        _stageWL[2].root = rootA;
        _stageWL[3].root = rootB;
        _stageWL[4].root = rootC;

        _stageBal[1].limit = 2;
        _stageBal[2].limit = 1;
        _stageBal[3].limit = 1;
        _stageBal[4].limit = 1;

        _priceByStage[1] = 0.01 ether;
        _priceByStage[2] = 0.00675 ether;
        _priceByStage[3] = 0;
        _priceByStage[4] = 0.01 ether;

        _stage_ = 1;
        _maxSupply_ = 0;

        _setRoyalties(royaltyReceiver_, royaltyBps_);

        require(payees_.length == shares_.length, "PaymentSplitter: bad input");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < payees_.length; i++) {
            _addPayee(payees_[i], shares_[i]);
        }

        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    function name() external view returns (string memory) { return _nameToken; }
    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) { return _symbolToken; }
    function prefix() external view returns (string memory) { return _prefix_; }
    function suffix() external view returns (string memory) { return _suffix_; }

    function setPrefix(string calldata p) external onlyAdmin { _prefix_ = p; }
    function setSuffix(string calldata s) external onlyAdmin { _suffix_ = s; }

    function owner() external view returns (address) { return _owner; }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        _admins[newOwner] = true;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = address(0);
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, address(0));
    }

    function isAdmin(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _admins[account] || account == _owner;
    }

    function setAdminPermissions(address account, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
        _admins[account] = allowed;
    }

    function setStage(uint8 stageValue) external onlyAdmin {
        _stage_ = stageValue;
    }

    function stage() external view returns (uint8) {
        return _stage_;
    }

    function setPrice(uint8 stageId, uint256 value) external onlyAdmin {
        _priceByStage[stageId] = value;
    }

    function price(uint8 stageId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _priceByStage[stageId];
    }

    function updateBalanceLimit(uint8 stageId, uint256 value) external onlyAdmin {
        _stageBal[stageId].limit = value;
    }

    function balanceLimit(uint8 stageId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stageBal[stageId].limit;
    }

    function updateMerkleTreeRoot(uint8 stageId, bytes32 root) external onlyAdmin {
        _stageWL[stageId].root = root;
    }

    function merkleTreeRoot(uint8 stageId) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _stageWL[stageId].root;
    }

    function addToWhitelist(uint8 stageId, address[] calldata accounts) external onlyAdmin {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _stageWL[stageId].manual[accounts[i]] = true;
        }
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(uint8 stageId, address[] calldata accounts) external onlyAdmin {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _stageWL[stageId].manual[accounts[i]] = false;
        }
    }

    function isWhitelisted(uint8 stageId, address account, bytes32[] calldata proof) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isWhitelisted(stageId, account, proof);
    }

    function currentBalance(uint8 stageId, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stageBal[stageId].minted[account];
    }

    function remainingBalance(uint8 stageId, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 lim = _stageBal[stageId].limit;
        if (lim == 0) return 0;
        uint256 used = _stageBal[stageId].minted[account];
        return used >= lim ? 0 : lim - used;
    }

    function maxSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxSupply_;
    }

    function setMaxSupply(uint256 value) external onlyAdmin {
        require(value >= _totalMinted_, "Exceeds supply");
        _maxSupply_ = value;
    }

    function publicMint(uint256 quantity) external payable {
        bytes32[] memory proof;
        _mintWithStage(msg.sender, quantity, proof, 1);
    }

    function multiStageMint(uint256 quantity, bytes32[] calldata proof, uint8 stageId) external payable {
        _mintWithStage(msg.sender, quantity, proof, stageId);
    }

    function adminMint(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata quantities) external onlyAdmin {
        require(recipients.length == quantities.length, "Admin mint: bad request");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            _mint(recipients[i], quantities[i]);
        }
    }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalMinted_;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "Balance query for zero");
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address o = _ownerships[tokenId].addr;
        require(o != address(0), "Owner query for nonexistent token");
        return o;
    }

    function explicitOwnershipOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (TokenOwnership memory) {
        if (tokenId >= _totalMinted_) return TokenOwnership(address(0), 0, false, 0);
        TokenOwnership memory own = _ownerships[tokenId];
        if (own.addr == address(0)) return TokenOwnership(address(0), 0, false, 0);
        return own;
    }

    function explicitOwnershipsOf(uint256[] calldata tokenIds) external view returns (TokenOwnership[] memory out) {
        out = new TokenOwnership[](tokenIds.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            out[i] = explicitOwnershipOf(tokenIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function tokensOfOwner(address account) external view returns (uint256[] memory ids) {
        uint256 count = _balances[account];
        ids = new uint256[](count);
        if (count == 0) return ids;
        uint256 idx;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _totalMinted_ && idx < count; i++) {
            if (_ownerships[i].addr == account) ids[idx++] = i;
        }
    }

    function tokensOfOwnerIn(address account, uint256 start, uint256 stop) external view returns (uint256[] memory ids) {
        require(start < stop, "InvalidQueryRange");
        if (stop > _totalMinted_) stop = _totalMinted_;
        ids = new uint256[](stop - start);
        uint256 idx;
        for (uint256 i = start; i < stop; i++) {
            if (_ownerships[i].addr == account) ids[idx++] = i;
        }
        assembly { mstore(ids, idx) }
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "URI query for nonexistent token");
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_prefix_, _toString(tokenId), _suffix_));
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(msg.sender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, msg.sender), "Not owner nor approved");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(tokenOwner, to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "Approval query for nonexistent token");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ApproveToCaller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address tokenOwner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        if (_operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][operator]) return true;
        return _proxyApproved(tokenOwner, operator);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "Transfer caller not owner nor approved");
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "Transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "Transfer to zero");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _ownerships[tokenId] = TokenOwnership(to, uint64(block.timestamp), false, 0);
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        transferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "Non ERC721Receiver");
    }

    function setRoyalties(address receiver, uint256 feeNumerator) external onlyAdmin {
        _setRoyalties(receiver, feeNumerator);
    }

    function royaltyInfo(uint256, uint256 salePrice) external view returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount) {
        receiver = _royaltyReceiver;
        royaltyAmount = (salePrice * _royaltyFeeBps) / 10000;
    }

    function totalShares() external view returns (uint256) { return _totalShares_; }
    function totalReleased() external view returns (uint256) { return _totalReleasedEth_; }
    function totalReleased(address token) external view returns (uint256) { return _erc20TotalReleased[token]; }
    function shares(address account) external view returns (uint256) { return _sharesByPayee[account]; }
    function released(address account) external view returns (uint256) { return _releasedEthByPayee[account]; }
    function released(address token, address account) external view returns (uint256) { return _erc20ReleasedByTokenAndPayee[token][account]; }
    function payeesLength() external view returns (uint256) { return _payees.length; }
    function payee(uint256 index) external view returns (address) { return _payees[index]; }

    function releasable(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_totalShares_ == 0) return 0;
        uint256 totalReceived = address(this).balance + _totalReleasedEth_;
        return (totalReceived * _sharesByPayee[account]) / _totalShares_ - _releasedEthByPayee[account];
    }

    function releasable(address token, address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_totalShares_ == 0) return 0;
        uint256 totalReceived = IERC20Minimal(token).balanceOf(address(this)) + _erc20TotalReleased[token];
        return (totalReceived * _sharesByPayee[account]) / _totalShares_ - _erc20ReleasedByTokenAndPayee[token][account];
    }

    function release(address payable account) public {
        require(_sharesByPayee[account] > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account has no shares");
        uint256 payment = releasable(account);
        require(payment > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");

        _releasedEthByPayee[account] += payment;
        _totalReleasedEth_ += payment;

        (bool ok, ) = account.call{value: payment}("");
        require(ok, "Address: unable to send value, recipient may have reverted");

        emit PaymentReleased(account, payment);
    }

    function release(address token, address account) public {
        require(_sharesByPayee[account] > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account has no shares");
        uint256 payment = releasable(token, account);
        require(payment > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");

        _erc20ReleasedByTokenAndPayee[token][account] += payment;
        _erc20TotalReleased[token] += payment;

        require(IERC20Minimal(token).transfer(account, payment), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        emit ERC20PaymentReleased(token, account, payment);
    }

    function releaseAll() external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _payees.length; i++) {
            address payable p = payable(_payees[i]);
            uint256 due = releasable(p);
            if (due > 0) release(p);
        }
    }

    function releaseAll(address token) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _payees.length; i++) {
            address p = _payees[i];
            uint256 due = releasable(token, p);
            if (due > 0) release(token, p);
        }
    }

    function _mintWithStage(address to, uint256 quantity, bytes32[] memory proof, uint8 stageId) internal {
        require(quantity > 0, "MintZeroQuantity");
        require(tx.origin == msg.sender, "No bots");
        require(_stageEnabled(stageId), "Current stage is not enabled");

        StageBalance storage sb = _stageBal[stageId];
        if (sb.limit > 0) {
            require(sb.minted[to] + quantity <= sb.limit, "Balance limit");
            sb.minted[to] += quantity;
        }

        if (_stageWL[stageId].root != bytes32(0) || _stageWL[stageId].manual[to] || proof.length > 0) {
            require(_isWhitelisted(stageId, to, proof), "Not whitelisted");
        }

        uint256 cost = _priceByStage[stageId] * quantity;
        require(msg.value >= cost, "Insufficient payment");
        if (msg.value > cost) {
            (bool ok, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: msg.value - cost}("");
            require(ok, "Refund failed");
        }

        _mint(to, quantity);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 quantity) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "Mint to zero");
        require(quantity > 0, "MintZeroQuantity");
        if (_maxSupply_ != 0) {
            require(_totalMinted_ + quantity <= _maxSupply_, "Exceeds supply");
        }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _totalMinted_;
            _totalMinted_++;
            _ownerships[tokenId] = TokenOwnership(to, uint64(block.timestamp), false, 0);
            _balances[to] += 1;
            emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _setRoyalties(address receiver, uint256 feeNumerator) internal {
        require(receiver != address(0), "Royalty receiver zero");
        require(feeNumerator <= 10000, "Royalties: value is too high");
        _royaltyReceiver = receiver;
        _royaltyFeeBps = uint96(feeNumerator);
        emit RoyaltiesSet(receiver, feeNumerator);
    }

    function _addPayee(address account, uint256 shares_) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "PaymentSplitter: account is the zero address");
        require(shares_ > 0, "PaymentSplitter: shares are 0");
        require(_sharesByPayee[account] == 0, "PaymentSplitter: account already has shares");

        _payees.push(account);
        _sharesByPayee[account] = shares_;
        _totalShares_ += shares_;

        emit PayeeAdded(account, shares_);
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _ownerships[tokenId].addr != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == tokenOwner || getApproved(tokenId) == spender || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, spender));
    }

    function _stageEnabled(uint8 s) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (s == 0) return false;
        return _stage_ == s || ((_stage_ & s) == s);
    }

    function _isWhitelisted(uint8 stageId, address account, bytes32[] memory proof) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (_stageWL[stageId].manual[account]) return true;
        bytes32 root = _stageWL[stageId].root;
        if (root == bytes32(0)) return false;
        return _verify(proof, root, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account)));
    }

    function _verify(bytes32[] memory proof, bytes32 root, bytes32 leaf) internal pure returns (bool) {
        bytes32 computed = leaf;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            bytes32 p = proof[i];
            computed = computed <= p ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(computed, p)) : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(p, computed));
        }
        return computed == root;
    }

    function _proxyApproved(address tokenOwner, address operator) internal view returns (bool) {
        address registry = _proxyRegistryAddress(block.chainid);
        if (registry == address(0)) return false;
        try IProxyRegistry(registry).proxies(tokenOwner) returns (address proxy) {
            return proxy == operator;
        } catch {
            return false;
        }
    }

    function _proxyRegistryAddress(uint256 cid) internal pure returns (address) {
        if (cid == 1) return 0xa5409ec958C83C3f309868babACA7c86DCB077c1;
        if (cid == 137) return 0x58807BaD0B376efc12F5AD86aAc70e78ed67deAE;
        if (cid == 4) return 0xF57B2c51dEd3A29e6891abA85459d600256CF317;
        if (cid == 80001) return 0xFF7Ca10Af37178BDd056628EF42fD7f799FaC77c;
        if (cid == 1337) return 0xE1A2BbC877B29AdBC56D2659DBCb0Ae14ee62071;
        return address(0);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;
        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch {
            return false;
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory str) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            unchecked { digits++; }
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            unchecked {
                digits--;
                buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (value % 10)));
            }
            value /= 10;
        }
        str = string(buffer);
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

interface IERC721Receiver {
    function onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
}

interface IERC20Minimal {
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
}

interface IOperatorFilterRegistry {
    function isOperatorAllowed(address registrant, address operator) external view returns (bool);
}

interface IOldGods {
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address);
    function isSloth(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool);
}

contract ElderGods {
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    event NFTListedForRent(uint256 tokenId, uint64 minDuration, uint64 maxDuration, uint256 price, address paymentToken);
    event NFTDeletedFromRent(uint256 tokenId);
    event BidPlaced(uint256 tokenId, uint256 price, uint64 minDuration, uint64 maxDuration, uint256 bidId, address paymentToken);
    event BidDeleted(uint256 tokenId);
    event UpdateUser(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed user, uint64 expires);

    struct UserInfo {
        address user;
        uint64 expires;
    }

    struct RentableItem {
        uint256 price;
        uint64 minDuration;
        uint64 maxDuration;
        address paymentToken;
        address lender;
    }

    struct RentBid {
        uint256 price;
        uint64 minDuration;
        uint64 maxDuration;
        address paymentToken;
        address bidder;
    }

    string private _nameValue;
    string private _symbolValue;
    string private _baseURIValue;
    string private _baseExtensionValue;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;

    uint256[] private _allTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _allTokensIndex;
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _ownedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex;

    address private _owner;
    uint256 private _status;

    address public OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY;
    address public treasury;
    address public ELDERGODS_old;
    address public constant WETH = 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0E5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2;

    mapping(address => bool) public allowedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => bool) private _isSloth;
    mapping(uint256 => UserInfo) private _users;
    mapping(uint256 => RentableItem) private _rentableItems;
    mapping(uint256 => RentBid) private _rentBids;

    uint256 public godsFee;
    uint256 public rentBidsCounter;
    bool public canRent;

    uint256 private _airdropCursor;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_status != 2, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _status = 2;
        _;
        _status = 1;
    }

    modifier rentEnabled() {
        require(canRent, "GODS: Rent is currently disabled");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _nameValue = "ELDERGODS";
        _symbolValue = "GODS";
        _baseExtensionValue = ".json";

        _owner = msg.sender;
        treasury = msg.sender;
        _status = 1;

        canRent = true;
        allowedTokens[WETH] = true;

        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert("Invalid call");
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert("Invalid call");
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // ERC165
            interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // ERC721
            interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f || // ERC721Metadata
            interfaceId == 0x780e9d63 || // ERC721Enumerable
            interfaceId == 0x2b424ad7;   // custom/user interface
    }

    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _nameValue;
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbolValue;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC721: address zero is not a valid owner");
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address o = _owners[tokenId];
        require(o != address(0), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return o;
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");

    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address account, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _balances[account], "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[account][index];
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        ownerOf(tokenId);
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address tokenOwner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][operator];
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != tokenOwner, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(

        _checkOperatorAllowed(to);
        _approve(to, tokenId);
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        if (approved) _checkOperatorAllowed(operator);
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner or approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        transferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (bytes(_baseURIValue).length == 0) return "";
        return string.concat(_baseURIValue, _toString(tokenId), _baseExtensionValue);
    }

    function setBaseURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external onlyOwner {
        _baseURIValue = newBaseURI;
    }

    function setBaseExtension(string calldata newExtension) external onlyOwner {
        _baseExtensionValue = newExtension;
    }

    function changeOperatorFilterRegistryAddress(address registry) external onlyOwner {
        OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY = registry;
    }

    function changeTreasuryAddress(address newTreasury) external onlyOwner {
        treasury = newTreasury;
    }

        uint256 cursor = _airdropCursor;

        if (ELDERGODS_old == address(0)) {
            while (minted < amount) {
                cursor++;
                _mint(treasury, cursor);
                _isSloth[cursor] = true;
                minted++;
            }
        } else {
            uint256 maxSupply = getEldersSupply();
            while (minted < amount && cursor < maxSupply) {
                cursor++;
                if (_owners[cursor] != address(0)) continue;

                address to;
                try IOldGods(ELDERGODS_old).ownerOf(cursor) returns (address o) {
                    to = o;
                } catch {
                    to = treasury;

                if (to == address(0)) to = treasury;

                _mint(to, cursor);

                try IOldGods(ELDERGODS_old).isSloth(cursor) returns (bool s) {

        if (ret.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");

        address registry = OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY;

        return (
            spender == tokenOwner ||
            _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender ||
            _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][spender]

    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");

        delete _tokenApprovals[tokenId];

        _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);

        unchecked {

            _balances[to] += 1;
        }
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        if (_users[tokenId].user != address(0)) {
            delete _users[tokenId];
            emit UpdateUser(tokenId, address(0), 0);
        }

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(_owners[tokenId] == address(0), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        _balances[to] += 1;

        _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 length = _balances[to] == 0 ? 0 : _balances[to] - 1;
        _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _balances[from] - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;
        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch {
            revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) private pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            unchecked {
                digits++;
                temp /= 10;

        }

            unchecked {
                digits -= 1;
                buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
                value /= 10;
            }
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

        return _numberOfLeavingNodes;

    function numberOfLeftNodes() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _numberOfLeftNodes;

        uint256 count;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _nodes.length; i++) {
            if (_nodes[i].exists && _nodes[i].status == 0) count++;
        }

        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](count);
        uint256 j;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _nodes.length; i++) {
            if (_nodes[i].exists && _nodes[i].status == 0) {
                ids[j++] = i;
            }
        }
        return ids;
    }

    function getActiveNodesByAddress() external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256[] storage all = _nodesByAddress[msg.sender];
        uint256 count;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
            uint256 id = all[i];
            if (id < _nodes.length && _nodes[id].exists && _nodes[id].status == 0) count++;
        }

        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](count);
        uint256 j;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
            uint256 id = all[i];
            if (id < _nodes.length && _nodes[id].exists && _nodes[id].status == 0) {
                ids[j++] = id;
            }
        }
        return ids;

    function getActiveNodeIPs() external view returns (bytes4[] memory) {
        uint256 count;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _nodes.length; i++) {

        bytes4[] memory ips = new bytes4[](count);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _nodes.length; i++) {

    function getNodesWithFreeSpace(uint8 space) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _spaceToNodes[space];

    function countNodesWithFreeSpace(uint8 space) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _spaceToNodes[space].length;
    }

    function checkPossibilityCreatingNode(address nodeAddress) external view {
        require(nodeAddress != address(0), "Message sender is invalid");
        require(!_hasNodeForAddress[nodeAddress], "Node does not exist for this Validator");

        if (nodeId >= _nodes.length) return false;
        NodeData storage n = _nodes[nodeId];
        if (!n.exists) return false;
        return n.validatorId == validatorId && n.status == 0;

    function initExit(uint256 nodeId) external returns (bool) {
        NodeData storage n = _node(nodeId);
        require(
            msg.sender == n.nodeAddress || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender),
            "Message sender is invalid"

        require(n.status == 0, "Node should be Active");

        uint8 oldFree = _freeSpace(n);
        n.finishTime = block.timestamp + _nodeCreationWindowSeconds;
        _setStatus(nodeId, 2);
        _removeFromArray(_spaceToNodes[oldFree], nodeId);

        emit ExitInitialized(nodeId, n.finishTime, block.timestamp, n.validatorId);
        return true;
    }

    function completeExit(uint256 nodeId) external returns (bool) {
        NodeData storage n = _node(nodeId);
        require(
            msg.sender == n.nodeAddress || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender),
            "Message sender is invalid"
        );
        require(n.status == 2, "Node is not Leaving");
        require(block.timestamp >= n.finishTime, "Node is not Leaving");

        _setStatus(nodeId, 3);
        _hasNodeForAddress[n.nodeAddress] = false;
        delete _nodeIndexes[n.nodeAddress];

        emit ExitCompleted(nodeId, block.timestamp, n.validatorId);
        return true;
    }

    function setNodeInMaintenance(uint256 nodeId) external onlyAuthorized {
        NodeData storage n = _node(nodeId);
        require(n.status == 0, "Node is not Active");
        uint8 oldFree = _freeSpace(n);
        _setStatus(nodeId, 1);
        _removeFromArray(_spaceToNodes[oldFree], nodeId);
    }

    function removeNodeFromInMaintenance(uint256 nodeId) external onlyAuthorized {
        NodeData storage n = _node(nodeId);
        require(n.status == 1, "Node is not In Maintenance");
        _setStatus(nodeId, 0);
        _spaceToNodes[_freeSpace(n)].push(nodeId);
    }

    function changeNodeLastRewardDate(uint256 nodeId) external onlyAuthorized {
        _node(nodeId).lastRewardDate = block.timestamp;
    }

    function changeNodeFinishTime(uint256 nodeId, uint256 finishTime) external onlyAuthorized {
        _node(nodeId).finishTime = finishTime;
    }

    function addSpaceToNode(uint256 nodeId, uint8 amount) external onlyAuthorized {
        NodeData storage n = _node(nodeId);
        uint8 beforeFree = _freeSpace(n);
        if (amount >= n.usedSpace) {
            n.usedSpace = 0;
        } else {
            n.usedSpace -= amount;
        }
        _moveSpaceBucket(nodeId, beforeFree, _freeSpace(n));
    }

    function removeSpaceFromNode(uint256 nodeId, uint8 amount) external onlyAuthorized returns (bool) {
        NodeData storage n = _node(nodeId);
        uint8 beforeFree = _freeSpace(n);
        if (amount > beforeFree) {
            return false;
        }
        n.usedSpace += amount;
        _moveSpaceBucket(nodeId, beforeFree, _freeSpace(n));
        return true;
    }

    function deleteNodeForValidator(uint256 validatorId, uint256 nodeId) external onlyAuthorized {
        NodeData storage n = _node(nodeId);
        require(n.validatorId == validatorId, "Validator ID does not exist");

        _removeFromArray(_validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId], nodeId);

        uint8 oldFree = _freeSpace(n);
        _removeFromArray(_spaceToNodes[oldFree], nodeId);

        if (n.status != 3) {
            _setStatus(nodeId, 3);
        }

        _hasNodeForAddress[n.nodeAddress] = false;
        delete _nodeIndexes[n.nodeAddress];
    }

    function populateBountyV2(uint256 nodeId, uint256 bountyPeriodSeconds) external onlyAuthorized {
        require(bountyPeriodSeconds > 0, "Message sender is invalid");
        _bountyPeriodSeconds = bountyPeriodSeconds;
        _node(nodeId).lastRewardDate = block.timestamp;
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) return;
        _roles[role].members[account] = true;
        _roles[role].memberList.push(account);
        _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account] = _roles[role].memberList.length;
        emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) return;
        _roles[role].members[account] = false;

        uint256 indexPlusOne = _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account];
        if (indexPlusOne > 0) {
            uint256 idx = indexPlusOne - 1;
            uint256 last = _roles[role].memberList.length - 1;
            if (idx != last) {
                address lastAcc = _roles[role].memberList[last];
                _roles[role].memberList[idx] = lastAcc;
                _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[lastAcc] = indexPlusOne;
            }
            _roles[role].memberList.pop();
            delete _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account];
        }

        emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _setStatus(uint256 nodeId, uint8 newStatus) internal {
        NodeData storage n = _nodes[nodeId];
        uint8 old = n.status;
        if (old == newStatus) return;

        if (old == 0) _numberOfActiveNodes -= 1;
        else if (old == 2) _numberOfLeavingNodes -= 1;
        else if (old == 3) _numberOfLeftNodes -= 1;

        if (newStatus == 0) _numberOfActiveNodes += 1;
        else if (newStatus == 2) _numberOfLeavingNodes += 1;
        else if (newStatus == 3) _numberOfLeftNodes += 1;

        n.status = newStatus;
    }

    function _node(uint256 nodeId) internal view returns (NodeData storage) {
        require(nodeId < _nodes.length && _nodes[nodeId].exists, "Node with such index does not exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId];
    }

    function _freeSpace(NodeData storage n) internal view returns (uint8) {
        if (n.totalSpace <= n.usedSpace) {
            return 0;
        }
        return uint8(n.totalSpace - n.usedSpace);
    }

    function _moveSpaceBucket(uint256 nodeId, uint8 fromBucket, uint8 toBucket) internal {
        if (fromBucket == toBucket) return;
        _removeFromArray(_spaceToNodes[fromBucket], nodeId);
        _spaceToNodes[toBucket].push(nodeId);
    }

    function _removeFromArray(uint256[] storage arr, uint256 value) internal returns (bool) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == value) {
                arr[i] = arr[arr.length - 1];
                arr.pop();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

    mapping(uint256 => string) private _tokenURIOverride;

    address private _owner;
    bool private _paused;

    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;
    string private _baseURI;
    string private _contractURIValue;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyRole(bytes32 role) {
        _checkRole(role, msg.sender);
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOperatorOrAdmin() {
        require(
            hasRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE_VALUE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE, msg.sender),
            "Caller does not have permission"
        );
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        _name = "Habibi";
        _symbol = "HABIBI";
        _roles[DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE].adminRole = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE;
        _roles[HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE_VALUE].adminRole = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE;
        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE, msg.sender);
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // IERC165
            interfaceId == 0xd9b67a26 || // IERC1155
            interfaceId == 0x0e89341c || // IERC1155MetadataURI
            interfaceId == 0x7965db0b || // IAccessControl
            interfaceId == 0x6cdb3d13 ||
            interfaceId == 0x03a24d07;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function setOwner(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = address(0);
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, address(0));
    }

    function pause() external onlyOwner {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _paused = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner {
        require(_paused, "Pausable: not paused");
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function name_() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function symbol_() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function setURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external onlyOwner {
        _baseURI = newBaseURI;
    }

    function setContractURI(string calldata newContractURI) external onlyOwner {
        _contractURIValue = newContractURI;
    }

    function contractURI() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _contractURIValue;
    }

    function _contractURI() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _contractURIValue;
    }

    function uri(uint256 id) public view returns (string memory) {
        string memory ov = _tokenURIOverride[id];
        if (bytes(ov).length > 0) return ov;
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_baseURI, id.toString()));
    }

    function balanceOf(address account, uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC1155: balance query for the zero address");
        return _balances[id][account];
    }

    function balanceOfBatch(address[] calldata accounts, uint256[] calldata ids) external view returns (uint256[] memory result) {
        require(accounts.length == ids.length, "ERC1155: accounts and ids length mismatch");
        result = new uint256[](accounts.length);
        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ) {
            result[i] = balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i]);
            unchecked { ++i; }
        }
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address account, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[account][operator];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(msg.sender != operator, "ERC1155: setting approval status for self");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) external {
        require(from == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, from, to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function safeBatchTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256[] calldata ids, uint256[] calldata amounts, bytes calldata data) external {
        require(from == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeBatchTransferFrom(msg.sender, from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function totalSupply(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSupply[id];
    }

    function getTokenSupply(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {

    }

    function exists(uint256 id) external view returns (bool) {
        return _totalSupply[id] > 0;
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _mint(to, id, amount, "");
    }

    function mintBatch(address to, uint256[] calldata ids, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyOwner {
        _mintBatch(to, ids, amounts, "");
    }

    function burn(address from, uint256 id, uint256 amount) external {
        require(from == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burn(from, id, amount);
    }

    function burnBatch(address from, uint256[] calldata ids, uint256[] calldata amounts) external {
        require(from == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burnBatch(from, ids, amounts);
    }

    function burnFromRedeem(address from, uint256 passId, uint256 amount) external {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)];
        require(msg.sender == mp.redeemContract, "Burnable: Only allowed from redeem");
        uint256 tokenId = mp.tokenId == 0 ? passId : mp.tokenId;
        _burn(from, tokenId, amount);
    }

    function DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE() external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE;
    }

    function HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE() external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE_VALUE;
    }

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members[account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 admin = _roles[role].adminRole;
        if (admin == bytes32(0)) return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE;
        return admin;
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) external onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) external onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function promoteTeamMember(address account) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE) {
        _grantRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE_VALUE, account);
    }

    function demoteTeamMember(address account) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE) {
        _revokeRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE_VALUE, account);
    }

    function addMintPass(
        bytes32 passId,
        uint256 tokenId,
        uint256 openTime,
        uint256 closeTime,
        uint256 unitPrice,
        uint256 maxSupply,
        string calldata metadata,
        address redeemContract,
        uint256 maxPerTx
    ) external onlyOperatorOrAdmin {
        require(openTime < closeTime, "addMintPass: open window must be before close window");
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[passId];
        require(!mp.exists, "Mint pass already exists");

        mp.exists = true;
        mp.saleOpen = false;
        mp.isDutch = false;
        mp.tokenId = tokenId;
        mp.openTime = openTime;
        mp.closeTime = closeTime;
        mp.unitPrice = unitPrice;
        mp.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        mp.maxPerTx = maxPerTx;
        mp.minted = 0;
        mp.metadata = metadata;
        mp.redeemContract = redeemContract;
        mp.whitelistMaxClaim = 0;

        _tokenURIOverride[tokenId] = metadata;
    }

    function editMintPass(
        bytes32 passId,
        uint256 tokenId,
        uint256 openTime,
        uint256 closeTime,
        uint256 unitPrice,
        uint256 maxSupply,
        string calldata metadata,
        address redeemContract,
        uint256 maxPerTx,
        bool saleOpen_,
        uint256 whitelistMaxClaim
    ) external onlyOperatorOrAdmin {
        require(openTime < closeTime, "editMintPass: open window must be before close window");
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[passId];
        require(mp.exists, "Claim: Mint pass does not exist");
        require(maxSupply >= mp.minted, "No supply remaining");

        mp.tokenId = tokenId;
        mp.openTime = openTime;
        mp.closeTime = closeTime;
        mp.unitPrice = unitPrice;
        mp.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        mp.maxPerTx = maxPerTx;
        mp.metadata = metadata;
        mp.redeemContract = redeemContract;
        mp.saleOpen = saleOpen_;
        mp.whitelistMaxClaim = whitelistMaxClaim;

        _tokenURIOverride[tokenId] = metadata;
    }

    function editMintPassWhiteListMerkleRoot(bytes32 passId, uint256 newMerkleRoot) external onlyOperatorOrAdmin {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[passId];
        require(mp.exists, "Claim: Mint pass does not exist");
        mp.merkleRoot = bytes32(newMerkleRoot);
    }

    function setDutchAuctionSettings(
        uint256 passId,
        bool enabled,
        uint256 startPrice,
        uint256 floorPrice,
        uint256 dropPerStep,
        uint256 stepSeconds,
        uint256 startTime
    ) external onlyOperatorOrAdmin {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)];
        require(mp.exists, "Claim: Mint pass does not exist");
        if (enabled) {
            require(stepSeconds > 0, "Sale is not a dutch auction");
            require(startPrice >= floorPrice, "Payment amount is incorrect");
        }
        mp.isDutch = enabled;
        mp.dutchStartPrice = startPrice;
        mp.dutchFloorPrice = floorPrice;
        mp.dutchDropPerStep = dropPerStep;
        mp.dutchStepSeconds = stepSeconds;
        if (startTime != 0) mp.openTime = startTime;
    }

    function turnSaleOn(uint256 passId) external onlyOperatorOrAdmin {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)];
        require(mp.exists, "Claim: Mint pass does not exist");
        mp.saleOpen = true;
    }

    function turnSaleOff(uint256 passId) external onlyOperatorOrAdmin {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)];
        require(mp.exists, "Claim: Mint pass does not exist");
        mp.saleOpen = false;
    }

    function isSaleOpen(uint256 passId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)].saleOpen;
    }

    function getRemainingPassSupply(uint256 passId) public view returns (uint256) {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)];
        if (!mp.exists || mp.minted >= mp.maxSupply) return 0;
        return mp.maxSupply - mp.minted;
    }

    function getClaimedMps(uint256 passId, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _claimedMps[_passKey(passId)][account];
    }

    function mintPasses(uint256 passId) external view returns (MintPassView memory pass) {
        bytes32 key = _passKey(passId);
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[key];
        pass = MintPassView({
            exists: mp.exists,
            saleOpen: mp.saleOpen,
            isDutch: mp.isDutch,
            tokenId: mp.tokenId,
            openTime: mp.openTime,
            closeTime: mp.closeTime,
            unitPrice: mp.unitPrice,
            maxSupply: mp.maxSupply,
            maxPerTx: mp.maxPerTx,
            minted: mp.minted,
            merkleRoot: mp.merkleRoot,
            metadata: mp.metadata,
            redeemContract: mp.redeemContract,
            whitelistMaxClaim: mp.whitelistMaxClaim,
            dutchStartPrice: mp.dutchStartPrice,
            dutchFloorPrice: mp.dutchFloorPrice,
            dutchStepSeconds: mp.dutchStepSeconds,
            dutchDropPerStep: mp.dutchDropPerStep,
            claimedByCaller: _claimedMps[key][msg.sender]
        });
    }

    function getPrice(uint256 passId) public view returns (uint256) {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)];
        if (!mp.isDutch) return mp.unitPrice;

        if (block.timestamp <= mp.openTime) return mp.dutchStartPrice;
        if (mp.dutchStepSeconds == 0) return mp.dutchFloorPrice;
        if (mp.dutchStartPrice <= mp.dutchFloorPrice) return mp.dutchFloorPrice;

        uint256 steps = (block.timestamp - mp.openTime) / mp.dutchStepSeconds;
        uint256 discount = steps * mp.dutchDropPerStep;
        uint256 raw = mp.dutchStartPrice > discount ? mp.dutchStartPrice - discount : 0;
        return raw < mp.dutchFloorPrice ? mp.dutchFloorPrice : raw;
    }

    function getRemainingTimeBeforeNextPricingChange(uint256 passId) external view returns (uint256) {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)];
        require(mp.isDutch, "Sale is not a dutch auction");
        if (block.timestamp < mp.openTime) return mp.openTime - block.timestamp;
        if (block.timestamp >= mp.closeTime || mp.dutchStepSeconds == 0) return 0;

        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - mp.openTime;
        uint256 nextStep = mp.openTime + ((elapsed / mp.dutchStepSeconds) + 1) * mp.dutchStepSeconds;
        if (nextStep > mp.closeTime) return 0;
        return nextStep - block.timestamp;
    }

    function getDutchTiers(uint256 passId) external view returns (uint256[] memory timestamps, uint256[] memory prices) {
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)];
        require(mp.isDutch, "Sale is not a dutch auction");
        require(mp.dutchStepSeconds > 0, "Sale is not a dutch auction");

        uint256 steps = 1;
        if (mp.closeTime > mp.openTime) {
            steps = ((mp.closeTime - mp.openTime) / mp.dutchStepSeconds) + 1;
        }
        if (steps > 256) steps = 256;

        timestamps = new uint256[](steps);
        prices = new uint256[](steps);

        for (uint256 i; i < steps; ) {
            uint256 ts = mp.openTime + (i * mp.dutchStepSeconds);
            uint256 discount = i * mp.dutchDropPerStep;
            uint256 p = mp.dutchStartPrice > discount ? mp.dutchStartPrice - discount : 0;
            if (p < mp.dutchFloorPrice) p = mp.dutchFloorPrice;
            timestamps[i] = ts;
            prices[i] = p;
            unchecked { ++i; }
        }
    }

    function makeLeaf(address account, uint256 quantity) public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account, quantity));
    }

    function verifyMerkleProof(bytes32[] calldata proof, uint256 passId, uint256 quantity) public view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 root = _mintPasses[_passKey(passId)].merkleRoot;
        return _verifyCalldata(proof, root, makeLeaf(msg.sender, quantity));
    }

    function claim(uint256 passId, uint256 quantity, uint256 allowedAmount, bytes32[] calldata proof) external payable {
        uint256 unit = _processClaim(passId, quantity, allowedAmount, proof, msg.sender);
        uint256 cost = unit * quantity;
        require(msg.value >= cost, "Payment amount is incorrect");
        _refundExcess(cost);
    }

    function claimMultiple(
        uint256[] calldata passIds,
        uint256[] calldata quantities,
        uint256[] calldata allowedAmounts,
        bytes32[][] calldata proofs
    ) external payable {
        require(
            passIds.length == quantities.length &&
            quantities.length == allowedAmounts.length &&
            allowedAmounts.length == proofs.length,
            "One or more claims are invalid"
        );

        uint256 totalCost;
        for (uint256 i; i < passIds.length; ) {
            uint256 unit = _processClaim(passIds[i], quantities[i], allowedAmounts[i], proofs[i], msg.sender);
            totalCost += unit * quantities[i];
            unchecked { ++i; }
        }

        require(msg.value >= totalCost, "Payment amount is incorrect");
        _refundExcess(totalCost);
        emit ClaimedMultiple(passIds, msg.sender, quantities);
    }

    function withdrawEther(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(to != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Payment amount is incorrect");
        (bool ok, ) = payable(to).call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "Error returning excess payment");
    }

    function _processClaim(
        uint256 passId,
        uint256 quantity,
        uint256 allowedAmount,
        bytes32[] calldata proof,
        address claimant
    ) internal returns (uint256 unitPrice) {
        bytes32 key = _passKey(passId);
        MintPassData storage mp = _mintPasses[key];

        require(mp.exists, "Claim: Mint pass does not exist");
        require(mp.saleOpen, "Caller does not have permission");
        require(block.timestamp >= mp.openTime && block.timestamp <= mp.closeTime, "Claim: time window closed");
        require(quantity > 0, "Claim: window cannot be 0");
        if (mp.maxPerTx > 0) require(quantity <= mp.maxPerTx, "Max quantity per transaction exceeded");
        require(mp.minted + quantity <= mp.maxSupply, "Purchase would exceed max supply");

        uint256 already = _claimedMps[key][claimant];
        if (mp.merkleRoot != bytes32(0)) {
            require(_verifyCalldata(proof, mp.merkleRoot, makeLeaf(claimant, allowedAmount)), "MerkleDistributor: Invalid proof");
            require(already + quantity <= allowedAmount, "Claim: Not allowed to claim given amount");
        }
        if (mp.whitelistMaxClaim > 0) {
            require(already + quantity <= mp.whitelistMaxClaim, "Claim: Not allowed to claim that many");
        }

        _claimedMps[key][claimant] = already + quantity;
        mp.minted += quantity;

        unitPrice = getPrice(passId);
        uint256 tokenId = mp.tokenId == 0 ? passId : mp.tokenId;
        _mint(claimant, tokenId, quantity, "");
        emit Claimed(passId, claimant, quantity);
    }

    function _refundExcess(uint256 cost) internal {
        if (msg.value > cost) {
            (bool ok, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: msg.value - cost}("");
            require(ok, "Error returning excess payment");
        }
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address operator, address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(!_paused, "ERC1155Pausable: token transfer while paused");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");

        uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
        require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: insufficient balance for transfer");

        unchecked {
            _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
        }
        _balances[id][to] += amount;

        emit TransferSingle(operator, from, to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(operator, from, to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _safeBatchTransferFrom(
        address operator,
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256[] memory ids,
        uint256[] memory amounts,
        bytes memory data
    ) internal {
        require(!_paused, "ERC1155Pausable: token transfer while paused");
        require(ids.length == amounts.length, "ERC1155: ids and amounts length mismatch");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");

        for (uint256 i; i < ids.length; ) {
            uint256 id = ids[i];
            uint256 amount = amounts[i];
            uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
            require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: insufficient balance for transfer");
            unchecked {
                _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
            }
            _balances[id][to] += amount;
            unchecked { ++i; }
        }

        emit TransferBatch(operator, from, to, ids, amounts);
        _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(operator, from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(!_paused, "ERC1155Pausable: token transfer while paused");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");

        _balances[id][to] += amount;
        _totalSupply[id] += amount;

        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, address(0), to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, address(0), to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _mintBatch(address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(!_paused, "ERC1155Pausable: token transfer while paused");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");
        require(ids.length == amounts.length, "ERC1155: ids and amounts length mismatch");

        for (uint256 i; i < ids.length; ) {
            _balances[ids[i]][to] += amounts[i];
            _totalSupply[ids[i]] += amounts[i];
            unchecked { ++i; }
        }

        emit TransferBatch(msg.sender, address(0), to, ids, amounts);
        _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, address(0), to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(!_paused, "ERC1155Pausable: token transfer while paused");
        require(from != address(0), "ERC1155: burn from the zero address");

        uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
        require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");

        unchecked {
            _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
            _totalSupply[id] -= amount;
        }

        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, from, address(0), id, amount);
    }

    function _burnBatch(address from, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts) internal {
        require(!_paused, "ERC1155Pausable: token transfer while paused");
        require(from != address(0), "ERC1155: burn from the zero address");
        require(ids.length == amounts.length, "ERC1155: ids and amounts length mismatch");

        for (uint256 i; i < ids.length; ) {
            uint256 id = ids[i];
            uint256 amount = amounts[i];
            uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
            require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");
            unchecked {
                _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
                _totalSupply[id] -= amount;
                ++i;
            }
        }

        emit TransferBatch(msg.sender, from, address(0), ids, amounts);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            if (_roles[role].adminRole == bytes32(0)) {
                _roles[role].adminRole = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE_VALUE;
            }
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view {
        require(hasRole(role, account), "Caller does not have required role");
    }

    function _verifyCalldata(bytes32[] calldata proof, bytes32 root, bytes32 leaf) internal pure returns (bool) {
        bytes32 computedHash = leaf;
        for (uint256 i; i < proof.length; ) {
            bytes32 proofElement = proof[i];
            computedHash = computedHash <= proofElement
                ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(computedHash, proofElement))
                : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(proofElement, computedHash));
            unchecked { ++i; }
        }
        return computedHash == root;
    }

    function _passKey(uint256 passId) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return bytes32(passId);
    }

    function _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(
        address operator,
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 id,
        uint256 value,
        bytes memory data
    ) internal {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155Received(operator, from, id, value, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");
            } catch Error(string memory reason) {
                revert(reason);
            } catch {
                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");
            }
        }
    }

    function _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(
        address operator,
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256[] memory ids,
        uint256[] memory values,
        bytes memory data
    ) internal {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155BatchReceived(operator, from, ids, values, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155BatchReceived.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");
            } catch Error(string memory reason) {
                revert(reason);
            } catch {
                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");
            }

        if (nextTargetPrice >= currentTargetPrice) {

        }

        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");

        _requireTransferAllowed(from, to, amount);

        uint256 fromBal = _balances[from];
        require(fromBal >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        unchecked {

        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");
        _requireTransferAllowed(address(0), to, amount);

        _totalSupply += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);

        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: burn from the zero address");
        _requireTransferAllowed(from, address(0), amount);

        }
    }

        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);

    function _requireTransferAllowed(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        address approver = transferApprover;
        if (approver != address(0)) {
            bool ok = ITransferApprover(approver).checkTransfer(from, to, amount);
            if (!ok) revert TransferNotAllowed();
        }
    }

    function _toMinterData(Minter storage m) internal view returns (MinterData memory) {
        return MinterData(m.maxAmount, m.mintedAmount, m.isValid, m.isEnabled);
    }

    function _applyRate(uint256 basePrice, int256 rate) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        int256 next = int256(basePrice) + (int256(basePrice) * rate) / int256(10_000_000_000);
        return next <= 0 ? 0 : uint256(next);
    }

        _callTarget(swapTarget, msg.value, swapData);
        uint256 received = address(this).balance - beforeNative;

        _callTarget(swapTarget, msg.value, swapData);

    }

        _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(newImplementation, data, true);
    }

            _setImplementation(newImplementation);
        } else {

            _setImplementation(newImplementation);

        }

        require(newImplementation.code.length > 0, "ERC1967: new implementation is not a contract");
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {

        }

        uint256 v;
        assembly {
            v := sload(slot)
        }
        value = (v != 0);

        if (fee > amount) fee = amount;

        address referral = _referral(user);
        uint256 referralFee = _protocolReferralFee(fee);
        if (referralFee > fee) referralFee = fee;

        if (referral != address(0) && referralFee > 0) {
            _safeTransfer(token, referral, referralFee);
        }

        address treasury = _feeAddress();
        uint256 protocolFee = fee - referralFee;
        if (treasury != address(0) && protocolFee > 0) {
            _safeTransfer(token, treasury, protocolFee);
        }

        return amount - fee;
    }

    function _takeNativeFee(uint256 amount, address user) private returns (uint256) {
        uint256 fee = _protocolFee(amount, true);
        if (fee == 0) return amount;
        if (fee > amount) fee = amount;

        address referral = _referral(user);

        if (referral != address(0) && referralFee > 0) {

        }

        address treasury = _feeAddress();
        uint256 protocolFee = fee - referralFee;
        if (treasury != address(0) && protocolFee > 0) {
            _safeTransferETH(treasury, protocolFee);
        }

        return amount - fee;
    }

    function _feeAddress() private view returns (address) {
        if (_smartHelper == address(0)) return address(0);
        try ISmartHelper(_smartHelper).feeAddress() returns (address a) {
            return a;
        } catch {
            return address(0);
        }
    }

    function _referral(address user) private view returns (address) {
        if (_smartHelper == address(0)) return address(0);
        try ISmartHelper(_smartHelper).getReferralInfo(user) returns (address r) {
            return r;
        } catch {
            return address(0);
        }
    }

    function _protocolFee(uint256 amount, bool nativeFee) private view returns (uint256) {
        if (_smartHelper == address(0)) return 0;
        try ISmartHelper(_smartHelper).calculateProtocolFees(amount, nativeFee) returns (uint256 f) {
            return f;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _protocolReferralFee(uint256 amount) private view returns (uint256) {
        if (_smartHelper == address(0)) return 0;
        try ISmartHelper(_smartHelper).calculateProtocolReferralFees(amount) returns (uint256 f) {
            return f;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _safeTransferETH(address to, uint256 value) private {
        (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: value}("");
        require(ok, "ETH transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) private {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, value), "ERC20 transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) private {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value), "ERC20 transferFrom failed");
    }

    function _safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 value) private {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector, spender, value), "Sell Token Approval Failed");
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data, string memory err) private {
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = token.call(data);
        if (!success) _revertWithData(returndata, err);
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), err);
        }
    }

    function _revertWithData(bytes memory returndata, string memory fallbackMessage) private pure {
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            assembly {
                revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
            }
        }
        revert(fallbackMessage);
    }
}
