    function inariZushi(address token) external payable returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut) {
        if (token == address(0)) {
            require(msg.value > 0, "Invalid token amount");
            IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: msg.value}();
            token = WETH;
            amountOut = msg.value;
        } else {
            amountOut = _balanceOf(token, msg.sender);
            _safeTransferFrom(token, msg.sender, address(this), amountOut);
        }

        if (token != SUSHI) {
            amountOut = _swap(token, SUSHI, amountOut, 0, address(0), "");
        }

        (amountOut, shareOut) = _depositToBento(SUSHI, msg.sender, amountOut);
    }

    function bridgeToken(address[] calldata tokensIn, address[] calldata tokensOut) external {
        uint256 len = _min(tokensIn.length, tokensOut.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (tokensIn[i] == tokensOut[i]) continue;
            uint256 amount = _balanceOf(tokensIn[i], msg.sender);
            if (amount == 0) continue;
            _safeTransferFrom(tokensIn[i], msg.sender, address(this), amount);
            uint256 out = _swap(tokensIn[i], tokensOut[i], amount, 0, address(0), "");
            _safeTransfer(tokensOut[i], msg.sender, out);
        }
    }

    function batch(bytes[] calldata calls, bool revertOnFail) external payable returns (bytes[] memory results) {
        results = new bytes[](calls.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < calls.length; i++) {
            (bool success, bytes memory result) = address(this).delegatecall(calls[i]);
            if (!success && revertOnFail) _revertWithData(result);
            results[i] = result;
        }
    }

    function _collectInput(address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn) internal returns (address inToken, uint256 pulled) {
        if (tokenIn == address(0)) {
            require(amountIn == 0 || amountIn == msg.value, "Invalid token amount");
            pulled = amountIn == 0 ? msg.value : amountIn;
            require(pulled > 0, "Invalid token amount");
            IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: pulled}();
            inToken = WETH;
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "Eth sent with token");
            inToken = tokenIn;
            pulled = amountIn;
            _safeTransferFrom(inToken, msg.sender, address(this), pulled);
        }
    }

    function _swap(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        address target,
        bytes memory data
    ) internal returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        if (amountIn == 0 || tokenIn == tokenOut) return amountIn;

        uint256 beforeBal = _balanceOf(tokenOut, address(this));

        if (target != address(0) && data.length > 0) {
            _safeApprove(tokenIn, target, 0);
            _safeApprove(tokenIn, target, amountIn);
            _call(target, data, "No Swap Available");
        } else {
            _safeApprove(tokenIn, SUSHI_ROUTER, 0);
            _safeApprove(tokenIn, SUSHI_ROUTER, amountIn);
            address[] memory path = new address[](2);
            path[0] = tokenIn;
            path[1] = tokenOut;
            IRouter(SUSHI_ROUTER).swapExactTokensForTokens(
                amountIn,
                amountOutMin,
                path,
                address(this),
                block.timestamp
            );
        }

        amountOut = _balanceOf(tokenOut, address(this)).sub(beforeBal);
        require(amountOut >= amountOutMin, "ERR: High Slippage");
    }

    function _zapOutInternal(address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint256 shareIn) internal returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut) {
        (uint256 amountIn,) = IBentoBox(BENTOBOX).withdraw(IERC20(tokenIn), msg.sender, address(this), 0, shareIn);
        address outToken = tokenOut == address(0) ? WETH : tokenOut;
        amountOut = _swap(tokenIn, outToken, amountIn, 0, address(0), "");
        if (tokenOut == address(0)) {
            IWETH(WETH).withdraw(amountOut);
            _sendETH(msg.sender, amountOut);
            shareOut = 0;
        } else {
            _safeTransfer(tokenOut, msg.sender, amountOut);
            shareOut = 0;
        }
    }

    function _depositToBento(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut) {
        _safeApprove(token, BENTOBOX, 0);
        _safeApprove(token, BENTOBOX, amount);
        (amountOut, shareOut) = IBentoBox(BENTOBOX).deposit(IERC20(token), address(this), to, amount, 0);
    }

    function _addAsset(address pair, address to, uint256 share) internal returns (uint256 fraction) {
        bytes memory ret = _call(
            pair,
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x1b51e940), to, false, share),
            "No Swap Available"
        );
        if (ret.length >= 32) fraction = abi.decode(ret, (uint256));
    }

    function _stakeToCream(uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256 cAmount) {
        _safeApprove(SUSHI, CREAM_SUSHI, 0);
        _safeApprove(SUSHI, CREAM_SUSHI, amount);
        _mintCToken(CREAM_SUSHI, amount);
        cAmount = _balanceOf(CREAM_SUSHI, address(this));
    }

    function _unstakeSushiFromCreamFromBento(address recipient, uint256 shareIn) internal {
        (uint256 cAmount,) = IBentoBox(BENTOBOX).withdraw(IERC20(CREAM_SUSHI), msg.sender, address(this), 0, shareIn);
        _redeemCToken(CREAM_SUSHI, cAmount);
        uint256 sushiAmount = _balanceOf(SUSHI, address(this));
        if (sushiAmount > 0) _safeTransfer(SUSHI, recipient, sushiAmount);
    }

    function _mintCToken(address cToken, uint256 amount) internal {
        bytes memory ret = _call(cToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa0712d68), amount), "No Swap Available");
        if (ret.length >= 32) require(abi.decode(ret, (uint256)) == 0, "No Swap Available");
    }

    function _redeemCToken(address cToken, uint256 amount) internal {
        bytes memory ret = _call(cToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xdb006a75), amount), "No Swap Available");
        if (ret.length >= 32) require(abi.decode(ret, (uint256)) == 0, "No Swap Available");
    }

    function _miniChefLpToken(uint256 pid) internal view returns (address lpToken) {
        bytes memory ret = _staticCall(MINI_CHEF_V2, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x78ed5d1f), pid), "No Swap Available");
        if (ret.length >= 32) lpToken = abi.decode(ret, (address));
    }

    function _miniChefDeposit(uint256 pid, uint256 amount, address to) internal {
        _call(MINI_CHEF_V2, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x8dbdbe6d), pid, amount, to), "No Swap Available");
    }

    function _cTokenUnderlying(address cToken) internal view returns (address token) {
        bytes memory ret = _staticCall(cToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x6f307dc3)), "BoringERC20: BalanceOf failed");
        require(ret.length >= 32, "BoringERC20: BalanceOf failed");
        token = abi.decode(ret, (address));
    }

    function _aTokenUnderlying(address aToken) internal view returns (address token) {
        bytes memory ret = _staticCall(aToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xb16a19de)), "No Swap Available");
        require(ret.length >= 32, "No Swap Available");
        token = abi.decode(ret, (address));
    }

    function _balanceOf(address token, address user) internal view returns (uint256 amount) {
        bytes memory ret = _staticCall(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x70a08231), user), "BoringERC20: BalanceOf failed");
        if (ret.length >= 32) amount = abi.decode(ret, (uint256));
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa9059cbb), to, amount), "BoringERC20: Transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x23b872dd), from, to, amount), "BoringERC20: TransferFrom failed");
    }

    function _safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x095ea7b3), spender, amount), "BoringERC20: Approve failed");
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = token.call(data);
        require(success, errorMessage);
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), errorMessage);
        }
    }

    function _call(address target, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal returns (bytes memory ret) {
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call(data);
        require(success, errorMessage);
        return returndata;
    }

    function _staticCall(address target, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal view returns (bytes memory ret) {
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.staticcall(data);
        require(success, errorMessage);
        return returndata;
    }

    function _sendETH(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success,) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "No Swap Available");
    }

    function _revertWithData(bytes memory data) internal pure {
        if (data.length == 0) revert("Transaction reverted silently");
        assembly {
            revert(add(data, 32), mload(data))
        }
    }

    function _min(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a < b ? a : b;
    }
}

    }

        return (

            _feeTokensData.e
        );
    }

    function buyFees() external view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256) {

    }

    function sellFees() external view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        return (_sellFeesData.a, _sellFeesData.b, _sellFeesData.c, _sellFeesData.d, _sellFeesData.e);
    }

    function getCirculatingSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 burned = _balances[address(0)] + _balances[address(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD)];
        return burned >= _totalSupply ? 0 : _totalSupply - burned;
    }

    function userInfo(address user) external view returns (bool, bool, bool) {

    }

    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256) {

    function initialize(bytes calldata data) external payable {
        if (_initialized) revert InvalidInitialization();
        _initialized = true;

        try this.decodeInit(data) returns (
            address router_,
            address main_,
            address secondary_,
            uint256 supply_,
            uint256 maxTx_,
            uint256 maxWallet_,
            uint256 swapAt_,
            uint256 whitelistDur_,
            string memory name_,
            string memory symbol_
        ) {
            if (router_ != address(0)) _router = router_;
            if (main_ != address(0)) _mainWallet = main_;
            if (secondary_ != address(0)) _secondaryWallet = secondary_;
            if (bytes(name_).length != 0) _nameToken = name_;
            if (bytes(symbol_).length != 0) _symbolToken = symbol_;

            if (_totalSupply == 0) {
                _mint(_owner, supply_ == 0 ? (1_000_000_000 * (10 ** uint256(_DECIMALS))) : supply_);
            }

            if (maxTx_ != 0) _maxTxAmount = maxTx_;
            if (maxWallet_ != 0) _maxWallet = maxWallet_;
            if (swapAt_ != 0) _swapTokensAtAmount = swapAt_;
            _whitelistDuration = whitelistDur_;
        } catch {
            if (_totalSupply == 0) {
                _mint(_owner, 1_000_000_000 * (10 ** uint256(_DECIMALS)));
            }
            if (_maxTxAmount == 0) _maxTxAmount = _totalSupply / 100;
            if (_maxWallet == 0) _maxWallet = _totalSupply / 50;
            if (_swapTokensAtAmount == 0) _swapTokensAtAmount = _totalSupply / 10_000;
        }

        if (_maxTxAmount == 0) _maxTxAmount = _totalSupply / 100;
        if (_maxWallet == 0) _maxWallet = _totalSupply / 50;
        if (_swapTokensAtAmount == 0) _swapTokensAtAmount = _totalSupply / 10_000;

        _createPairIfNeeded();
        _setFlag(_mainWallet, 0, true);
        _setFlag(_secondaryWallet, 0, true);

        emit Initialized(uint64(block.number));
        _refreshDerived();

        external
        pure
        returns (
            address router_,
            address main_,
            address secondary_,
            uint256 supply_,
            uint256 maxTx_,
            uint256 maxWallet_,
            uint256 swapAt_,
            uint256 whitelistDur_,
            string memory name_,
            string memory symbol_

        return abi.decode(
            data,
            (address, address, address, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, string, string)

        _whitelistEndTime = block.timestamp + _whitelistDuration;
        _whitelistActive = _whitelistDuration > 0;

        _lockID = block.number;

        _createPairIfNeeded();

        _refreshDerived();

        _setFlag(account, 0, enabled);

        }

        uint256 buyA,
        uint256 buyB,
        uint256 buyC,

        uint256 sellB,

        uint256 sellTotal = sellA + sellB + sellC;

        _buyFeesData = FeeBucket(buyA, buyB, buyC, 0, buyTotal);
        _sellFeesData = FeeBucket(sellA, sellB, sellC, 0, sellTotal);

        _transferOwnership(address(0));

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidApprover(from);
        if (to == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidReceiver(to);

        if (_balances[from] < amount) revert InvalidConfiguration();

        if (!_tradingEnabled && from != _owner && to != _owner && from != address(this)) {
            revert TradingNotEnabled();
        }

        if (_whitelistActive && block.timestamp >= _whitelistEndTime) {
            _whitelistActive = false;
        }

        if (_whitelistActive && from != _owner && to != _owner) {
            if (!_isFeeExempt(from) && !_isFeeExempt(to)) {
                revert TradingNotEnabled();
            }
        }

        if (amount != 0) {
            if (!_isTxExempt(from) && !_isTxExempt(to) && _maxTxAmount != 0 && amount > _maxTxAmount) {
                revert InvalidConfiguration();
            }

            if (!_isWalletExempt(to) && to != _pair && _maxWallet != 0) {
                if (_balances[to] + amount > _maxWallet) revert ExceedsMaxWalletAmount();
            }
        }

        if (_shouldSwapBack(from, to)) {
            _swapBack();
        }

        uint256 feeAmount;
        uint256 denominator = _customSlot0a == 0 ? 10_000 : _customSlot0a;

        if (!_isFeeExempt(from) && !_isFeeExempt(to)) {
            uint256 feeBps;
            if (from == _pair) {
                feeBps = _feeTotal(_buyFeesData);
            } else if (to == _pair) {
                feeBps = _feeTotal(_sellFeesData);
            }
            if (feeBps != 0) {
                feeAmount = (amount * feeBps) / denominator;
            }
        }

        if (feeAmount != 0) {
            _basicTransfer(from, address(this), feeAmount);
            _feeTokensData.e += feeAmount;
            if (to == _pair) _feeTokensData.b += feeAmount;
            else if (from == _pair) _feeTokensData.a += feeAmount;
            else _feeTokensData.c += feeAmount;
        }

        _basicTransfer(from, to, amount - feeAmount);

            !_swapping &&
            _swapEnabled &&
            _router != address(0) &&
            _pair != address(0) &&
            to == _pair &&
            from != address(this) &&
            _balances[address(this)] >= _swapTokensAtAmount &&
            _swapTokensAtAmount != 0;
    }

    function _swapBack() internal {
        uint256 tokenBalance = _balances[address(this)];
        if (tokenBalance < _swapTokensAtAmount) return;

        uint256 amountToSwap = tokenBalance;
        uint256 cap = _swapTokensAtAmount * 20;
        if (cap != 0 && amountToSwap > cap) amountToSwap = cap;

        _swapping = true;
        _allowances[address(this)][_router] = amountToSwap;
        emit Approval(address(this), _router, amountToSwap);

        address weth;
        try IRouter(_router).WETH() returns (address w) {
            weth = w;
        } catch {
            _swapping = false;
            return;
        }

        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = weth;

        uint256 ethBefore = address(this).balance;
        try IRouter(_router).swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(
            amountToSwap,
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp
        ) {
            uint256 received = address(this).balance - ethBefore;
            emit SwapAndLiquify(amountToSwap, received);

            if (received != 0) {
                uint256 half = received / 2;
                _sendETH(_mainWallet == address(0) ? _owner : _mainWallet, half);
                _sendETH(_secondaryWallet == address(0) ? _owner : _secondaryWallet, address(this).balance);
            }
        } catch {}
        _swapping = false;
    }

    function _createPairIfNeeded() internal {
        if (_router == address(0) || _pair != address(0)) return;

        address fac;
        address weth;
        try IRouter(_router).factory() returns (address f) {
            fac = f;
        } catch {
            return;
        }
        try IRouter(_router).WETH() returns (address w) {
            weth = w;
        } catch {
            return;
        }
        if (fac == address(0) || weth == address(0)) return;

        try IFactory(fac).createPair(address(this), weth) returns (address p) {
            _pair = p;
        } catch {}
    }

    function _spendAllowance(address tokenOwner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 current = _allowances[tokenOwner][spender];
        if (current != type(uint256).max) {
            if (current < amount) revert InvalidConfiguration();
            unchecked {
                _allowances[tokenOwner][spender] = current - amount;
            }
            emit Approval(tokenOwner, spender, _allowances[tokenOwner][spender]);
        }
    }

    function _approve(address tokenOwner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (tokenOwner == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidApprover(tokenOwner);
        if (spender == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidReceiver(spender);
        _allowances[tokenOwner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(tokenOwner, spender, amount);
    }

    function _basicTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        unchecked {
            _balances[from] -= amount;
            _balances[to] += amount;
        }
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ERC20InvalidReceiver(to);
        _totalSupply += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
    }

    function _setFlag(address account, uint256 shift, bool enabled) internal {
        if (account == address(0)) return;
        uint256 mask = uint256(1) << shift;
        if (enabled) _userFlags[account] |= mask;
        else _userFlags[account] &= ~mask;
    }

    function _isFeeExempt(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        return (_userFlags[account] & 1) != 0;
    }

    function _isTxExempt(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        return (_userFlags[account] & (1 << 8)) != 0;
    }

    function _isWalletExempt(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        return (_userFlags[account] & (1 << 16)) != 0;
    }

    function _feeTotal(FeeBucket storage b) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 t = b.e;
        if (t == 0) t = b.a + b.b + b.c + b.d;
        return t;
    }

    function _sendETH(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (to == address(0) || amount == 0) return;
        (bool ok, ) = payable(to).call{value: amount}("");
        ok;
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _onlyOwner() internal view {
        if (msg.sender != _owner) revert OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(msg.sender);
    }

    function _refreshDerived() internal {
        _addressesData[0] = _router;
        _addressesData[1] = _pair;
        _addressesData[2] = _mainWallet;
        _addressesData[3] = _secondaryWallet;
        _addressesData[4] = address(this);

        _limitsData[0] = _maxTxAmount;
        _limitsData[1] = _maxWallet;
        _limitsData[2] = _swapTokensAtAmount;
        _limitsData[3] = _launchedAt;
        _limitsData[4] = _whitelistEndTime;
        _limitsData[5] = _whitelistDuration;
        _limitsData[6] = _lpLockDuration;
        _limitsData[7] = _lockID;
        _limitsData[8] = _customSlot25;
    }

    function _calldataWord(uint256 pos) private pure returns (uint256 v) {
        assembly {
            v := calldataload(pos)
        }
    }

    function _returnUint(uint256 v) private pure {
        assembly {
            mstore(0x00, v)
            return(0x00, 0x20)
        }
    }

    function _returnAddress(address a) private pure {
        assembly {
            mstore(0x00, a)
            return(0x00, 0x20)
        }
    }

    function _returnBool(bool b) private pure {
        uint256 v = b ? 1 : 0;
        assembly {
            mstore(0x00, v)
            return(0x00, 0x20)
        }
    }

        _balances[account] = bal - amount;

        seizeAmount = (seizeAmount * priceBorrowed) / priceCollateral;
        uint256 seizeTokens = (seizeAmount * EXP_SCALE) / exchangeRate;

        _accountAssets[account].push(cToken);

        try IApeToken(cToken).version() returns (uint256 v) {
            if (v == 2) {
                try IApeToken(cToken).registerCollateral(account) returns (bool) {} catch {}
            }
        } catch {}

        if (!ok) return 1;

        require(err == 0 && shortfall == 0, "insufficient liquidity");

        _accountMembership[account][cToken] = false;
        _removeAccountAsset(account, cToken);

        emit MarketExited(cToken, account);

        try IApeToken(cToken).version() returns (uint256 v) {

            }

        address account,
        address cTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) internal view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 sumCollateral;
        uint256 sumBorrowPlusEffects;

        address[] storage assets = _accountAssets[account];

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            address asset = assets[i];
            Market storage m = _markets[asset];
            if (!m.isListed) continue;

            (bool ok, uint256 cTokenBalance, uint256 borrowBal, uint256 exchangeRateMantissa) = _safeAccountSnapshot(asset, account);
            if (!ok) return (1, 0, 0);

            uint256 price = _safePrice(asset);
            if (price == 0) return (2, 0, 0);

            uint256 tokensToDenom = (cTokenBalance * exchangeRateMantissa) / EXP_SCALE;
            uint256 collateral = (tokensToDenom * m.collateralFactorMantissa) / EXP_SCALE;
            collateral = (collateral * price) / EXP_SCALE;

            sumCollateral += collateral;
            sumBorrowPlusEffects += (borrowBal * price) / EXP_SCALE;

            if (asset == cTokenModify) {
                uint256 redeemEffect = (redeemTokens * exchangeRateMantissa) / EXP_SCALE;
                redeemEffect = (redeemEffect * m.collateralFactorMantissa) / EXP_SCALE;
                redeemEffect = (redeemEffect * price) / EXP_SCALE;
                sumBorrowPlusEffects += redeemEffect;
                sumBorrowPlusEffects += (borrowAmount * price) / EXP_SCALE;
            }
        }

        if (sumCollateral > sumBorrowPlusEffects) {
            return (0, sumCollateral - sumBorrowPlusEffects, 0);
        }
        return (0, 0, sumBorrowPlusEffects - sumCollateral);
    }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {

        } catch {

        }
    }

        } catch {
            return 0;
        }

        try IApeToken(cToken).totalReserves() returns (uint256 v) {
            return v;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _safeExchangeRateStored(address cToken) internal view returns (uint256) {
        try IApeToken(cToken).exchangeRateStored() returns (uint256 v) {
            return v;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _safeAccountSnapshot(address cToken, address account)
        internal
        view
        returns (bool ok, uint256 cTokenBalance, uint256 borrowBalance, uint256 exchangeRateMantissa)
    {
        try IApeToken(cToken).getAccountSnapshot(account) returns (
            uint256 err,
            uint256 tokenBal,
            uint256 borrowBal,
            uint256 exch
        ) {
            if (err != 0) return (false, 0, 0, 0);
            return (true, tokenBal, borrowBal, exch);
        } catch {
            return (false, 0, 0, 0);
        }
    }

        if (!ok) return false;
        if (ret.length == 0) return true;
        if (ret.length >= 32) return abi.decode(ret, (bool));
        return false;

        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = interestRateModel.staticcall(

        );
        require(ok && ret.length >= 32, "borrow rate failed");

    function _getSupplyRate(
        uint256 cash,

        uint256 reserves,

    ) internal view returns (uint256) {

                cash,

                reserves,
                reserveFactorMantissa_
            )
        );
        require(ok && ret.length >= 32, "supply rate failed");
        return abi.decode(ret, (uint256));
    }

    function _callComptrollerUint(bytes memory callData) internal returns (uint256) {
        if (comptroller == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = comptroller.call(callData);
        if (!ok || ret.length < 32) return 1;
        return abi.decode(ret, (uint256));
    }

    function _callComptrollerVoid(bytes memory callData) internal {
        if (comptroller == address(0)) return;
        comptroller.call(callData);
    }

        require(target != address(0), "target zero");
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = target.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature(sig));
        require(ok && ret.length >= 32 && abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "marker method returned false");
    }

        return keccak256(

                keccak256(bytes(_NAME)),

                block.chainid,

    }

    function _hashTypedDataV4(bytes32 structHash) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(bytes2(0x1901), _domainSeparatorV4(), structHash));

    function _recover(bytes32 digest, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal pure returns (address) {
        require(uint256(s) <= uint256(_MAX_S), "ECDSA: invalid signature 's' value");
        require(v == 27 || v == 28, "ECDSA: invalid signature");
        address signer = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
        require(signer != address(0), "ECDSA: invalid signature");
        return signer;
    }

        }
    }

        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(prev, newOwner);
    }

    bytes32 public constant ROYALTY_ADJUSTER_ROLE = 0x42cc64ec4860a94ad09164ceae04e16d6b1dd40c82fba2b191377262fa45e2ae;
    bytes32 public constant WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE = keccak256("WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE");

    uint256 private constant _FEE_DENOMINATOR = 10_000;
    uint256 private constant _SECP256K1_HALF_N = 0x7fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff5d576e7357a4501ddfe92f46681b20a0;
    uint256 private constant _EIP2098_MASK = 0x7fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff;

    mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) private _roles;

    string public name;
    string public symbol;
    string public baseUri;
    address public owner;

    uint256[6] public tierQuantities;
    uint256[6] public tierOffsets;
    uint256[6] public pricePerTokenPerTier;

    mapping(uint8 => bool) public mintingEnabled;
    mapping(uint8 => bool) public whitelistMintingEnabled;
    mapping(address => bool) public whitelist;
    mapping(address => bool) public whitelistSigner;

    mapping(uint8 => mapping(uint8 => mapping(uint256 => uint256))) public minted;

    RoyaltyData private _royalty;
    uint256 private _reentrancyStatus;
    uint256 private _nextTokenId;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;

    uint256[] private _allTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _allTokensIndex;
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _ownedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex;

    mapping(uint256 => uint8) private _tokenKingdom;
    mapping(uint256 => uint8) private _tokenGender;
    mapping(uint256 => uint8) private _tokenTier;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyRole(bytes32 role) {
        require(hasRole(role, msg.sender), "AccessControl: missing role");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_reentrancyStatus != 2, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _reentrancyStatus = 2;
        _;
        _reentrancyStatus = 1;
    }

    constructor() {
        name = "Kingdom";
        symbol = "KING";
        baseUri = "";

        tierQuantities = [uint256(5000), 4000, 3000, 2000, 1000, 500];
        tierOffsets = [uint256(1), 5001, 9001, 12001, 14001, 15001];
        pricePerTokenPerTier = [uint256(0.01 ether), 0.02 ether, 0.03 ether, 0.04 ether, 0.05 ether, 0.06 ether];

        _setRoleAdmin(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(PRICE_ADJUSTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(BASEURI_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(BENEFICIARY_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(MINT_ENABLE_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(ROYALTY_ADJUSTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);

        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(PRICE_ADJUSTER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(BASEURI_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(BENEFICIARY_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(MINT_ENABLE_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(ROYALTY_ADJUSTER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);

        _reentrancyStatus = 1;
        _nextTokenId = START_TOKEN_ID;
        _royalty = RoyaltyData({receiver: msg.sender, feeNumerator: 500});

        _transferOwnership(msg.sender);
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // IERC165
            interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // IERC721
            interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f || // IERC721Metadata
            interfaceId == 0x780e9d63 || // IERC721Enumerable
            interfaceId == 0x7965db0b || // IAccessControl
            interfaceId == 0x2a55205a;   // IERC2981
    }

    function mint_per_gender() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 0;
    }

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members[account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roles[role].adminRole;
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) external onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) external onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC721: address zero is not a valid owner");
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address tokenOwner = _owners[tokenId];
        require(tokenOwner != address(0), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return tokenOwner;
    }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address account, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _balances[account], "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[account][index];
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address tokenOwner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][operator];
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != tokenOwner, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(msg.sender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, msg.sender), "ERC721: approve caller is not token owner or approved for all");
        _approve(to, tokenId, tokenOwner);
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner or approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner or approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        if (bytes(baseUri).length == 0) return "";
        return string(abi.encodePacked(baseUri, _toString(tokenId)));
    }

    function getKingdom(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _tokenKingdom[tokenId];
    }

    function getGender(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _tokenGender[tokenId];
    }

    function getTier(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _tokenTier[tokenId];
    }

    function pricesPerTokenPerTier() external view returns (uint256[6] memory) {
        return pricePerTokenPerTier;
    }

    function getMintingEnabled() external view returns (bool[4] memory out) {
        for (uint8 i = 0; i < uint8(NUM_KINGDOMS); i++) {
            out[i] = mintingEnabled[i];
        }
    }

    function getWhitelistMintingEnabled() external view returns (bool[4] memory out) {
        for (uint8 i = 0; i < uint8(NUM_KINGDOMS); i++) {
            out[i] = whitelistMintingEnabled[i];
        }
    }

    function remainingTokens() external view returns (uint256[6][4] memory out) {
        for (uint8 kingdom = 0; kingdom < uint8(NUM_KINGDOMS); kingdom++) {
            for (uint8 tier = 1; tier <= uint8(MAX_TIER); tier++) {
                out[kingdom][tier - 1] = _remainingForTier(kingdom, tier);
            }
        }
    }

    function adjustBaseUri(string calldata newBaseUri) external onlyRole(BASEURI_ROLE) {
        string memory old = baseUri;
        baseUri = newBaseUri;
        emit BaseUriUpdated(old, newBaseUri);
    }

    function adjustPrices(uint256[6] calldata newPrices) external onlyRole(PRICE_ADJUSTER_ROLE) {
        uint256[6] memory oldPrices = pricePerTokenPerTier;
        pricePerTokenPerTier = newPrices;
        uint256[6] memory updated = pricePerTokenPerTier;
        emit PricesUpdated(oldPrices, updated);
    }

    function setMinting(uint8 kingdom, bool enabledMinting, bool enabledWhitelistMinting) external onlyRole(MINT_ENABLE_ROLE) {
        require(kingdom < uint8(NUM_KINGDOMS), "invalid kingdom");
        mintingEnabled[kingdom] = enabledMinting;
        whitelistMintingEnabled[kingdom] = enabledWhitelistMinting;
        emit KingdomMintingUpdated(kingdom, enabledMinting, enabledWhitelistMinting);
    }

    function addToWhitelist(address[] calldata accounts) external onlyRole(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            whitelist[accounts[i]] = true;
        }
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(address[] calldata accounts) external onlyRole(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            whitelist[accounts[i]] = false;
        }
    }

    function setWhitelistSigner(address[] calldata accounts, bool enabled) external onlyRole(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            whitelistSigner[accounts[i]] = enabled;
        }
    }

    function withdraw(address to) external onlyRole(BENEFICIARY_ROLE) {
        (bool ok, ) = payable(to).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(ok, "Address: unable to send value, recipient may have reverted");
    }

    function adjustRoyalty(RoyaltyData calldata newRoyalty) external onlyRole(ROYALTY_ADJUSTER_ROLE) {
        require(newRoyalty.receiver != address(0), "ERC2981: invalid receiver");
        require(newRoyalty.feeNumerator <= _FEE_DENOMINATOR, "ERC2981: royalty fee will exceed salePrice");
        _royalty = newRoyalty;
    }

    function royaltyInfo(uint256, uint256 salePrice) external view returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount) {
        receiver = _royalty.receiver;
        royaltyAmount = (salePrice * _royalty.feeNumerator) / _FEE_DENOMINATOR;
    }

    function mintFor(address to, uint256 quantity, uint8 kingdom, uint8 gender, uint256 tier) external onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(quantity > 0, "invalid quantity");
        require(kingdom < uint8(NUM_KINGDOMS), "invalid kingdom");
        require(gender < uint8(NUM_GENDERS), "invalid gender");
        require(tier >= MIN_TIER && tier <= MAX_TIER, "invalid tier");
        require(quantity <= _remainingForTier(kingdom, tier), "Not enough Tokens of selected Kingdom/Gender/Tier combination");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            _mintOne(to, kingdom, gender, uint8(tier), tier);
        }
    }

    function purchase(address to, uint256 quantity, uint8 kingdom, uint256 tier) external payable nonReentrant {
        if (!mintingEnabled[kingdom]) {
            require(whitelistMintingEnabled[kingdom], "Minting disabled for Kingdom");
            require(whitelist[msg.sender], "Your account is not whitelisted");
        }
        _purchaseInternal(to, quantity, kingdom, tier);
    }

    function purchaseSignedWhitelist(address to, uint256 quantity, uint8 kingdom, uint256 tier, bytes calldata signature) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(whitelistMintingEnabled[kingdom], "Minting disabled for Kingdom");

        bytes32 digest = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(address(this), bytes4(0xfd287627), msg.sender, to, quantity, kingdom, tier));
        address signer = _recoverSigner(_toEthSignedMessageHash(digest), signature);
        require(whitelistSigner[signer], "Your account is not whitelisted");

        _purchaseInternal(to, quantity, kingdom, tier);
    }

    function _purchaseInternal(address to, uint256 quantity, uint8 kingdom, uint256 tier) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(quantity > 0 && quantity <= 20, "You can purchase a maximum of 20 NFTs");
        require(kingdom < uint8(NUM_KINGDOMS), "invalid kingdom");
        require(tier >= MIN_TIER && tier <= MAX_TIER, "invalid tier");

        uint256 totalCost = pricePerTokenPerTier[tier - 1] * quantity;
        require(msg.value == totalCost, "Ether sent is not correct");
        require(quantity <= _remainingForTier(kingdom, tier), "Not enough Tokens of selected Kingdom/Gender/Tier combination");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            uint8 gender = uint8(uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.prevrandao, blockhash(block.number - 1), _nextTokenId, to, i))) % NUM_GENDERS);
            _mintOne(to, kingdom, gender, uint8(tier), tier);
        }
    }

    function _mintOne(address to, uint8 kingdom, uint8 gender, uint8 tierU8, uint256 tier) internal {
        uint256 tokenId = _nextTokenId;
        _nextTokenId = tokenId + 1;

        minted[kingdom][gender][tier] += 1;
        _tokenKingdom[tokenId] = kingdom;
        _tokenGender[tokenId] = gender;
        _tokenTier[tokenId] = tierU8;

        _safeMint(to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function _remainingForTier(uint8 kingdom, uint256 tier) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 cap = tierQuantities[tier - 1];
        uint256 used = minted[kingdom][0][tier] + minted[kingdom][1][tier];
        if (used >= cap) return 0;
        return cap - used;
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");

        _approve(address(0), tokenId, from);
        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);

        unchecked {
            _balances[from] -= 1;
            _balances[to] += 1;
        }
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        unchecked {
            _balances[to] += 1;
        }
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId, address tokenOwner) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(tokenOwner, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, spender) || getApproved(tokenId) == spender);
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _requireMinted(uint256 tokenId) internal view {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
            _allTokens.push(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            uint256 lastTokenIndex = _balances[from] - 1;
            uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

            if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
                uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
                _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
                _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
            }

            delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
            delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
        }

        if (to == address(0)) {
            uint256 lastIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
            uint256 index = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];

            if (index != lastIndex) {
                uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastIndex];
                _allTokens[index] = lastTokenId;
                _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = index;
            }

            delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
            _allTokens.pop();
        } else if (to != from) {
            uint256 length = _balances[to];
            _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
        }
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;
        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) {
                revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            }
            assembly {
                revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
            }
        }
    }

    function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal {
        _roles[role].adminRole = adminRole;
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = owner;
        owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _recoverSigner(bytes32 digest, bytes calldata signature) internal pure returns (address) {
        bytes32 r;
        bytes32 s;
        uint8 v;

        if (signature.length == 65) {
            assembly {
                r := calldataload(signature.offset)
                s := calldataload(add(signature.offset, 32))
                v := byte(0, calldataload(add(signature.offset, 64)))
            }
        } else if (signature.length == 64) {
            bytes32 vs;
            assembly {
                r := calldataload(signature.offset)
                vs := calldataload(add(signature.offset, 32))
            }
            s = bytes32(uint256(vs) & _EIP2098_MASK);
            v = uint8((uint256(vs) >> 255) + 27);
        } else {
            return address(0);
        }

        if (v < 27) v += 27;
        if (v != 27 && v != 28) return address(0);
        if (uint256(s) > _SECP256K1_HALF_N) return address(0);

        return ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
    }

    function _toEthSignedMessageHash(bytes32 hash) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32", hash));
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            unchecked {
                digits++;
            }
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            unchecked {
                digits -= 1;
            }
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

    }

        revert();
    }

    }

    }

    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {

    }

    function poolAddress(uint8 pool) external view returns (address) {
        return _poolAddress[pool];
    }

        if (privatePool != address(0)) {

    function numberOfInstallmentsMade(uint8 pool) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _numberOfInstallmentsMade[pool];
    }

    }

    function token() external view returns (address) {
        return _token;

    }

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract CommissionGame {
    struct Game {
        uint256 startedAt;
        uint256 updatedAt;
        uint256 minAmount;
        uint256 totalAmount;
        uint256 remainAmount;
        uint256 commissionAmount;
        uint256 participants;
        uint8 state;
    }

    struct GameMaxInfo {
        address user;
        uint256 amount;
    }

    address private _admin;
    address private _finance;
    address private _setting;

    uint256 private _lastRemainAmount;
    bool private _paused;
    uint32 private _currentGameCount;

    mapping(uint32 => Game) private _games;
    mapping(uint32 => GameMaxInfo) private _gameMaxInfo;

    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _superNode;
    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _auctioneer;
    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _shareNode;
    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _leaderShip;
    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _sponsorCommission;
    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _userInvestment;
    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => bool)) private _userWithdrawFlag;
    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => bool)) private _gameMemberFlag;
    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _keyCommission;

    mapping(uint32 => address[]) private _lastAddresses;
    mapping(uint32 => address[]) private _firstAddresses;

    event Failure(uint256 code, uint32 gameId, uint256 amount);
    event SetPaused(bool value);
    event SetAdmin(address value);
    event SetFinance(address value);
    event WithdrawCommission(address user, uint32 gameId, uint256 amount);
    event CalculateGame(uint32 gameId, uint256 amount);
    event PlayGame(address user, address referrer, uint256 amount);

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == _admin, "ADMIN");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyFinance() {
        require(msg.sender == _finance, "FINANCE");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _admin = msg.sender;
        _finance = msg.sender;
        _currentGameCount = 1;
    }

    receive() external payable {
        _onPlainTransfer();
    }

    fallback(bytes calldata data) external payable returns (bytes memory) {
        bytes4 sig;
        assembly {
            sig := calldataload(0)
        }
        if (sig == 0x00afec63 && data.length >= 68) {
            (uint32 gameId, address user) = abi.decode(data[4:], (uint32, address));
            return abi.encode(_gameMemberFlag[gameId][user]);
        }
        _onPlainTransfer();
        return "";
    }

    function admin() external view returns (address) {
        return _admin;
    }

    function finance() external view returns (address) {
        return _finance;
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function currentGameCount() external view returns (uint32) {
        return _currentGameCount;
    }

    function lastRemainAmount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lastRemainAmount;
    }

    function setPaused(bool value) external onlyAdmin returns (bool) {
        _paused = value;
        emit SetPaused(value);
        return true;
    }

    function setSetting(address setting_) external onlyAdmin returns (bool) {
        _setting = setting_;
        return true;
    }

    function setAdmin(address newAdmin) external onlyAdmin returns (bool) {
        require(newAdmin != address(0), "ZERO");
        _admin = newAdmin;
        emit SetAdmin(newAdmin);
        return true;
    }

    function setFinance(address newFinance) external onlyFinance returns (bool) {
        require(newFinance != address(0), "ZERO");
        _finance = newFinance;
        emit SetFinance(newFinance);
        return true;
    }

    function recycle(uint256 amount) external onlyFinance returns (bool) {
        require(_safeTransfer(_finance, amount), "TRANSFER");
        return true;
    }

    function playGame(uint32 gameId, address referrer) external payable returns (bool) {
        return _playGame(gameId, msg.sender, referrer, msg.value);
    }

    function withdrawCommission(uint32 gameId) external returns (bool) {
        if (_userWithdrawFlag[gameId][msg.sender]) {
            emit Failure(5, gameId, 0);
            return false;
        }

        uint256 amount = calculateCommission(gameId, msg.sender);
        if (amount == 0) {
            emit Failure(6, gameId, 0);
            return false;
        }

        _userWithdrawFlag[gameId][msg.sender] = true;

        Game storage g = _games[gameId];
        if (g.remainAmount >= amount) g.remainAmount -= amount;
        if (_lastRemainAmount >= amount) _lastRemainAmount -= amount;

        require(_safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount), "TRANSFER");
        emit WithdrawCommission(msg.sender, gameId, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function calculateGame(
        address[] calldata a,
        address[] calldata b,
        address[] calldata c,
        address[] calldata d,
        uint32 gameId
    ) external onlyAdmin returns (bool) {
        if (gameId == 0) gameId = _currentGameCount;
        _batchAssign(gameId, a, b, c, d);
        emit CalculateGame(gameId, _games[gameId].totalAmount);
        return true;
    }

    function calculateRemain(
        address[] calldata a,
        address[] calldata b,
        address[] calldata c,
        address[] calldata d,
        uint32 gameId
    ) external onlyAdmin returns (bool) {
        if (gameId == 0) gameId = _currentGameCount;
        _batchAssign(gameId, a, b, c, d);
        _games[gameId].state = 3;
        if (gameId == _currentGameCount) _currentGameCount += 1;
        return true;
    }

    function firstAddressLength(uint32 gameId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _firstAddresses[gameId].length;
    }

    function lastAddressLength(uint32 gameId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lastAddresses[gameId].length;
    }

    function firstAddress(uint32 gameId, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        require(index < _firstAddresses[gameId].length, "OOB");
        return _firstAddresses[gameId][index];
    }

    function lastAddress(uint32 gameId, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        require(index < _lastAddresses[gameId].length, "OOB");
        return _lastAddresses[gameId][index];
    }

    function game(uint32 gameId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 startedAt,
            uint256 updatedAt,
            uint256 minAmount,
            uint256 totalAmount,
            uint256 remainAmount,
            uint256 commissionAmount,
            uint256 participants,
            uint8 state
        )
    {
        Game storage g = _games[gameId];
        return (
            g.startedAt,
            g.updatedAt,
            g.minAmount,
            g.totalAmount,
            g.remainAmount,
            g.commissionAmount,
            g.participants,
            g.state
        );
    }

    function gameMax(uint32 gameId) external view returns (address, uint256) {
        GameMaxInfo storage m = _gameMaxInfo[gameId];
        return (m.user, m.amount);
    }

    function userInvestment(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _userInvestment[gameId][user];
    }

    function userWithdrawFlag(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return _userWithdrawFlag[gameId][user];
    }

    function sponsorCommission(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _sponsorCommission[gameId][user];
    }

    function shareNode(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _shareNode[gameId][user];
    }

    function leaderShip(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _leaderShip[gameId][user];
    }

    function superNode(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _superNode[gameId][user];
    }

    function auctioneer(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _auctioneer[gameId][user];
    }

    function calculateAmountMax(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _userInvestment[gameId][user] * 2;
    }

    function calculateKeyCommission(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _keyCommission[gameId][user] + _calculateFirstAddressRaw(gameId, user) + _calculateLastAddressRaw(gameId, user);
    }

    function calculateKeyNumber(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _countInArray(_firstAddresses[gameId], user) + _countInArray(_lastAddresses[gameId], user);
    }

    function calculateFirstAddress(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _calculateFirstAddressRaw(gameId, user);
    }

    function calculateLastAddress(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _calculateLastAddressRaw(gameId, user);
    }

    function calculateCommission(uint32 gameId, address user) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_userWithdrawFlag[gameId][user]) return 0;

        uint256 gross =
            _sponsorCommission[gameId][user] +
            _shareNode[gameId][user] +
            _leaderShip[gameId][user] +
            _superNode[gameId][user] +
            _keyCommission[gameId][user] +
            _auctioneer[gameId][user] +
            _calculateFirstAddressRaw(gameId, user) +
            _calculateLastAddressRaw(gameId, user);

        uint256 fee = (gross * _rate(0xea99e689, 5)) / 100;
        return gross > fee ? gross - fee : 0;
    }

    function commissionGameCount(address user) external view returns (uint32[] memory) {
        uint32[] memory tmp = new uint32[](_currentGameCount + 1);
        uint256 n;
        for (uint32 i = 1; i <= _currentGameCount; i++) {
            if (calculateCommission(i, user) > 0) {
                tmp[n] = i;
                n++;
            }
            if (i == type(uint32).max) break;
        }
        uint32[] memory out = new uint32[](n);
        for (uint256 j = 0; j < n; j++) out[j] = tmp[j];
        return out;
    }

    function gameMemberFlag(uint32 gameId, address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return _gameMemberFlag[gameId][user];
    }

    function _playGame(uint32 gameId, address player, address referrer, uint256 amount) internal returns (bool) {
        if (_paused) {
            emit Failure(7, gameId, amount);
            return false;
        }
        if (amount == 0) {
            emit Failure(3, gameId, amount);
            return false;
        }

        if (gameId == 0) gameId = _currentGameCount;
        if (gameId > _currentGameCount) {
            emit Failure(2, gameId, amount);
            return false;
        }

        Game storage g = _games[gameId];
        if (g.startedAt == 0) {
            g.startedAt = block.timestamp;
            g.updatedAt = block.timestamp;
            g.minAmount = 0.01 ether;
            g.state = 2;
        }

        if (amount < g.minAmount) {
            emit Failure(4, gameId, amount);
            return false;
        }

        g.updatedAt = block.timestamp;
        g.totalAmount += amount;
        g.remainAmount += amount;
        g.participants += 1;
        _lastRemainAmount += amount;

        _userInvestment[gameId][player] += amount;
        _auctioneer[gameId][player] += amount;

        if (!_gameMemberFlag[gameId][player]) {
            _gameMemberFlag[gameId][player] = true;
            _firstAddresses[gameId].push(player);
        }

        _lastAddresses[gameId].push(player);
        if (_lastAddresses[gameId].length > 10) {
            for (uint256 i = 0; i + 1 < _lastAddresses[gameId].length; i++) {
                _lastAddresses[gameId][i] = _lastAddresses[gameId][i + 1];
            }
            _lastAddresses[gameId].pop();
        }

        if (referrer != address(0) && referrer != player) {
            _sponsorCommission[gameId][referrer] += (amount * _rate(0xe3f9e352, 5)) / 100;
        }

        _shareNode[gameId][player] += (amount * _rate(0xfb802a65, 10)) / 100;
        _leaderShip[gameId][player] += (amount * _rate(0x7613e80a, 6)) / 100;
        _superNode[gameId][player] += (amount * _rate(0x484db63f, 4)) / 100;
        _keyCommission[gameId][player] += (amount * _rate(0x82cac6df, 2)) / 100;

        uint256 invested = _userInvestment[gameId][player];
        if (invested > _gameMaxInfo[gameId].amount) {
            _gameMaxInfo[gameId] = GameMaxInfo(player, invested);
        }

        uint256 fee = (amount * _rate(0xea99e689, 5)) / 100;
        if (fee > 0 && _finance != address(0) && address(this).balance >= fee) {
            bool sent = _safeTransfer(_finance, fee);
            if (sent) {
                if (g.remainAmount >= fee) g.remainAmount -= fee;
                g.commissionAmount += fee;
            }
        }

        emit PlayGame(player, referrer, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function _batchAssign(
        uint32 gameId,
        address[] memory a,
        address[] memory b,
        address[] memory c,
        address[] memory d
    ) internal {
        Game storage g = _games[gameId];
        uint256 total = a.length + b.length + c.length + d.length;
        if (total == 0 || g.remainAmount == 0) return;

        uint256 unit = g.remainAmount / total;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < a.length; i++) _sponsorCommission[gameId][a[i]] += unit;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < b.length; i++) _shareNode[gameId][b[i]] += unit;
